title.raw: 卷五十 志第三 天文三 Volume 50 Treatises 3: Astronomy 3

translations.literal: The Twenty-eight Lodges, Part One
translations.idiomatic: The Twenty-eight Lunar Lodges (Part One)

sentences.zh: 角宿二星，爲天關，其間天門也，其內天庭也。

translations.literal: The Horn Lodge has two stars; they form the Celestial Gate. Between them is the Heavenly Gate; within them is the Celestial Court.
translations.idiomatic: The Horn Lodge comprises two stars that serve as the Celestial Gate; the space between them is the Heavenly Gate, and the region within is the Celestial Court.

sentences.zh: 故黃道經其中，七曜之所行也。

translations.literal: Therefore the Yellow Path passes through their midst—it is where the Seven Luminaries travel.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic therefore runs through them, for this is the path along which the Seven Luminaries move.

translations.literal: The left Horn is the Celestial Field, is the office of judgment, and governs punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The left Horn is identified with the Celestial Field and with judicial administration; it presides over penal matters.

translations.literal: To its south is the Solar Path.
translations.idiomatic: South of it lies the Solar Path.

translations.literal: The right Horn is the general and governs armies.
translations.idiomatic: The right Horn represents the commander and presides over military affairs.

translations.literal: To its north is the Lunar Path.
translations.idiomatic: North of it lies the Lunar Path.

sentences.zh: 蓋天之三門，猶房之四表。

translations.literal: They are, as it were, the three gates of Heaven, just as the Room Lodge has its four markers.
translations.idiomatic: They function as the three gates of Heaven, analogous to the four boundary markers of the Room Lodge.

sentences.zh: 星明大，吉，王道太平，賢者在朝；

translations.literal: When the stars are bright and large, it is auspicious: the kingly Way is at peace and worthy men are at court.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars shine bright and large, the omen is favorable—the royal Way is tranquil and worthy ministers hold office at court.

translations.literal: If they tremble or shift position, the king will travel.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling or shifting of the stars portends that the sovereign will go on campaign or tour.

translations.literal: When the left Horn is red and bright, prisons are settled.
translations.idiomatic: A red, brilliant left Horn indicates that legal cases will be resolved and prisons emptied.

translations.literal: When dim and small, the kingly Way is lost.
translations.idiomatic: If they are dim and faint, the royal Way has fallen into disorder.

sentences.zh: 陶隱居曰：「左角天津，右角天門，中爲天關。

translations.literal: Tao Hongjing said: "The left Horn is the Celestial Ford, the right Horn is the Heavenly Gate, and between them is the Celestial Gate."
translations.idiomatic: Tao Hongjing wrote: "The left Horn is the Celestial Ford, the right Horn the Heavenly Gate, and between them lies the Celestial Gate."

translations.literal: A solar eclipse at the Horn Lodge is ill-omened for the king.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in the Horn Lodge bodes ill for the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 暈於角內，有陰謀，陰國用兵得地，又主大赦。

translations.literal: A halo within the Horn indicates secret plots; a yin state will wage war and gain territory, and it also presages a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A halo appearing within the Horn signals clandestine intrigue; a northern or yin-aligned state will take the field and seize territory, and the omen also governs a general pardon.

sentences.zh: 月犯角，大臣憂獄事，法官憂黜。

translations.literal: When the moon trespasses upon the Horn, great ministers worry over prison affairs and judges fear dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon encroaches upon the Horn, senior ministers grow anxious over legal cases and judicial officials fear removal from office.

translations.literal: It also portends anxiety within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The omen further indicates distress within the inner palace.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: in its allotted region armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends the outbreak of war in the corresponding territorial division.

translations.literal: The right Horn: disaster for the right general.
translations.idiomatic: As for the right Horn, calamity befalls the commander of the right wing.

translations.literal: The left is likewise so.
translations.idiomatic: The same applies to the left.

translations.literal: Some say it governs water.
translations.idiomatic: According to another interpretation, it presides over floods and water disasters.

translations.literal: When the color is yellow, there is a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A yellow hue signals a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 月暈三重，入天門及兩角，兵起，將失利。

translations.literal: A triple lunar halo entering the Heavenly Gate and both Horns: armies rise and generals suffer defeat.
translations.idiomatic: A triple lunar halo reaching the Heavenly Gate and both Horns portends the outbreak of war and defeat for commanders in the field.

translations.literal: When Jupiter trespasses upon it, there is famine.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter's encroachment upon the Horn foretells famine.

translations.literal: When Mars trespasses upon it, the state declines and armies are defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Mars's trespass upon the Horn indicates national decline and military defeat.

translations.literal: Trespassing upon the left Horn: there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Encroachment upon the left Horn portends a pardon or amnesty.

translations.literal: The right Horn: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Encroachment upon the right Horn signals the outbreak of war.

translations.literal: If it stations there, slanderous ministers advance and state affairs grow urgent.
translations.idiomatic: When Mars halts there, slanderous officials gain influence and government affairs turn pressing.

translations.literal: Dwelling in the yang sector, there is joy.
translations.idiomatic: If it occupies the yang side, the omen brings good fortune.

sentences.zh: 填星犯角爲喪，一曰兵起。

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing upon the Horn means mourning; another reading says armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn's encroachment upon the Horn portends mourning; according to another tradition, it signals the outbreak of war.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing upon the Horn: among the host of ministers there are divergent plots.
translations.idiomatic: Venus's trespass upon the Horn indicates that ministers harbor subversive designs.

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: minor warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury's encroachment portends skirmishing or small-scale conflict.

translations.literal: If it stations there, great floods.
translations.idiomatic: When Mercury halts there, catastrophic flooding is foretold.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: armies rise and the five grains are harmed.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star's encroachment portends war and damage to the harvest.

translations.literal: Stationing at the left Horn, color red: drought.
translations.idiomatic: If it halts at the left Horn and appears red, drought will follow.

translations.literal: Stationing at the right Horn: great floods.
translations.idiomatic: If it halts at the right Horn, great flooding is foretold.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing upon it, color white: warfare.
translations.idiomatic: A comet encroaching upon the Horn, if white in color, portends war.

translations.literal: Red: wherever it points, armies are broken.
translations.idiomatic: If red, the direction it points will see armies shattered in defeat.

translations.literal: Emerging from the Horn: throughout the realm, military chaos.
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges from the Horn, warfare and disorder will spread across the empire.

translations.literal: A broom star at the Horn, white: warfare.
translations.idiomatic: A broom star appearing at the Horn, if white, portends war.

translations.literal: Red: armies defeated.
translations.idiomatic: If red, armies will suffer defeat.

translations.literal: Entering the Celestial Market: war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters the Celestial Market Enclosure, both war and mourning are foretold.

translations.literal: A meteor trespassing upon it: envoys from foreign states arrive.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor striking the Horn portends the arrival of embassies from foreign lands.

translations.literal: Entering and trespassing upon the left Horn: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters and strikes the left Horn, war will break out.

translations.literal: Yellow-white cloud vapor entering the right Horn: gaining territory.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-white vapors entering the right Horn portend the seizure of territory.

translations.literal: Red entering the left: there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Red vapor entering the left Horn signals the outbreak of war.

translations.literal: Entering the right: victory in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Red vapor entering the right Horn portends victory in battle.

translations.literal: Black-white vapor entering the right: armies and generals will be defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Black-and-white vapors entering the right Horn foretell defeat for armies and their commanders.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以角爲十三度；

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Horn was reckoned at thirteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Yongyuan-era bronze armillary sphere of the Han, the Horn Lodge was measured at thirteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 而唐開元遊儀，角二星十二度。

translations.literal: But in the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary, the two stars of the Horn were twelve degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the Kaiyuan touring armillary of the Tang, however, the two stars of the Horn were reckoned at twelve degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊經去極九十一度，今測九十三度半。

translations.literal: The old classic gave the polar distance as ninety-one degrees; the present measurement is ninety-three and a half degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier texts recorded a polar distance of ninety-one degrees, whereas the present measurement yields ninety-three and a half degrees.

sentences.zh: 距星正當赤道，其黃道在赤道南，不經角中；

translations.literal: The determining star lies directly on the equator; its Yellow Path is south of the equator and does not pass through the center of the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: The determining star lies directly on the celestial equator, while the ecliptic runs south of the equator and does not pass through the center of the Horn.

sentences.zh: 今測角在赤道南二度半，黃道復經角中，即與天象合。

translations.literal: The present measurement places the Horn two and a half degrees south of the equator, and the Yellow Path again passes through the center of the Horn—this accords with the celestial phenomena.
translations.idiomatic: Current observations place the Horn two and a half degrees south of the equator, with the ecliptic once again passing through its center, in agreement with the actual heavens.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，角二星十二度，距南星去極九十七度，在赤道外六度，與《乾象新書》合，今從《新書》爲正。

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey determined the two stars of the Horn at twelve degrees; from the southern star the polar distance was ninety-seven degrees, six degrees outside the equator, agreeing with the New Book of the Supernal Image—today the New Book is taken as authoritative.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey measured the two stars of the Horn at twelve degrees, with the southern star at a polar distance of ninety-seven degrees, six degrees south of the equator, in agreement with the New Book of the Supernal Image; the New Book is now adopted as the standard.

sentences.zh: 南門二星，在庫樓南，天之外門也，主守兵禁。

translations.literal: The Southern Gate has two stars, south of the Arsenal Tower; it is the outer gate of Heaven and governs guarding troops and prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Gate comprises two stars south of the Arsenal Tower; it is the outer gate of Heaven and presides over garrison forces and martial prohibitions.

translations.literal: When the stars are bright, distant regions come to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars shine bright, distant peoples will come bearing tribute.

translations.literal: When dim, the barbarians rebel.
translations.idiomatic: When dim, frontier peoples will rise in rebellion.

translations.literal: If small stars appear among them, armies move.
translations.idiomatic: The appearance of minor stars within them portends military mobilization.

translations.literal: Guest stars or comets stationing there: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: Guest stars or comets halting there foretell the outbreak of war.

sentences.zh: 庫樓十星，六大星庫也，南四星樓也，在角宿南。

translations.literal: The Arsenal Tower has ten stars: six great stars form the arsenal, four southern stars form the tower; it lies south of the Horn Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The Arsenal Tower consists of ten stars—six major stars forming the arsenal and four southern stars forming the tower—located south of the Horn Lodge.

translations.literal: It is also called the Celestial Arsenal, the storehouse of chariots and arms.
translations.idiomatic: It is also known as the Celestial Arsenal, the treasury of war chariots and weapons.

sentences.zh: 旁十五星，三三而聚者柱也，中央四小星衡也。

translations.literal: Fifteen stars beside it, gathered three by three, are the pillars; four small stars in the center are the crossbeam.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen adjacent stars, clustered in groups of three, form the pillars, while four small central stars constitute the crossbeam.

translations.literal: Rayed horns: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars show rayed points, war will break out.

translations.literal: Stars vanishing: subordinates rebel.
translations.idiomatic: If stars disappear, ministers and subordinates will turn rebellious.

translations.literal: Movement: then generals march.
translations.idiomatic: If they shift position, commanders will take the field.

translations.literal: Fullness: auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars appear full and bright, the omen is favorable.

translations.literal: Emptiness: then inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When they appear hollow or faint, the omen is dire.

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing upon it governs armies.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter's encroachment upon the Arsenal Tower portends war.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing upon it: warfare and drought.
translations.idiomatic: Mars's encroachment foretells both war and drought.

translations.literal: The moon entering the Arsenal Tower: warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The moon's entry into the Arsenal Tower portends war.

translations.literal: Comets or broom stars entering: war and famine.
translations.idiomatic: Comets or broom stars entering the lodge foretell war and famine.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: barbarian armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star's entry portends the mobilization of frontier forces.

translations.literal: A meteor entering: all armies deploy.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor entering the lodge signals the full mobilization of military forces.

translations.literal: Red cloud vapor entering: inner and outer realms are unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Red vapors entering the lodge portend unrest within the court and across the borders.

translations.literal: The Celestial Arsenal sprouting horns: there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: When the Celestial Arsenal stars develop rayed points, war will follow.

sentences.zh: 平星二星，在庫樓北，角南，主平天下法獄，廷尉之象。

translations.literal: The Level Stars are two stars, north of the Arsenal Tower and south of the Horn; they govern leveling the law and prisons of the realm—the image of the Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: The Level Stars comprise two stars north of the Arsenal Tower and south of the Horn; they preside over the equitable administration of law and penal affairs throughout the realm, symbolizing the Minister of Justice.

translations.literal: When upright, prison cases are settled.
translations.idiomatic: When properly aligned and bright, legal cases will be adjudicated fairly.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: prison officials worry.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends anxiety among judicial officials.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing upon them: armies rise, and there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Mars's encroachment signals war but also foretells a general pardon.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯，政不行，執法者黜。

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: government does not proceed, and those who enforce the law are dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: A comet's encroachment indicates that policy will not be carried out and judicial officials will be removed from office.

sentences.zh: 平道二星，在角宿間，主平道之官。

translations.literal: The Level Road has two stars, between the stars of the Horn Lodge; it governs officials of the level road.
translations.idiomatic: The Level Road comprises two stars situated between the stars of the Horn Lodge; it presides over officials charged with maintaining the imperial highways.

sentences.zh: 武密曰：「天子八達之衢，主轍軾。

translations.literal: Wu Mi said: "The thoroughfare by which the Son of Heaven reaches in all eight directions—it governs wheel-ruts and carriage shafts."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi wrote: "This is the thoroughfare by which the Son of Heaven reaches in all eight directions; it governs carriage tracks and axles."

translations.literal: Bright and upright: auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: When bright and properly aligned, the omen is favorable.

translations.literal: Trembling: the imperial carriage has cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: Trembling or shifting portends danger to the sovereign's traveling carriage.

translations.literal: Jupiter stationing there: the realm is governed.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter halts there, the empire will be well governed.

translations.literal: Mars or Venus stationing there: disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Mars or Venus halting there portends rebellion and disorder.

translations.literal: A guest star stationing there: the imperial carriage goes forth.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star halting there foretells that the sovereign will travel abroad.

translations.literal: A meteor stationing there: the worthy are dismissed and the treacherous employed.
translations.idiomatic: A meteor halting there portends the dismissal of worthy men and the elevation of treacherous officials.

sentences.zh: 天田二星，在角北，主畿內封域。

translations.literal: The Celestial Field has two stars, north of the Horn; it governs the enclosed domains within the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Field comprises two stars north of the Horn; it presides over the territorial domains within the capital precincts.

translations.literal: Wu Mi said: "The Son of Heaven's ceremonial plowing field."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi identified it as the Son of Heaven's ceremonial plowing field.

translations.literal: Jupiter stationing there: grain ripens.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter halts there, the harvest will be abundant.

translations.literal: Mars stationing there: drought.
translations.idiomatic: Mars halting there portends drought.

translations.literal: Venus stationing there: grain is harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Venus halting there foretells damage to the crops.

translations.literal: Mercury stationing there: water disasters.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury halting there portends flooding and water-related calamities.

translations.literal: A guest star stationing there: drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star halting there foretells drought and locust plagues.

translations.literal: The Heavenly Gate has two stars, north of the Level Stars.
translations.idiomatic: The Heavenly Gate comprises two stars north of the Level Stars.

sentences.zh: 武密云：「在左角南，朝聘待客之所。

translations.literal: Wu Mi said: "South of the left Horn—the place where court audiences and receiving guests are conducted."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi wrote that it lies south of the left Horn and is the place where the court receives envoys and hosts guests.

translations.literal: When the stars are bright, the myriad regions submit and are transformed.
translations.idiomatic: When the stars shine bright, all regions will submit and be brought into civilized order.

translations.literal: When dim, foreign armies arrive.
translations.idiomatic: When dim, hostile forces from beyond the borders will arrive.

translations.literal: A lunar halo outside them: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo appearing outside the Heavenly Gate portends the outbreak of war.

translations.literal: Mars entering: passes and bridges are impassable;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars enters the Heavenly Gate, frontier passes and bridges will be blocked.

translations.literal: Stationing there: loss of propriety.
translations.idiomatic: If it halts there, ritual propriety will be violated.

translations.literal: Venus stationing there: there are ambush troops.
translations.idiomatic: Venus halting there portends troops lying in ambush.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: there is one who plots against the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star crossing the gate signifies a plot against the throne.

sentences.zh: 進賢一星，在平道西，主卿相舉逸材。

translations.literal: Promoting the Worthy is one star, west of the Level Road, governing ministers and chancellors raising outstanding talents.
translations.idiomatic: Promoting the Worthy is a single star west of the Level Road; it governs the elevation of outstanding talent by ministers and chancellors.

translations.literal: When bright, then worthy men are employed;
translations.idiomatic: When bright, worthy men will be employed;

translations.literal: When dim, then wicked ministers advance.
translations.idiomatic: When dim, corrupt ministers will gain advancement.

translations.literal: The moon and Jupiter trespassing it: great ministers die.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon or Jupiter crosses it, great ministers will die.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: it is mourning; worthy men conceal themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossing it portends mourning, and worthy men will withdraw from public life.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing it: the worthy withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossing it foretells the withdrawal of worthy men from office.

sentences.zh: 歲星、太白、填星、辰星合守之，其占爲天子求賢。

translations.literal: Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, and Mercury together stationing there—the omen is the Son of Heaven seeking the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, and Mercury jointly halt there, the omen indicates that the Son of Heaven is seeking worthy men.

sentences.zh: 黃白紫氣貫之，草澤賢人出。

translations.literal: Yellow-white and purple vapors piercing through it: worthy men of the grasslands and marshes emerge.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-white or purple vapors threading through it signify that worthy men dwelling in obscurity will emerge.

sentences.zh: 周鼎三星，在角宿上，主流亡。

translations.literal: The Zhou Tripod has three stars, atop the Horn Lodge, governing the passing of rulers.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou Tripod comprises three stars above the Horn Lodge; they preside over the demise of ruling houses.

translations.literal: When the stars are bright, the state is secure;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars shine bright, the realm will be secure;

translations.literal: If not visible, then fortune is not flourishing;
translations.idiomatic: If they are not visible, dynastic fortune will not flourish;

translations.literal: If they tremble and shift, the state is about to change.
translations.idiomatic: If they tremble and shift, the state is about to undergo transformation.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》引郟鄏定鼎事，以周衰秦無道，鼎淪泗水，其精上爲星。

translations.literal: The New Book of the Supernal Image cites the casting of the tripod at Xie and Ruo, noting that when Zhou declined and Qin ruled without the Way, the tripod sank in the Si River and its essence rose to become stars.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of the Supernal Image cites the casting of the tripod at Xie and Ruo, explaining that when Zhou declined and Qin's rule turned corrupt, the tripod sank in the Si River and its essence rose to become stars.

sentences.zh: 李太異曰：「商巫鹹《星圖》已有周鼎，蓋在秦前數百年矣。」

translations.literal: Li Taiyi said: "The Shang diviner Wu Xian's 《Star Chart》 already had the Zhou Tripod—presumably several hundred years before Qin."
translations.idiomatic: Li Taiyi remarked: "Wu Xian the Shang diviner's 《Star Chart》 already recorded the Zhou Tripod, presumably several centuries before the Qin."

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，庫樓十星，柱十五星，衡四星，平星、平道、天田、天門各二星，進賢一星，周鼎三星，俱屬角宿。

translations.literal: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, Arsenal Tower ten stars, Pillars fifteen stars, Balance four stars, Level Stars, Level Road, Heavenly Field, and Heavenly Gate each two stars, Promoting the Worthy one star, Zhou Tripod three stars—all belong to the Horn Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, the Arsenal Tower has ten stars, the Pillars fifteen, the Balance four, the Level Stars, Level Road, Heavenly Field, and Heavenly Gate two each, Promoting the Worthy one, and the Zhou Tripod three—all assigned to the Horn Lodge.

sentences.zh: 而《晉志》以左角爲天田，別不載天田二星，《隋志》有之。

translations.literal: But the 《Jin Treatise》 takes the left Horn as the Heavenly Field and separately does not record the two Heavenly Field stars; the 《Sui Treatise》 has them.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Jin Treatise》, however, identifies the left Horn as the Heavenly Field and omits the two Heavenly Field stars altogether; the 《Sui Treatise》 includes them.

sentences.zh: 平道、進賢、周鼎，《晉志》皆屬太微垣，庫樓並衡星、柱星、南門、天門、平星皆在二十八宿之外。

translations.literal: Level Road, Promoting the Worthy, and Zhou Tripod—in the 《Jin Treatise》 all belong to the Supreme Palace Enclosure; Arsenal Tower together with Balance stars, Pillar stars, Southern Gate, Heavenly Gate, and Level Stars all lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.
translations.idiomatic: In the 《Jin Treatise》, the Level Road, Promoting the Worthy, and Zhou Tripod all belong to the Supreme Palace Enclosure, while the Arsenal Tower together with the Balance stars, Pillar stars, Southern Gate, Heavenly Gate, and Level Stars all fall outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.

sentences.zh: 唐武密及景祐書乃與《步天歌》合。

translations.literal: Tang Wu Mi and the Jingyou treatise only then accord with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.
translations.idiomatic: Only with Tang Wu Mi and the Jingyou astronomical treatise did the reckoning again accord with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.

sentences.zh: 亢宿四星，爲天子內朝，總攝天下奏事。

translations.literal: The Neck Lodge has four stars; it is the Son of Heaven's inner court, overseeing all memorials from the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The Neck Lodge comprises four stars forming the Son of Heaven's inner court, where all memorials from the realm are received and processed.

translations.literal: Hearing lawsuits, administering prisons, recording merit.
translations.idiomatic: It governs hearing lawsuits, administering prisons, and recording merit.

translations.literal: It is also called the Dispersed Temple; it governs epidemic illness.
translations.idiomatic: It is also known as the Dispersed Temple and presides over epidemic disease.

translations.literal: When the stars are bright and large, assistants are loyal and the people are secure;
translations.idiomatic: When the stars shine bright and large, assistants prove loyal and the people live in security;

translations.literal: If they move, then many illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: if they stir, widespread illness will follow.

translations.literal: It is the Son of Heaven's proper seat and the Heavenly tally.
translations.idiomatic: It marks the Son of Heaven's proper seat and serves as the Heavenly tally.

translations.literal: If not visible at the autumn equinox, grain is harmed and grain prices rise.
translations.idiomatic: If it is not visible at the autumn equinox, the harvest will suffer and grain prices will soar.

sentences.zh: 太陽犯之，諸侯謀國，君憂。

translations.literal: The sun trespassing it: feudal lords plot against the state, the ruler is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When the sun crosses the Neck Lodge, feudal lords will plot against the state and the ruler will be troubled.

sentences.zh: 日暈，其分大臣凶，多雨，民饑、疫。

translations.literal: A solar halo: in its allotted region great ministers suffer misfortune, much rain, the people famine and epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo in its allotted region portends misfortune for great ministers, heavy rains, famine among the people, and epidemic disease.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，君憂或大臣當之；

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: the ruler is troubled or a great minister bears the omen;
translations.idiomatic: When the moon crosses it, the ruler will be troubled or a great minister will bear the omen;

translations.literal: left means water, right means military action.
translations.idiomatic: an appearance on the left portends flooding, on the right, warfare.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: in its allotted region whoever raises troops first prevails;
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo in its allotted region means whoever raises troops first will prevail;

translations.literal: in winter, great men are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: if it occurs in winter, eminent men will suffer distress.

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing it: there is an amnesty, grain has success;
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter crossing it portends an amnesty and a successful harvest;

translations.literal: stationing there: there is warfare, many people fall ill;
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, warfare will arise and many will fall ill;

translations.literal: remaining thirty days or more: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it remains thirty days or longer, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: It is also said: "If it trespasses, then rebellious ministers raise disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Another account states: "If it trespasses, rebellious ministers will stir up disorder.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: dwelling in the yang position, it is joy;
translations.idiomatic: When Mars crosses it, dwelling in the yang sector brings rejoicing;

translations.literal: in yin, it is sorrow;
translations.idiomatic: in the yin sector, sorrow;

translations.literal: if it has rays and horns, great men find it ominous;
translations.idiomatic: if it shows rays and horn-like projections, eminent men will find the omen dire;

sentences.zh: 守之久，民憂，多雨水，又爲兵。

translations.literal: stationing long: the people are troubled, much rain, and again warfare.
translations.idiomatic: a prolonged halt brings popular distress, heavy rains, and warfare as well.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing: grain harmed, people perish;
translations.idiomatic: Saturn crossing it foretells damaged crops and widespread death among the people;

translations.literal: retrograde motion: women hold power exclusively, rebellious ministers plot;
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde, women will dominate government and rebellious ministers will plot;

translations.literal: stationing there: there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, warfare will break out.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing it: the state perishes, the people suffer calamity;
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossing it portends the fall of the state and calamity for the people;

translations.literal: retrograde: military disorder;
translations.idiomatic: if it moves retrograde, military disorder will ensue;

translations.literal: having rays and horns: noble ministers executed;
translations.idiomatic: if it displays rays and horn-like projections, noble ministers will be executed;

translations.literal: stationing there: flood and drought disasters, or mourning.
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, flood or drought will strike, or mourning will descend upon the realm.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯之，爲水，又爲大兵；

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing it: means water, and also great armies;
translations.idiomatic: Mercury crossing it portends flooding and also the mobilization of great armies;

sentences.zh: 守之，米貴，民疾，歲旱，盜起，民相惡。

translations.literal: stationing there: rice is dear, the people ill, the year drought, bandits rise, the people turn on one another.
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, rice will grow costly, the people will sicken, the year will be drought-stricken, bandits will rise, and the populace will turn against one another.

translations.literal: Guest star trespassing: the state is not secure;
translations.idiomatic: A guest star crossing it means the state will be unsettled;

translations.literal: color red means war and drought, yellow means earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: if its color is red, war and drought; if yellow, public earthworks;

translations.literal: green-black: envoys are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if green-black, envoys will suffer distress;

translations.literal: stationing there: grain harmed.
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, the harvest will be harmed.

translations.literal: One version says: there is an amnesty decree;
translations.idiomatic: One account adds that an amnesty decree will be issued;

translations.literal: black: the people disperse in flight.
translations.idiomatic: if black, the people will flee and scatter.

translations.literal: Comet trespassing: state calamity;
translations.idiomatic: A comet crossing it portends calamity for the state;

translations.literal: departing: then water, armies, epidemic, ministers rebel;
translations.idiomatic: when it departs, flooding, armies, epidemic, and ministerial rebellion will follow;

translations.literal: white: mourning.
translations.idiomatic: if white, mourning.

translations.literal: Broom star trespassing: the state endangered, means water, means armies;
translations.idiomatic: A broom star crossing it endangers the state and portends both flooding and warfare;

translations.literal: entering: then the people flee;
translations.idiomatic: when it enters, the people will flee;

translations.literal: departing: then that state suffers famine.
translations.idiomatic: when it departs, that state will suffer famine.

translations.literal: Shooting star entering: foreign envoys arrive, grain ripens;
translations.idiomatic: A shooting star entering portends the arrival of foreign envoys and a ripening harvest;

translations.literal: departing: the Son of Heaven dispatches envoys, an amnesty decree is issued.
translations.idiomatic: when one departs, the Son of Heaven will dispatch envoys and issue an amnesty decree.

sentences.zh: 李淳風曰：「流星入亢，幸臣死。

translations.literal: Li Chunfeng said: "A shooting star entering the Neck: favored ministers die.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chunfeng wrote: "When a shooting star enters the Neck Lodge, favored ministers will die.

translations.literal: Cloud-vapor trespassing it, color blue-green: the people suffer epidemic;
translations.idiomatic: When cloud-vapor crosses it, a blue-green hue portends epidemic among the people;

translations.literal: white: earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: if white, public earthworks;

translations.literal: black: water;
translations.idiomatic: if black, flooding;

translations.literal: red: armies.
translations.idiomatic: if red, warfare.

translations.literal: One version says: white, the people cruelly afflicted with illness;
translations.idiomatic: One account states: if white, the people will suffer cruel epidemic illness;

translations.literal: yellow: earthworks.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, public earthworks.

sentences.zh: 右亢宿四星，漢永元銅儀十度，唐開元遊儀九度。

translations.literal: To the right: the Neck Lodge's four stars—the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary at ten degrees, the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary at nine degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To the right: the Neck Lodge's four stars measured ten degrees on the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary and nine degrees on the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary.

sentences.zh: 舊去極八十九度，今九十一度半。

translations.literal: Formerly eighty-nine degrees from the pole; now ninety-one and a half degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly its distance from the celestial pole was eighty-nine degrees; now it is ninety-one and a half.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，亢九度，距南第二星去極九十五度。

translations.literal: Jingyou observations: Neck nine degrees; from the second star on the south, distance from pole ninety-five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyou-era measurements placed the Neck at nine degrees; from the second southern star, the distance from the pole was ninety-five degrees.

sentences.zh: 大角一星，在攝提間，天王坐也。

translations.literal: Great Horn is one star, between the Leadstars, the seat of the King of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Great Horn is a single star set between the Leadstars, forming the seat of the King of Heaven.

translations.literal: It is also called the Heavenly Ridgepole; it governs rectifying the warp and woof of the cosmos.
translations.idiomatic: It is also known as the Heavenly Ridgepole and presides over setting right the cosmic warp and woof.

translations.literal: Bright, lustrous, and moist: auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: When bright, lustrous, and moist, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: green: sorrow;
translations.idiomatic: if green, sorrow;

translations.literal: red: armies;
translations.idiomatic: if red, warfare;

translations.literal: white: mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if white, mourning;

translations.literal: black: illness;
translations.idiomatic: if black, illness;

translations.literal: color yellow and still: the people secure;
translations.idiomatic: if its color is yellow and it remains still, the people will live in security;

translations.literal: if it moves, then the ruler delights in roaming.
translations.idiomatic: if it stirs, the ruler will take to wandering and pleasure.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，大臣憂，王者惡之。

translations.literal: Moon trespassing it: great ministers troubled, the king finds it ominous.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon crosses it, great ministers will be troubled and the king will find the omen dire.

translations.literal: Lunar halo: in its allotted region the ruler dons mourning garb.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo in its allotted region means the ruler will don mourning garb.

translations.literal: The five planets trespassing it: ministers plot against the ruler, there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets cross it, ministers will plot against the ruler and warfare will arise.

translations.literal: Venus stationing there: warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Venus halting there portends warfare.

sentences.zh: 彗星出，其分主更改，或爲兵。

translations.literal: Comet appearing: in its allotted region the ruler is changed, or there is warfare.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appearing in its allotted region portends a change of ruler or warfare.

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven loses benevolence, it then stations there.
translations.idiomatic: When the Son of Heaven abandons benevolent rule, it will halt there.

translations.literal: Broom star trespassing: warfare;
translations.idiomatic: A broom star crossing it portends warfare;

translations.literal: stationing there: the ruler is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, the ruler will be troubled.

translations.literal: Guest star trespassing or stationing: ministers plot against the sovereign;
translations.idiomatic: A guest star crossing or halting there means ministers are plotting against the sovereign;

translations.literal: departing: then the ruler is constrained by others.
translations.idiomatic: when it departs, the ruler will fall under others' control.

translations.literal: Shooting star entering: the king finds it ominous;
translations.idiomatic: A shooting star entering means the king will find the omen dire;

translations.literal: trespassing it: frontier armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: crossing it portends the rise of frontier armies.

translations.literal: Cloud-vapor green: the ruler is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: Green cloud-vapor means the ruler will be troubled;

translations.literal: white: mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if white, mourning;

translations.literal: yellow vapor emerging: there is joy.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow vapor emerges, rejoicing will follow.

sentences.zh: 折威七星，在亢南，主斬殺，斷軍獄。

translations.literal: Breaking Might has seven stars, south of the Neck Lodge; it governs decapitation and execution, and adjudicating military prisons.
translations.idiomatic: Breaking Might comprises seven stars south of the Neck Lodge; it presides over executions and the severance of military justice.

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: the Son of Heaven is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon crosses it, the Son of Heaven will be troubled.

translations.literal: The five planets trespassing: generals rebel.
translations.idiomatic: When the five planets cross it, generals will rebel.

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing: border generals die.
translations.idiomatic: A comet or broom star crossing it portends death for border generals.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor trespassing, blue-white: military disorder;
translations.idiomatic: Cloud vapor crossing it, if blue-white, foretells military disorder;

translations.literal: red: ministers rebel against the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: if red, ministers will rebel against the ruler;

translations.literal: yellow-white: marriage alliances are made;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white, marriage alliances will be forged;

translations.literal: emerging: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: black vapor entering: the ruler finds it ominous.
translations.idiomatic: if black vapor enters, the ruler will find the omen dire.

sentences.zh: 攝提六星，左右各三，直鬥杓南，主建時節，伺禨祥。

translations.literal: Pacing the Timbers has six stars, three to the left and three to the right, aligned straight south of the Dipper's ladle; it governs establishing the seasonal nodes and watching omens of fortune and calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Pacing the Timbers comprises six stars—three to the left and three to the right—set directly south of the Dipper's ladle; it presides over fixing the seasonal nodes and scanning for omens of fortune and woe.

sentences.zh: 其星爲盾，以夾擁帝坐，主九卿。

translations.literal: Its stars form shields, thereby flanking and embracing the imperial seat; it governs the Nine Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: These stars form shields that flank and embrace the imperial throne and stand for the Nine Ministers.

translations.literal: Stars bright and large: the Three Dukes act willfully, the ruler is weak;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shine bright and large, the Three Dukes grow overbearing and the ruler grows weak;

translations.literal: color warm and not bright: the realm is secure;
translations.idiomatic: if their color is warm and dim, the realm will live in security;

translations.literal: Drawing near Great Horn, drawing near kin there is plotting.
translations.idiomatic: drawing near Great Horn, or drawing near royal kin, conspiracy will take shape.

translations.literal: Great Yin entering: the ruler suffers constraint.
translations.idiomatic: when Great Yin enters, the ruler will fall under another's power.

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse: in its allotted region the ruler finds it ominous.
translations.idiomatic: a lunar eclipse in its allotted region means the ruler will find the omen dire.

sentences.zh: 熒惑、太白守，兵起，天下更主。

translations.literal: Mars and Venus stationing there: warfare arises, the realm changes its ruler.
translations.idiomatic: when Mars and Venus halt there, warfare will arise and the realm will change its ruler.

translations.literal: Comet or broom star entering: the ruler personally leads troops;
translations.idiomatic: if a comet or broom star enters, the ruler will take the field in person;

translations.literal: emerging: the ruler suffers constraint.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, the ruler will fall under constraint.

translations.literal: Shooting star entering: there is warfare;
translations.idiomatic: a shooting star entering portends warfare;

translations.literal: emerging: envoys are sent forth;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, envoys will be dispatched;

translations.literal: Trespassing it: dukes and ministers are unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: whoever crosses it will leave dukes and ministers ill at ease.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor entering, red: warfare, the Nine Ministers troubled;
translations.idiomatic: red cloud vapor entering foretells warfare and distress for the Nine Ministers;

translations.literal: color yellow: rejoicing;
translations.idiomatic: if its color is yellow, rejoicing will follow;

translations.literal: black: great ministers executed.
translations.idiomatic: if black, great ministers will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 陽門二星，在庫樓東北，主守隘塞，禦外寇。

translations.literal: Solar Gate has two stars, northeast of the Arsenal Tower; it governs guarding passes and barriers, repelling foreign invaders.
translations.idiomatic: Solar Gate comprises two stars northeast of the Arsenal Tower; it presides over guarding mountain passes and repelling invaders from beyond the borders.

translations.literal: The five planets entering: the five weapons are stored away.
translations.idiomatic: when the five planets enter, the five weapons will be laid away and peace restored.

sentences.zh: 彗星守之，外夷犯塞、兵起。

translations.literal: A comet stationing there: outer barbarians invade the passes, warfare arises.
translations.idiomatic: a comet halting there portends invasion of the passes by outer tribes and the outbreak of war.

translations.literal: Red cloud vapor entering: the ruler deploys troops.
translations.idiomatic: red cloud vapor entering means the ruler will take up arms.

sentences.zh: 頓頑二星，在折威東南，主考囚情狀，察詐偽也。

translations.literal: Slow Stubborn has two stars, southeast of Breaking Might; it governs examining prisoners' circumstances and detecting fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Slow Stubborn comprises two stars southeast of Breaking Might; it presides over reviewing prisoners' cases and exposing deceit.

translations.literal: Stars bright: no blame;
translations.idiomatic: when the stars shine bright, no blame attaches;

translations.literal: dim: then punishments are excessive.
translations.idiomatic: if dim, punishments will run to excess.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing it: nobles imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: a comet crossing it portends imprisonment for the nobility.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，大角一星，折威七星，左、右攝提總六星，頓頑、陽門各二星，俱屬角宿。

translations.literal: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, Great Horn one star, Breaking Might seven stars, left and right Pacing the Timbers six stars in all, Slow Stubborn and Solar Gate two stars each—all belong to the Horn Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, Great Horn has one star, Breaking Might seven, the left and right Pacing the Timbers six in all, Slow Stubborn and Solar Gate two each—all assigned to the Horn Lodge.

sentences.zh: 而《晉志》以大角、攝提屬太微垣，折威、頓頑在二十八宿之外。

translations.literal: But the 《Jin Treatise》 assigns Great Horn and Pacing the Timbers to the Supreme Palace Enclosure; Breaking Might and Slow Stubborn lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Jin Treatise》, however, assigns Great Horn and Pacing the Timbers to the Supreme Palace Enclosure, while Breaking Might and Slow Stubborn fall outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.

sentences.zh: 陽門則見於《隋志》，而《晉史》不載。

translations.literal: Solar Gate appears in the 《Sui Treatise》, while the 《Jin History》 does not record it.
translations.idiomatic: Solar Gate appears in the 《Sui Treatise》, but the 《Jin History》 omits it altogether.

sentences.zh: 武密書以攝提、折威、陽門皆屬角、亢。

translations.literal: Wu Mi's treatise assigns Pacing the Timbers, Breaking Might, and Solar Gate all to the Horn and Neck.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi's treatise assigns Pacing the Timbers, Breaking Might, and Solar Gate alike to the Horn and Neck Lodges.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以右攝提屬角，左攝提屬亢，余與武密書同。

translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns the right Pacing the Timbers to the Horn, the left Pacing the Timbers to the Neck; the rest agrees with Wu Mi's treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns the right Pacing the Timbers to the Horn Lodge and the left to the Neck Lodge; on all else it agrees with Wu Mi's treatise.

sentences.zh: 《景祐》測驗，乃以大角、攝提、頓頑、陽門皆屬於亢，其說不同。

translations.literal: The 《Jingyou》 survey measurements assign Great Horn, Pacing the Timbers, Slow Stubborn, and Solar Gate all to the Neck—the accounts differ.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Jingyou》 survey measurements, however, assign Great Horn, Pacing the Timbers, Slow Stubborn, and Solar Gate all to the Neck Lodge, so the reckonings do not agree.

sentences.zh: 氐宿四星，爲天子舍室，後妃之府，休解之房。

translations.literal: The Root Lodge has four stars; it is the Son of Heaven's lodging chamber, the consorts' palace, the chamber of rest and release.
translations.idiomatic: The Root Lodge comprises four stars forming the Son of Heaven's lodging chamber, the consorts' palace, and the chamber of rest and release.

translations.literal: The front two stars: the primary consort;
translations.idiomatic: the front two stars represent the primary consort;

translations.literal: The rear two stars: concubines.
translations.idiomatic: the rear two represent concubines.

translations.literal: It is also the Heavenly Root, governing epidemic illness.
translations.idiomatic: It is also known as the Heavenly Root and presides over epidemic disease.

sentences.zh: 後二星大，則臣奉度，主安；

translations.literal: Rear two stars large: ministers observe propriety, the ruler is secure;
translations.idiomatic: when the rear two stars shine large, ministers will observe propriety and the ruler will live in security;

translations.literal: small: ministers lose power;
translations.idiomatic: if small, ministers will lose their standing;

translations.literal: If they stir: corvée labor arises.
translations.idiomatic: if they stir, corvée labor will be imposed.

sentences.zh: 日食，其分，卿相有讒諛，一曰王者後妃惡之，大臣憂。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse in its allotted region: ministers and chancellors face slander and flattery; one account says the king and consorts find it ominous, great ministers troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in its allotted region portends slander and flattery against ministers and chancellors; one account says the sovereign and consorts will find the omen dire and great ministers will be troubled.

sentences.zh: 日暈，女主恣，一曰國有憂，日下興師。

translations.literal: Solar halo: the empress acts willfully; one account says the state has distress, troops raised below the sun.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo means the empress will act without restraint; one account says the state will suffer distress and armies will be raised beneath the sun.

sentences.zh: 月食其宿，大臣凶，後妃惡之，一曰糴貴。

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse at its lodge: great ministers suffer misfortune, consorts find it ominous; one account says grain prices rise.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse at this lodge portends misfortune for great ministers and dire omens for consorts; one account says grain prices will soar.

translations.literal: Lunar halo: great generals suffer misfortune, epidemic among the people;
translations.idiomatic: a lunar halo portends misfortune for great generals and epidemic disease among the people;

sentences.zh: 在冬，爲水，主危，以赦解之。

translations.literal: in winter: water [omen], the ruler in peril, resolved by amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: if it occurs in winter, the omen is water and the ruler will stand in peril, to be resolved by an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 月犯，左右郎將有誅，一曰有兵、盜。

translations.literal: Moon trespassing: left and right commandants of the guard face execution; one account says warfare and banditry.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon crosses it, the left and right commandants of the guard will face execution; one account says warfare and banditry will follow.

translations.literal: Trespassing the right star: water [omen];
translations.idiomatic: crossing the right star portends flooding;

translations.literal: Occulting it: conspiracy, generals bear the omen.
translations.idiomatic: occulting it foretells conspiracy, which generals will bear.

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing: there is an amnesty, or an empress is installed;
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter crossing it portends an amnesty or the installation of an empress;

translations.literal: Stationing there: earthquake, a bountiful year;
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, the earth will quake and the year will prove abundant;

translations.literal: Retrograde motion: warfare.
translations.idiomatic: retrograde motion portends warfare.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，臣僭上，一云將軍憂；

translations.literal: Mars trespassing it: ministers overstep the ruler; one account says generals are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossing it means ministers will overstep the ruler; one account says generals will suffer distress;

translations.literal: Stationing: there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, an amnesty will be proclaimed.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing: left and right commandants of the guard face execution;
translations.idiomatic: Saturn crossing it portends execution for the left and right commandants of the guard;

translations.literal: Stationing there: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, an amnesty will follow;

translations.literal: Color yellow: consorts rejoice, or the crown prince is invested;
translations.idiomatic: if its color is yellow, consorts will rejoice or the crown prince will be invested;

translations.literal: Lingering: warfare throughout the realm;
translations.idiomatic: if it lingers, warfare will spread across the realm;

translations.literal: Evenly bright: amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: if evenly bright, an amnesty will be granted.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing it: commandants of the guard executed;
translations.idiomatic: Venus crossing it portends execution for the commandants of the guard;

translations.literal: Entering its allotted region: epidemic illness;
translations.idiomatic: entering its allotted region foretells epidemic disease;

translations.literal: Or it is said trespassing it: appointing generals;
translations.idiomatic: another account says crossing it portends the appointment of generals;

translations.literal: Riding the right star: flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: riding the right star portends flood disaster.

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: noble ministers sudden distress;
translations.idiomatic: Mercury crossing it brings sudden distress to noble ministers;

translations.literal: Stationing there: water, drought, warfare;
translations.idiomatic: if it halts there, flooding, drought, or warfare will follow;

translations.literal: Entering and stationing: nobles imprisoned;
translations.idiomatic: entering and halting there portends imprisonment for the nobility;

translations.literal: Riding the left star: the Son of Heaven leads troops personally.
translations.idiomatic: riding the left star means the Son of Heaven will take command in person.

translations.literal: Guest star trespassing: cattle and horses costly;
translations.idiomatic: a guest star crossing it portends dear prices for cattle and horses;

sentences.zh: 色黃白，爲喜，有赦，或曰邊兵起，後宮亂；

translations.literal: Color yellow-white: rejoicing, amnesty; or it is said border armies arise, inner palace disorder;
translations.idiomatic: if its color is yellow-white, rejoicing and amnesty will follow; another account says border armies will rise and the inner palace fall into disorder;

translations.literal: Not departing for fifty days: assassins.
translations.idiomatic: if it does not depart within fifty days, assassins will appear.

translations.literal: Comet trespassing: great amnesty, grain prices rise;
translations.idiomatic: a comet crossing it portends a great amnesty and soaring grain prices;

translations.literal: Extinguished: great epidemic;
translations.idiomatic: if it is extinguished, a great epidemic will follow;

translations.literal: Entering: minor warfare; one account says the ruler is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: entering portends minor warfare; one account says the ruler will be unsettled.

translations.literal: Broom star trespassing: grain prices rise;
translations.idiomatic: a broom star crossing it portends soaring grain prices;

translations.literal: Emerging: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: Entering: minor warfare;
translations.idiomatic: entering portends minor warfare;

translations.literal: Or it is said trespassing it: ministers overawe the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: another account says crossing it means ministers will overawe the ruler.

translations.literal: Shooting star trespassing: Secretariat officials have troubles;
translations.idiomatic: a shooting star crossing it portends trouble for Secretariat officials;

translations.literal: In winter or summer: flood and drought;
translations.idiomatic: if it appears in winter or summer, flooding or drought will follow;

translations.literal: The Yisi Occupations: the inner palace has cause for joy;
translations.idiomatic: According to the Yisi Occupations, the inner palace will have cause for rejoicing;

translations.literal: Color red-black: the inner palace is unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: if its color is red-black, the inner palace will fall into unrest.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor entering: yellow means earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: cloud vapor entering, if yellow, foretells earthworks;

translations.literal: black governs water;
translations.idiomatic: if black, it governs water;

translations.literal: red means armies;
translations.idiomatic: if red, armies will march;

translations.literal: blue-white means epidemic illness;
translations.idiomatic: if blue-white, epidemic disease will spread;

translations.literal: white: the inner palace is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: if white, the inner palace will suffer distress.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀、唐開元遊儀，氐宿十六度，去極九十四度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary and the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary, the Root Lodge sixteen degrees, polar distance ninety-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary and the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary, the Root Lodge was measured at sixteen degrees with a polar distance of ninety-four degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗與《乾象新書》皆九十八度。

translations.literal: The Jingyou survey and the 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 both give ninety-eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Both the Jingyou survey and the 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 place it at ninety-eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 天乳一星，在氐東北，當赤道中。

translations.literal: Heavenly Milk is one star, northeast of the Root Lodge, on the equator.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Milk is a single star northeast of the Root Lodge, lying on the equator.

translations.literal: Bright: then sweet dew descends.
translations.idiomatic: when bright, sweet dew will descend.

translations.literal: Comet or guest star entering: heaven rains.
translations.idiomatic: a comet or guest star entering portends rain from heaven.

sentences.zh: 將軍一星，騎將也，在騎官東南，總領車騎軍將、部陣行列。

translations.literal: General is one star, the cavalry commander; it lies southeast of the Cavalry Officer, overall command of chariot-and-cavalry generals and the ordering of ranks and formations.
translations.idiomatic: General is a single star representing the cavalry commander, southeast of the Cavalry Officer; it presides over chariot-and-cavalry generals and the deployment of ranks and battle lines.

translations.literal: Color stirring and shaking: armies march abroad.
translations.idiomatic: if its color stirs and shakes, armies will march beyond the borders.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑、客星犯之，大兵出，天下亂。

translations.literal: Venus, Mars, or a guest star trespassing it: great armies march forth, the realm falls into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Venus, Mars, or a guest star crossing it portends the march of great armies and chaos across the realm.

sentences.zh: 招搖一星，在梗河北，主北兵。

translations.literal: Swaying Spear is one star, north of the Geng River; it governs northern armies.
translations.idiomatic: Swaying Spear is a single star north of the Geng River; it presides over armies of the north.

translations.literal: Rays and horns, or change and movement: then armies march on a great scale;
translations.idiomatic: If it shows rays and horns, or shifts and changes, armies will march on a great scale;

translations.literal: If bright: armies arise;
translations.idiomatic: If it shines bright, war will break out;

sentences.zh: 若與棟星、梗河、北斗相直，則北方當來受命中國。

translations.literal: If it aligns with Ridge Star, the Geng River, and the Northern Dipper, then the north will come to receive the Mandate in the Central State.
translations.idiomatic: If it stands in alignment with Ridge Star, the Geng River, and the Northern Dipper, the north will come to receive the Mandate within the Central State.

translations.literal: Further prognostication: if it moves, close ministers grow unrestrained;
translations.idiomatic: Further prognostication: if it stirs, close ministers will grow unrestrained;

translations.literal: If it leaves its station: arsenal troops are deployed;
translations.idiomatic: If it leaves its station, troops from the arsenal will be deployed;

translations.literal: Color green: means sorrow;
translations.idiomatic: If its color is green, sorrow is foretold;

translations.literal: white: means the ruler's anger;
translations.idiomatic: If white, the ruler will be angry;

translations.literal: red: means armies;
translations.idiomatic: If red, armies will march;

translations.literal: black: means armies defeated;
translations.idiomatic: If black, armies will be broken;

translations.literal: yellow: then the realm is secure.
translations.idiomatic: If yellow, the realm will be secure.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: northern border armies stir;
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, armies on the northern border will stir;

translations.literal: If it emerges: in its allotted region barbarian armies rise greatly.
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, barbarian armies will rise greatly in its allotted region.

translations.literal: A broom star trespassing: barbarians fall into turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star trespasses it, barbarians will fall into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 客星出，蠻夷來貢，一云北地有兵、喪。

translations.literal: A guest star appearing: barbarians come to offer tribute; one account says the northern regions will have war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star appears, barbarians will come to offer tribute; one account says the northern regions will see war and mourning.

translations.literal: A shooting star appearing: there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star appears, armies will take the field.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor trespassing, color yellow-white: mutual death;
translations.idiomatic: If cloud vapor trespasses it and its color is yellow-white, mutual slaughter is foretold;

translations.literal: red: means internal armies in turmoil;
translations.idiomatic: If red, internal armies will fall into turmoil;

translations.literal: color yellow: armies cease;
translations.idiomatic: If its color is yellow, armies will stand down;

translations.literal: white: great men are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If white, great men will suffer distress.

sentences.zh: 帝席三星，在大角北，主宴獻酬酢。

translations.literal: Imperial Mat has three stars, north of Great Horn; it governs banquets, offerings, and toasts exchanged in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Mat comprises three stars north of Great Horn; it presides over banquets, offerings, and the exchange of toasts.

translations.literal: Stars bright: princes and dukes suffer calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars shine bright, princes and dukes will suffer calamity;

translations.literal: dim: the realm is secure;
translations.idiomatic: If dim, the realm will be secure;

translations.literal: stars perish: great men lose their positions;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars vanish, great men will lose their positions;

translations.literal: trembling and shifting: the ruler is imperiled.
translations.idiomatic: If they tremble and shift, the ruler will be imperiled.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: the ruler is troubled; there are rebellious armies.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, the ruler will be troubled and rebellious armies will arise.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: the ruler is imperiled.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses it, the ruler will be imperiled.

translations.literal: Neck Pool has six stars, north of the Neck Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Neck Pool comprises six stars north of the Neck Lodge.

translations.literal: Neck means a boat;
translations.idiomatic: Neck signifies a boat;

translations.literal: pool means water.
translations.idiomatic: pool signifies water.

translations.literal: It governs crossing water and coming and going in welcome and farewell.
translations.idiomatic: It presides over crossing waters and the comings and goings of welcome and farewell.

translations.literal: Faint and fine: inauspicious;
translations.idiomatic: If faint and fine, the omen is inauspicious;

translations.literal: if scattered: the realm is not connected;
translations.idiomatic: If scattered, communications across the realm will be cut off;

sentences.zh: 移徙不居其度中，則宗廟有怪。

translations.literal: Shifting and not dwelling within its proper degree: then the ancestral temples have strangeness.
translations.idiomatic: If they shift and no longer dwell within their proper degree, the ancestral temples will suffer portents.

translations.literal: The Five Planets trespassing it: rivers overflow.
translations.idiomatic: If the Five Planets trespass it, rivers will overflow their banks.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: water; insects die in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses it, there will be floods and insects will die in great numbers.

sentences.zh: 武密云：「主斷軍獄，掌棄市殺戮。

translations.literal: Wu Mi's treatise says: "It governs adjudicating military prisons and presides over marketplace executions and slaughter."
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi's treatise states: "It governs the adjudication of military prisons and presides over marketplace executions and slaughter."

translations.literal: "—a view differing from the old histories.
translations.idiomatic: —a view that differs from the older histories.

sentences.zh: 騎官二十七星，在氐南，天子虎賁也，主宿衛。

translations.literal: Riding Guards has twenty-seven stars, south of the Root Lodge; they are the Son of Heaven's tiger guards and govern night watch.
translations.idiomatic: Riding Guards comprises twenty-seven stars south of the Root Lodge; they are the Son of Heaven's tiger guards and preside over palace watch.

translations.literal: Stars numerous: the realm is secure;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars are numerous, the realm will be secure;

translations.literal: sparse: then cavalry rebel;
translations.idiomatic: If sparse, the cavalry will rebel;

translations.literal: not visible: armies arise.
translations.idiomatic: If they are not visible, armies will arise.

translations.literal: The Five Planets trespassing: means armies.
translations.idiomatic: If the Five Planets trespass it, armies will take the field.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，將出有憂，士卒發。

translations.literal: A guest star dwelling on it: the general setting out has troubles; soldiers are mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star dwells upon it, the general who sets out will face trouble and troops will be mobilized.

sentences.zh: 流星入，兵起，色蒼白，將死。

translations.literal: A shooting star entering: armies arise; color blue-white, the general dies.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star enters it, armies will arise; if its color is blue-white, the general will die.

sentences.zh: 梗河三星，在帝席北，天矛也。

translations.literal: The Geng River has three stars, north of Imperial Mat; it is the Heavenly Spear.
translations.idiomatic: The Geng River comprises three stars north of Imperial Mat; it is the Heavenly Spear.

sentences.zh: 一曰天鋒，主北邊兵，又主喪，故其變動應以兵、喪。

translations.literal: It is also called the Heavenly Point; it governs northern border armies and also governs mourning, so its changes respond with armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: It is also called the Heavenly Point; it presides over armies of the northern border and also over mourning, so its changes correspond to war and mourning.

translations.literal: Stars perish: the state has military plotting.
translations.idiomatic: If the stars vanish, the state will harbor military plots.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing it: northern armies are defeated.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, northern armies will be defeated.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: armies march forth; yin and yang are not in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters it, armies will march forth and yin and yang will fall out of harmony.

translations.literal: One account says northern armies invade the Central State.
translations.idiomatic: One account says northern armies will invade the Central State.

translations.literal: A shooting star appearing: means armies.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star appears, armies will take the field.

translations.literal: Red cloud vapor trespassing: armies defeated;
translations.idiomatic: If red cloud vapor trespasses it, armies will be defeated;

translations.literal: blue-white: the general dies.
translations.idiomatic: If blue-white, the general will die.

sentences.zh: 車騎三星，在騎官南，總車騎將，主部陣行列。

translations.literal: Chariot and Cavalry has three stars, south of Riding Guards; it commands the chariot-and-cavalry generals and governs arranging formations and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot and Cavalry comprises three stars south of Riding Guards; it commands the chariot-and-cavalry generals and presides over arranging formations and ranks.

translations.literal: Changing color and trembling: then armies march.
translations.idiomatic: If its color changes and it trembles, armies will march.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑、客星犯之，大兵出，天下亂。

translations.literal: Venus, Mars, or a guest star trespassing it: great armies march forth, the realm falls into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus, Mars, or a guest star trespasses it, great armies will march forth and the realm will fall into chaos.

sentences.zh: 陣車三星，在氐南，一云在騎官東北，革車也。

translations.literal: Formation Chariot has three stars, south of the Root Lodge; one account says northeast of Riding Guards; it is the leather chariot.
translations.idiomatic: Formation Chariot comprises three stars south of the Root Lodge; one account places it northeast of Riding Guards; it represents the leather war chariot.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑守之，主車騎滿野，內兵無禁。

translations.literal: Venus or Mars dwelling on it: chariots and cavalry fill the fields; internal armies are unchecked.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus or Mars dwells upon it, chariots and cavalry will fill the countryside and internal armies will go unchecked.

sentences.zh: 天輻二星，在房西斜列，主乘輿，若《周官》巾車官也。

translations.literal: Celestial Spokes has two stars, slanting in array west of the Room Lodge; it governs the imperial carriage, like the Chariot Office in the Offices of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial Spokes comprises two stars arrayed obliquely west of the Room Lodge; it presides over the imperial carriage, analogous to the Chariot Office in the Offices of Zhou.

translations.literal: Drawing near the Tail: the realm has blessing.
translations.idiomatic: If it draws near the Tail Lodge, the realm will enjoy blessing.

sentences.zh: 五星、客、彗犯之，則輦轂有變。

translations.literal: The Five Planets, a guest star, or a comet trespassing it: then the imperial equipage has change.
translations.idiomatic: If the Five Planets, a guest star, or a comet trespasses it, the imperial equipage will suffer change.

translations.literal: It is also written as Heavenly Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: It is also written as Heavenly Blessing.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，已上諸星俱屬氐宿。

translations.literal: According to the Book of the Pace of Heaven, all the stars above belong to the Root Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Book of the Pace of Heaven, all the stars named above belong to the Root Lodge.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以帝席屬角，亢池屬亢；

translations.literal: The New Book of the Supernal Image assigns Imperial Mat to the Horn and Neck Pool to the Neck;
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of the Supernal Image assigns Imperial Mat to the Horn Lodge and Neck Pool to the Neck Lodge;

sentences.zh: 武密與《步在歌》合，皆屬氐，而以梗河屬亢。

translations.literal: Wu Mi agrees with the Book of the Pace of Heaven that all belong to the Root, but assigns the Geng River to the Neck.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi agrees with the Book of the Pace of Heaven in assigning them all to the Root Lodge, but assigns the Geng River to the Neck Lodge.

sentences.zh: 《占天錄》又以陣車屬於亢，《乾象新書》屬氐，餘皆與《步天歌》合。

translations.literal: The Records of Observing Heaven again assigns Formation Chariot to the Neck; the New Book of the Supernal Image assigns it to the Root; on all else they accord with the Book of the Pace of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Records of Observing Heaven again assigns Formation Chariot to the Neck Lodge, while the New Book of the Supernal Image assigns it to the Root Lodge; on all else they accord with the Book of the Pace of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 房宿四星，爲明堂，天子布政之官也，亦四輔也。

translations.literal: The Room Lodge has four stars; it is the Bright Hall, the Son of Heaven's office for promulgating government, and also the Four Supports.
translations.idiomatic: The Room Lodge comprises four stars forming the Bright Hall, the Son of Heaven's office for promulgating government, and also the Four Supports.

translations.literal: The lower first star: the chief general;
translations.idiomatic: The lower first star is the chief general;

translations.literal: the next: the second general;
translations.idiomatic: the next, the second general;

translations.literal: the next: the second chancellor;
translations.idiomatic: the next, the second chancellor;

translations.literal: the upper star: the chief chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: the upper star is the chief chancellor.

sentences.zh: 南二星君位，北二星夫人位。

translations.literal: The southern two stars are the ruler's station; the northern two are the consort's station.
translations.idiomatic: The southern two stars mark the ruler's station; the northern two mark the consort's station.

sentences.zh: 又爲四表，中爲天衢、爲天關，黃道之所經也。

translations.literal: It is also the Four Markers; within is the Heavenly Crossroads and the Heavenly Gate, where the Yellow Path passes.
translations.idiomatic: It also serves as the Four Markers; within lie the Heavenly Crossroads and the Heavenly Gate, along which the ecliptic runs.

sentences.zh: 南間曰陽環，其南曰太陽；

translations.literal: The southern gap is called the Yang Ring; south of it is the Great Yang;
translations.idiomatic: The southern gap is called the Yang Ring; south of it lies the Great Yang;

sentences.zh: 北間曰陰環，其北曰太陰。

translations.literal: the northern gap is called the Yin Ring; north of it is the Great Yin.
translations.idiomatic: the northern gap is called the Yin Ring; north of it lies the Great Yin.

sentences.zh: 七曜由乎天衢，則天下和平，由陽道，則旱、喪；

translations.literal: If the Seven Luminaries pass by the Heavenly Crossroads, the realm is at peace; if by the yang path, then drought and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: If the Seven Luminaries pass through the Heavenly Crossroads, the realm will be at peace; if by the yang path, drought and mourning will follow;

translations.literal: if by the yin path, then flood and armies.
translations.idiomatic: if by the yin path, floods and armies will follow.

sentences.zh: 亦曰天駟，爲天馬，主車駕。

translations.literal: It is also called the Heavenly Team of Four; it is the Heavenly Horse and governs the ruler's chariot equipage.
translations.idiomatic: It is also called the Heavenly Team of Four, identified with the Heavenly Horse, and presides over the ruler's chariot equipage.

sentences.zh: 南星曰左驂，次左服，次右服，次右驂。

translations.literal: The southern star is called the left outrigger; next the left shaft-horse; next the right shaft-horse; next the right outrigger.
translations.idiomatic: The southern star is the left outrigger; next comes the left shaft-horse, then the right shaft-horse, then the right outrigger.

translations.literal: It is also called the Heavenly Stable.
translations.idiomatic: It is also called the Heavenly Stable.

sentences.zh: 又主開閉，爲畜藏之所由。

translations.literal: It also governs opening and closing, the source from which livestock and stores are kept.
translations.idiomatic: It also presides over opening and closing—the gateway through which livestock and stores are gathered.

translations.literal: Stars bright: then the king is enlightened;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars shine bright, the sovereign will be enlightened;

translations.literal: outrigger stars large: then armies arise;
translations.idiomatic: If the outrigger stars grow large, armies will arise;

translations.literal: if separated: the people scatter;
translations.idiomatic: If they separate, the people will scatter;

sentences.zh: 左驂、服亡，則東南方不可舉兵；

translations.literal: left outrigger and shaft-horses perish: then in the southeast one must not raise armies;
translations.idiomatic: If the left outrigger and shaft-horses vanish, armies must not be raised in the southeast;

translations.literal: right perish: then in the northwest one must not raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: If the right vanish, armies must not be raised in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 日食，其分爲兵，大臣專權。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse: in its allotted region armies; great ministers monopolize power.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in its allotted region portends armies and great ministers monopolizing power.

sentences.zh: 日暈，亦爲兵，君臣失政，女主憂。

translations.literal: Solar halo: also means armies; ruler and ministers lose government, the chief consort is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo likewise portends armies, misgovernment by ruler and ministers, and distress for the chief consort.

sentences.zh: 月食其宿，大臣憂，又爲王者昏，大臣專政。

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse at its lodge: great ministers are troubled; it also means the king grows dim, great ministers monopolize government.
