translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse at this lodge portends trouble for great ministers, the king growing dim, and great ministers monopolizing government.

translations.literal: Lunar halo: means armies;
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends armies;

sentences.zh: 三宿，主赦，及五舍不出百日赦。

translations.literal: three lodges: governs amnesty; and within five lodges no amnesty within a hundred days.
translations.idiomatic: Three lodges preside over amnesty; and if amnesty is not proclaimed within five lodges, it will come within a hundred days.

translations.literal: Great Yin trespassing the yang path: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If Great Yin trespasses the yang path, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: the yin path: means rain;
translations.idiomatic: If by the yin path, rain will follow;

translations.literal: the central path: the year is abundant.
translations.idiomatic: If by the central path, the year will be abundant.

translations.literal: Further prognostication: the chief general is executed.
translations.idiomatic: Further prognostication: the chief general will be executed.

translations.literal: When aligned with the Heavenly Gate and Heavenly Team of Four: grain ripens.
translations.idiomatic: When aligned with the Heavenly Gate and the Heavenly Team of Four, grain will ripen.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，更政令，又爲兵，爲饑，民流；

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing it: government orders are changed; it also means armies, famine, and the people scatter;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter trespasses it, government orders will be changed; it also portends armies, famine, and the scattering of the people;

sentences.zh: 守之，大赦，天下和平，一云良馬出。

translations.literal: dwelling on it: great amnesty, the realm at peace; one account says fine horses appear.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, a great amnesty will be proclaimed and the realm will be at peace; one account says fine horses will appear.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: horses are costly, the ruler is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, horses will grow costly and the ruler will be troubled;

translations.literal: color green: means mourning;
translations.idiomatic: If its color is green, mourning is foretold;

translations.literal: red: means armies;
translations.idiomatic: If red, armies will march;

translations.literal: black: generals and chancellors suffer calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If black, generals and chancellors will suffer calamity;

translations.literal: white rays: fire calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If it shows white rays, fire calamity will follow;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: there is an amnesty decree;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, an amnesty decree will be issued;

translations.literal: If for ten days it forms the coiled-serpent aspect, ministers rebel.
translations.idiomatic: If for ten days it forms the coiled-serpent aspect, ministers will rebel.

sentences.zh: 填星犯之，女主憂，勾巳，相有誅；

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing it: the chief consort is troubled; coiled-serpent aspect, a chancellor is executed;
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn trespasses it, the chief consort will be troubled; if it forms the coiled-serpent aspect, a chancellor will be executed;

sentences.zh: 守之，土功興，一曰旱、兵，一曰有赦令。

translations.literal: dwelling on it: earthworks arise; one account says drought and armies; one account says there is an amnesty decree.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, earthworks will be undertaken; one account says drought and armies; one account says an amnesty decree will be issued.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing: the four borders join in alliance;
translations.idiomatic: If Venus trespasses it, the four borders will join in alliance;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: means earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, earthworks will be undertaken;

translations.literal: entering and exiting: frost and rain are untimely.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters and exits, frost and rain will come untimely.

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: there is calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury trespasses it, calamity will strike;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: flood calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, floods will follow.

translations.literal: One account says northern armies arise and the general rebels.
translations.idiomatic: One account says northern armies will arise and the general will rebel.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing, crossing the yang path: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses it and crosses the yang path, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: the yin path: means water; the state is emptied, the people famished;
translations.idiomatic: If by the yin path, floods will follow, the state will be emptied, and the people will go hungry;

translations.literal: color white: there is attack and battle;
translations.idiomatic: If its color is white, attack and battle will follow;

translations.literal: entering: means grain prices are dear.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, grain prices will soar.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯，國危，人亂，其分惡之。

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: the state is imperiled, the people fall into turmoil; its allotted region finds it dire.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, the state will be imperiled and the people will fall into turmoil; its allotted region will find the omen dire.

translations.literal: A broom star trespassing: there are armies, the people famished, national calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star trespasses it, armies will arise, the people will go hungry, and the state will suffer calamity.

sentences.zh: 流星犯之，在春夏，爲土功；

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing it: in spring and summer, means earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star trespasses it, in spring and summer earthworks will be undertaken;

translations.literal: in autumn and winter, chancellors are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: in autumn and winter, chancellors will be troubled;

translations.literal: entering: there is mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, mourning will follow.

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》：出，其分天子恤民，下德令。

translations.literal: The Prognostications of the Yisi Cycle: emerging, in its allotted region the Son of Heaven shows compassion for the people and issues virtuous decrees.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Prognostications of the Yisi Cycle, if it emerges, in its allotted region the Son of Heaven will show compassion for the people and issue virtuous decrees.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor entering, red-yellow: auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: If cloud vapor enters and its color is red-yellow, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: like a human form, with a child behind;
translations.idiomatic: if shaped like a human form with a child behind;

translations.literal: color red: the palace falls into turmoil;
translations.idiomatic: if its color is red, the palace will fall into turmoil;

translations.literal: blue-white vapor emerging: generals and chancellors are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If blue-white vapor emerges, generals and chancellors will be troubled.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀、唐開元游儀，房宿五度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary and the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary, the Room Lodge five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary and the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary, the Room Lodge was measured at five degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極百八度，今百十度半。

translations.literal: Formerly polar distance one hundred eight degrees; now one hundred ten and a half degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Its former polar distance was one hundred eight degrees; now it is one hundred ten and a half degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，房距南第二星去極百十五度，在赤道外二十三度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: the Room Lodge from its second southern star polar distance one hundred fifteen degrees, twenty-three degrees south of the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey measurements reckoned the Room Lodge's second southern star at a polar distance of one hundred fifteen degrees, twenty-three degrees south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》在赤道外二十四度。

translations.literal: The New Book of the Supernal Image places it twenty-four degrees south of the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of the Supernal Image places it twenty-four degrees south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 鍵閉一星，在房東北，主關籥。

translations.literal: Lock and Bolt is one star, northeast of the Room Lodge; it governs gates and locks.
translations.idiomatic: Lock and Bolt is a single star northeast of the Room Lodge; it presides over gates and locks.

translations.literal: bright: auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: If bright, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: dim: then palace gates are not barred.
translations.idiomatic: If dim, the palace gates will not be barred.

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: great ministers are troubled; fire calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, great ministers will be troubled and fire calamity will follow.

translations.literal: Jupiter dwelling on it: the king should not go forth.
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter dwells upon it, the king should not go forth.

translations.literal: Saturn's prognostication is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Saturn's prognostication is the same.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing: generals and chancellors are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus trespasses it, generals and chancellors will be troubled.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: the ruler is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, the ruler will be troubled.

sentences.zh: 彗星、客星守之，道路阻，兵起，一云兵滿野。

translations.literal: A comet or guest star dwelling on it: roads blocked, armies arise; one account says armies fill the fields.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or guest star dwells upon it, roads will be blocked and armies will arise; one account says armies will fill the countryside.

sentences.zh: 鉤鈐二星，在房北，房之鈐鍵，天之管籥。

translations.literal: Hook and Hasp has two stars, north of the Room Lodge; the hasp and key of the Room, the pipes and flutes of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Hook and Hasp comprises two stars north of the Room Lodge—the hasp and key of the Room, the pipes and flutes of Heaven.

translations.literal: If the king reaches utmost filial piety, they are bright.
translations.idiomatic: If the king attains utmost filial piety, they will shine bright.

sentences.zh: 又曰明而近房，天下同心。

translations.literal: It is also said: if bright and drawing near the Room Lodge, the realm is of one heart.
translations.idiomatic: It is also said that if they are bright and draw near the Room Lodge, the realm will be of one heart.

sentences.zh: 房、鉤鈐間有星及疏折，則地動，河清。

translations.literal: If stars appear between the Room Lodge and Hook and Hasp, or they are sparse and broken, then the earth quakes and the river runs clear.
translations.idiomatic: If stars appear between the Room Lodge and Hook and Hasp, or they grow sparse and broken, the earth will quake and the river will run clear.

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: great men are troubled; the imperial equipage sets out.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, great men will be troubled and the imperial equipage will take the road.

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse: in its allotted region a general dies.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse in its allotted region portends the death of a general.

translations.literal: Jupiter dwelling on it: means famine;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter dwells upon it, famine will follow;

sentences.zh: 去其宿三寸，王失政，近臣起，亂。

translations.literal: Departing its lodge by three inches: the king loses government, close ministers rise, turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: If it departs its lodge by three inches, the king will lose government, close ministers will rise, and turmoil will follow.

translations.literal: Mars dwelling on it: there is a decree of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars dwells upon it, a decree of virtue will be issued.

translations.literal: Venus dwelling: throat and tongue are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus dwells upon it, the throat-and-tongue offices will be troubled.

translations.literal: Saturn dwelling: the king loses territory.
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn dwells upon it, the king will lose territory.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: the palace court loses its offices.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, the palace court will lose its offices.

sentences.zh: 客星、流星犯，王有奔馬之敗。

translations.literal: A guest star or shooting star trespassing: the king suffers defeat as of a runaway horse.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star or shooting star trespasses it, the king will suffer defeat as swift as a runaway horse.

sentences.zh: 東鹹、西鹹各四星，東咸在心北，西咸在房西北，日、月、五星之道也。

translations.literal: Eastern Influence and Western Influence each have four stars; Eastern Influence is north of the Heart Lodge, Western Influence northwest of the Room Lodge—the path of sun, moon, and Five Planets.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Influence and Western Influence each comprise four stars; Eastern Influence lies north of the Heart Lodge and Western Influence northwest of the Room Lodge, along the path of the sun, moon, and Five Planets.

translations.literal: They are the doors of the Room Lodge, to guard against licentious excess.
translations.idiomatic: They serve as the doors of the Room Lodge, guarding against licentious excess.

translations.literal: bright: then trust is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: If bright, trust and good faith will prevail.

translations.literal: Eastern Influence drawing near Hook and Hasp: slanderous ministers enter.
translations.idiomatic: If Eastern Influence draws near Hook and Hasp, slanderous ministers will enter court.

sentences.zh: 西鹹近上及動，有知星者入。

translations.literal: Western Influence drawing near above and stirring: those who know the stars enter.
translations.idiomatic: If Western Influence draws near above and stirs, those versed in the stars will enter court.

sentences.zh: 月、五星犯之，有陰謀，又爲女主失禮，民饑。

translations.literal: The moon or Five Planets trespassing: there is secret plotting; it also means the chief consort loses propriety and the people famish.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon or the Five Planets trespass them, secret plotting will arise; it also portends impropriety by the chief consort and hunger among the people.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: ministers plot against the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses them, ministers will plot against the ruler.

translations.literal: Trespassing together with Venus: armies arise.
translations.idiomatic: If it trespasses together with Venus, armies will arise.

translations.literal: Jupiter or Saturn trespassing: there is secret plotting.
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter or Saturn trespasses them, secret plotting will arise.

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing: consorts grow unrestrained; the king has troubles.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star trespasses them, consorts will grow unrestrained and the king will suffer distress.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: the ruler loses propriety; consorts grow unrestrained.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses them, the ruler will lose propriety and consorts will grow unrestrained.

sentences.zh: 罰三星，在東、西咸正南，主受金罰贖。

translations.literal: Punishment has three stars, due south of Eastern and Western Influence; it governs receiving metal fines for redemption.
translations.idiomatic: Punishment comprises three stars due south of Eastern and Western Influence; it presides over receiving metal fines for redemption.

translations.literal: If curved and slanting in array, then punishments miss the mark.
translations.idiomatic: If they curve and slant in array, punishments will miss the mark.

sentences.zh: 彗星、客星犯之，國無政令，憂多，枉法。

translations.literal: A comet or guest star trespassing: the state lacks government decrees, troubles multiply, laws are perverted.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or guest star trespasses them, the state will lack government decrees, troubles will multiply, and laws will be perverted.

sentences.zh: 日一星，在房宿南，太陽之精，主昭明令德。

translations.literal: Sun is one star, south of the Room Lodge; the essence of Great Yang; it governs brilliant virtue and luminous decrees.
translations.idiomatic: Sun is a single star south of the Room Lodge, the essence of Great Yang; it presides over brilliant virtue and luminous decrees.

translations.literal: Bright and large: then the ruler has a decree of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: If it shines bright and large, the ruler will issue a decree of virtue.

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: subordinates plot against superiors.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, subordinates will plot against their superiors.

sentences.zh: 歲星守，王得忠臣，陰陽和，四夷賓，五穀豐。

translations.literal: Jupiter dwelling: the king gains loyal ministers, yin and yang are in harmony, the four barbarians come as guests, the five grains are abundant.
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter dwells upon it, the king will gain loyal ministers, yin and yang will be in harmony, the four barbarians will come as guests, and the five grains will be abundant.

translations.literal: Venus or Mars trespassing: the ruler has troubles.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus or Mars trespasses it, the ruler will suffer distress.

translations.literal: A guest star or comet trespassing: the ruler loses position.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star or comet trespasses it, the ruler will lose his position.

sentences.zh: 從官二星，在房宿西南，主疾病巫醫。

translations.literal: Attendant Officials has two stars, southwest of the Room Lodge; it governs illness, shamans, and physicians.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Officials comprises two stars southwest of the Room Lodge; it presides over illness, shamans, and physicians.

translations.literal: Bright and large: then shamans monopolize power.
translations.idiomatic: If they shine bright and large, shamans will monopolize power.

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing: shaman-ministers make rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or broom star trespasses them, shaman-ministers will stir rebellion.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor trespassing, black: shaman-ministers are executed;
translations.idiomatic: If cloud vapor trespasses them and is black, shaman-ministers will be executed;

translations.literal: yellow: then they receive noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: If yellow, they will receive noble rank.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，以上諸星俱屬在房。

translations.literal: According to the Book of the Pace of Heaven, all the stars above belong to the Room.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Book of the Pace of Heaven, all the stars named above belong to the Room Lodge.

sentences.zh: 日一星，《晉》、《隋志》皆不載，以他書考之，雖在房宿南，實入氐十二度半。

translations.literal: Sun as one star: the Jin and Sui treatises do not record it; examining other books, though south of the Room Lodge, it actually enters the Root by twelve and a half degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Sun as a single star is omitted from the Jin and Sui treatises; examining other books, though it lies south of the Room Lodge, it actually enters the Root Lodge by twelve and a half degrees.

sentences.zh: 武密書及《乾象新書》惟以東鹹屬心，西咸屬房，與《步天歌》不同，餘皆吻合。

translations.literal: Wu Mi's treatise and the New Book of the Supernal Image only assign Eastern Influence to the Heart and Western Influence to the Room, differing from the Book of the Pace of Heaven; on all else they accord.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi's treatise and the New Book of the Supernal Image assign Eastern Influence only to the Heart Lodge and Western Influence only to the Room Lodge, differing from the Book of the Pace of Heaven; on all else they accord.

translations.literal: The Heart Lodge has three stars; they are the King of Heaven's proper station.
translations.idiomatic: The Heart Lodge comprises three stars forming the King of Heaven's proper station.

sentences.zh: 中星曰明堂，天子位，爲大辰，主天下之賞罰；

translations.literal: The central star is called the Bright Hall, the Son of Heaven's station; it is the Great Chronogram and governs rewards and punishments across the realm;
translations.idiomatic: The central star is called the Bright Hall, the Son of Heaven's station; it is the Great Chronogram and presides over rewards and punishments across the realm;

translations.literal: the front star is the heir apparent;
translations.idiomatic: the front star is the heir apparent;

translations.literal: the rear star is the secondary son.
translations.idiomatic: the rear star is the secondary son.

translations.literal: Stars straight: then the king loses power.
translations.idiomatic: If the stars align straight, the king will lose power.

translations.literal: bright and large: the realm is of one heart;
translations.idiomatic: If they shine bright and large, the realm will be of one heart;

translations.literal: when the realm changes, the Heart stars show auspicious signs;
translations.idiomatic: when the realm undergoes change, the Heart stars will show auspicious signs;

translations.literal: trembling: then armies scatter and the people flow away.
translations.idiomatic: If they tremble, armies will scatter and the people will flow away.

sentences.zh: 日食，其分刑罰不中，將相疑，民饑，兵、喪。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse: in its allotted region punishments miss the mark, generals and chancellors are suspicious, the people famish, armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in its allotted region portends punishments missing the mark, suspicion between generals and chancellors, hunger among the people, armies, and mourning.

translations.literal: Solar halo: the king is troubled by it.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo will trouble the king.

sentences.zh: 月食其宿，王者惡之，三公憂，下有喪。

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse at its lodge: the king finds it dire, the Three Dukes are troubled, mourning below.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse at this lodge portends the king finding the omen dire, distress for the Three Dukes, and mourning below.

sentences.zh: 月暈，爲旱，穀貴，蟲生，將凶。

translations.literal: Lunar halo: means drought, grain costly, insects breed, generals are inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends drought, dear grain prices, insect plagues, and misfortune for generals.

translations.literal: Conjoining with the Five Planets: great inauspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: If it conjoins with the Five Planets, the omen is greatly inauspicious.

translations.literal: Great Yin trespassing it: great ministers are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: If Great Yin trespasses it, great ministers will be troubled;

sentences.zh: 犯中央及前後星，主惡之；

translations.literal: trespassing the central and front and rear stars: the ruler finds it dire;
translations.idiomatic: If it trespasses the central and front and rear stars, the ruler will find the omen dire;

translations.literal: emerging north of the Heart's great star: the state suffers drought;
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges north of the Heart's great star, the state will suffer drought;

translations.literal: emerging south: the ruler is troubled, armies arise.
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges to the south, the ruler will be troubled and armies will arise.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，有慶賀事，谷豐，華夷奉化；

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing it: there are celebrations, grain is abundant, Chinese and barbarians submit to transformation;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter trespasses it, celebrations will be held, grain will be abundant, and Chinese and barbarians alike will submit to the royal transformation;

translations.literal: Color not bright: there is mourning and drought.
translations.idiomatic: If its color is not bright, mourning and drought will follow.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing it: great ministers are troubled;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, great ministers will be troubled;

translations.literal: piercing the Heart: means famine;
translations.idiomatic: If it pierces the Heart, famine will follow;

translations.literal: dwelling together with Venus: means mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells together with Venus, mourning will follow.

translations.literal: It is also said: if Mars occupies its yang side, means rejoicing;
translations.idiomatic: It is also said that if Mars occupies its yang side, rejoicing is foretold;

translations.literal: the yin side: means sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: If on its yin side, sorrow is foretold.

translations.literal: It is also said: dwelling on it, the ruler changes government;
translations.idiomatic: It is also said that if it dwells upon it, the ruler will change his government;

translations.literal: trespassing: the people scatter, great ministers find it dire;
translations.idiomatic: If it trespasses it, the people will scatter and great ministers will find the omen dire;

translations.literal: dwelling star to the south: means water;
translations.idiomatic: If the dwelling star lies to the south, floods will follow;

translations.literal: to the north: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If to the north, drought will follow;

translations.literal: retrograde motion: great ministers fall into turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: If it moves retrograde, great ministers will fall into turmoil.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing it: great ministers rejoice, grain is abundant;
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn trespasses it, great ministers will rejoice and grain will be abundant;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: there are earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, earthworks will be undertaken;

translations.literal: remaining lodged thirty days: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: If it remains lodged for thirty days, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: dwelling long: the ruler is worthy;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells long, the ruler will prove worthy;

translations.literal: trespassing the central Bright Hall: fire calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If it trespasses the central Bright Hall, fire calamity will follow;

translations.literal: retrograde motion: the chief consort meddles in government.
translations.idiomatic: If it moves retrograde, the chief consort will meddle in government.

sentences.zh: 太白犯，糴貴，將軍憂，有水災，不出一年有大兵；

translations.literal: Venus trespassing: grain dear, the general troubled, flood calamity; within one year great armies;
translations.idiomatic: If Venus trespasses it, grain prices will soar, the general will be troubled, and floods will follow; within one year great armies will march;

translations.literal: lodging on it, color not bright: means mourning;
translations.idiomatic: If it lodges upon it and its color is not bright, mourning is foretold;

translations.literal: retrograde motion encircling: great men find it dire.
translations.idiomatic: If it moves retrograde and encircles, great men will find the omen dire.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯明堂，則大臣當之，在陽爲燕，在陰爲塞北，不則地動、大雨；

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing the Bright Hall: then great ministers bear it; in yang means Yan, in yin means the northern frontier, otherwise earth quakes and great rain;
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury trespasses the Bright Hall, great ministers will bear the omen; in yang it means Yan, in yin the northern frontier, otherwise the earth will quake and great rains will fall;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: means water and banditry.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, floods and banditry will follow.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing it: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses it, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: means fire calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, fire calamity will follow;

translations.literal: lodging on it: then grain is dear, the people famish.
translations.idiomatic: If it lodges upon it, grain prices will soar and the people will go hungry.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing it: great ministers suspect one another;
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, great ministers will suspect one another;

sentences.zh: 守之而出，爲蝗、饑，又曰爲兵。

translations.literal: dwelling on it then emerging: means locusts and famine; it is also said to mean armies.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it then emerges, locusts and famine will follow; it is also said to portend armies.

translations.literal: A broom star: in its allotted region armies and mourning, the people scatter.
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star appears, its allotted region will see armies and mourning and the people will scatter.

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing: ministers rebel;
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star trespasses it, ministers will rebel;

translations.literal: entering it: envoys from foreign states come;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, envoys from foreign states will arrive;

translations.literal: color green: means armies and sorrow;
translations.idiomatic: If its color is green, armies and sorrow are foretold;

translations.literal: yellow: there are earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: If yellow, earthworks will be undertaken;

translations.literal: black: means inauspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: If black, the omen is inauspicious.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor entering, color yellow: sons and grandsons rejoice;
translations.idiomatic: If cloud vapor enters and its color is yellow, sons and grandsons will rejoice;

translations.literal: white: rebellious ministers are at the ruler's side;
translations.idiomatic: If white, rebellious ministers will be at the ruler's side;

translations.literal: black: the heir apparent is guilty.
translations.idiomatic: If black, the heir apparent will be found guilty.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀、唐開元遊儀，心三星皆五度，去極百八度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary and the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary, the Heart's three stars are all five degrees, polar distance one hundred eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary and the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary, the Heart Lodge's three stars were each measured at five degrees with a polar distance of one hundred eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，心三星五度，距西第一星去極百十四度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: the Heart's three stars five degrees, from the first western star polar distance one hundred fourteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey measurements reckoned the Heart Lodge's three stars at five degrees, with the first western star at a polar distance of one hundred fourteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 積卒十二星，在房西南，五營軍士之象，主衛士掃除不祥。

translations.literal: Accumulated Soldiers has twelve stars, southwest of the Room Lodge; the image of soldiers of the Five Camps, governing guards who sweep away ill omens.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated Soldiers comprises twelve stars southwest of the Room Lodge, representing soldiers of the Five Camps; it presides over guards who sweep away ill omens.

translations.literal: Stars small: auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars are small, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: bright: then there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: If bright, armies will arise;

translations.literal: one star perishes: few armies march forth;
translations.idiomatic: If one star vanishes, few armies will march forth;

translations.literal: two stars perish: half the armies march forth;
translations.idiomatic: If two stars vanish, half the armies will march forth;

translations.literal: three stars perish: all armies march forth.
translations.idiomatic: If three stars vanish, all armies will march forth.

translations.literal: The Five Planets dwelling on it: armies arise;
translations.idiomatic: If the Five Planets dwell upon it, armies will arise;

translations.literal: otherwise close ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: otherwise close ministers will be executed.

sentences.zh: 彗星、客星守之，禁兵大出，天子自將。

translations.literal: A comet or guest star dwelling on it: palace guards march forth in force, the Son of Heaven leads in person.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or guest star dwells upon it, palace guards will march forth in force and the Son of Heaven will lead in person.

sentences.zh: 雲氣犯之，青赤，爲大臣持政，欲論兵事。

translations.literal: Cloud vapor trespassing it, green-red: great ministers hold government and wish to debate military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: If cloud vapor trespasses it and is green-red, great ministers will hold government and seek to debate military affairs.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，積卒十二星屬心，《晉志》在二十八宿之外，唐武密書與《步天歌》合。

translations.literal: According to the Book of the Pace of Heaven, Accumulated Soldiers' twelve stars belong to the Heart; the Jin Treatise places them outside the Twenty-eight Lodges; Tang Wu Mi's treatise accords with the Book of the Pace of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Book of the Pace of Heaven, the twelve stars of Accumulated Soldiers belong to the Heart Lodge; the Jin Treatise places them outside the Twenty-eight Lodges, while Tang Wu Mi's treatise accords with the Book of the Pace of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》乃以積卒屬房宿爲不同，今兩存其說。

translations.literal: The New Book of the Supernal Image assigns Accumulated Soldiers to the Room Lodge as a difference; now both accounts are preserved.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of the Supernal Image differs in assigning Accumulated Soldiers to the Room Lodge; both accounts are therefore preserved here.

sentences.zh: 尾宿九星，爲天子後宮，亦主後妃之位。

translations.literal: The Tail Lodge has nine stars; it is the Son of Heaven's inner palace and also governs the consorts' stations.
translations.idiomatic: The Tail Lodge comprises nine stars forming the Son of Heaven's inner palace and also presiding over the consorts' stations.

translations.literal: The upper first star: the queen consort;
translations.idiomatic: The upper first star is the queen consort;

translations.literal: the next three stars: ladies;
translations.idiomatic: the next three are the ladies;

translations.literal: the next stars: concubines.
translations.idiomatic: the remaining stars are concubines.

translations.literal: It is also the Nine Sons.
translations.idiomatic: It also represents the Nine Sons.

sentences.zh: 均明，大小相承，則後宮有序，子孫蕃昌。

translations.literal: Evenly bright, large and small succeeding one another: then the inner palace is ordered and sons and grandsons flourish.
translations.idiomatic: If they shine evenly bright, large and small succeeding one another, the inner palace will be ordered and sons and grandsons will flourish.

translations.literal: bright: then the consort has cause for joy, grain ripens;
translations.idiomatic: If bright, the consort will have cause for joy and grain will ripen;

translations.literal: not bright: then the consort has troubles, grain fails.
translations.idiomatic: If not bright, the consort will suffer distress and grain will fail.

sentences.zh: 日食，其分將有疾，在燕風沙，兵、喪，後宮有憂，人君戒出。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse: in its allotted region generals will suffer illness; in Yan, wind and sand; armies and mourning; the inner palace has troubles; the ruler is warned against going forth.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in its allotted region portends illness among generals; in Yan, wind and sand; armies and mourning; distress in the inner palace; and the ruler is warned against going forth.

translations.literal: Solar halo: mourning for the chief consort, generals and chancellors troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo portends mourning for the chief consort and distress for generals and chancellors.

sentences.zh: 月食，其分貴臣犯刑，後宮有憂。

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse: in its allotted region noble ministers suffer punishment, the inner palace has troubles.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse in its allotted region portends punishment for noble ministers and distress in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 月暈，有疫，大赦，將相憂，其分有水災，後妃憂。

translations.literal: Lunar halo: epidemic illness, great amnesty, generals and chancellors troubled; in its allotted region flood calamity, consorts troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends epidemic illness, a great amnesty, distress for generals and chancellors, floods in its allotted region, and distress for consorts.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯之，臣不和，將有憂。

translations.literal: Great Yin trespassing it: ministers are not in harmony, generals have troubles.
translations.idiomatic: If Great Yin trespasses it, ministers will fall out of harmony and generals will face trouble.

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing: grain is dear;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter trespasses it, grain prices will rise;

translations.literal: entering it: a concubine becomes the primary wife, ministers monopolize government;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, a concubine will be raised to primary wife and ministers will monopolize government;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: drought, fire calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, drought and fire calamity will follow.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing it: there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, armies will arise;

translations.literal: remaining twenty days: flood calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If it remains twenty days, floods will follow;

translations.literal: remaining three months: guest armies gather;
translations.idiomatic: If it remains three months, guest armies will gather;

sentences.zh: 入之，人相食，又云宮內亂。

translations.literal: entering it: people eat one another; it is also said the palace falls into turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, people will eat one another; it is also said the palace will fall into turmoil.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing it, color yellow: consorts rejoice;
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn trespasses it and its color is yellow, consorts will rejoice;

translations.literal: entering: means armies, famine, and bandits;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, armies, famine, and bandits will follow;

translations.literal: retrograde motion: a concubine becomes the ruling woman;
translations.idiomatic: If it moves retrograde, a concubine will become the ruling woman;

sentences.zh: 守之而有芒角，更姓易政。

translations.literal: dwelling on it with rays and horns: the surname changes and government is transformed.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it showing rays and horns, the ruling house will change and government will be transformed.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing or entering: great ministers raise armies;
translations.idiomatic: If Venus trespasses or enters it, great ministers will raise armies;

translations.literal: remaining long: means flood calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If it remains long, floods will follow;

sentences.zh: 出、入、舍、守，糴貴，兵起，後宮憂；

translations.literal: emerging, entering, lodging, dwelling: grain dear, armies arise, the inner palace troubled;
translations.idiomatic: Whether it emerges, enters, lodges, or dwells, grain prices will soar, armies will arise, and the inner palace will suffer distress;

translations.literal: losing its proper motion: armies are broken and cities perish.
translations.idiomatic: If it loses its proper motion, armies will be broken and cities will perish.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯守，爲水災，民疾，後宮有罪者，兵起；

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing and dwelling: flood calamity, the people suffer illness, guilty persons in the inner palace, armies arise;
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury trespasses and dwells upon it, floods will follow, the people will suffer illness, guilty persons will be found in the inner palace, and armies will arise;

translations.literal: entering: then the ten thousand things do not ripen, the people suffer epidemic.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, the ten thousand things will fail to ripen and the people will suffer epidemic disease.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing or entering: palace women find it dire;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses or enters it, palace women will find the omen dire;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: lowborn women suddenly grow exalted;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, lowborn women will suddenly rise to exalted rank;

sentences.zh: 出，則爲風、爲水，後宮惡之，兵罷，民饑多死。

translations.literal: emerging: then wind and water; the inner palace finds it dire; armies cease, the people famish and many die.
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, wind and floods will follow; the inner palace will find the omen dire; armies will stand down, and many among the famished people will die.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯，後惑主，宮人出，兵起，宮門多土功；

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: the consort deludes the ruler, palace women go forth, armies arise, many earthworks at the palace gates;
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, the consort will delude the ruler, palace women will go forth, armies will arise, and many earthworks will be undertaken at the palace gates;

translations.literal: entering and emerging: noble ministers executed, flood calamity.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters and emerges, noble ministers will be executed and floods will follow.

translations.literal: A broom star trespassing: many earthworks, great ministers executed;
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star trespasses it, many earthworks will be undertaken and great ministers will be executed;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: palace women go forth;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, palace women will go forth;

translations.literal: emerging: great floods, the people famish.
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, great floods will follow and the people will go hungry.

translations.literal: A shooting star entering or trespassing, color green: old ministers return;
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star enters or trespasses it and its color is green, old ministers will return;

translations.literal: in spring and summer: the inner palace has quarrels;
translations.idiomatic: In spring and summer, the inner palace will suffer quarrels;

translations.literal: in autumn and winter: worthy men hold office;
translations.idiomatic: In autumn and winter, worthy men will hold office;

translations.literal: emerging: then the inner palace rejoices, there are sons and grandsons;
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, the inner palace will rejoice and sons and grandsons will be born;

translations.literal: color white: concubines in the inner palace die;
translations.idiomatic: If its color is white, concubines in the inner palace will die;

sentences.zh: 出入，風雨時，穀熟，入，後族進祿；

translations.literal: entering and emerging: wind and rain are timely, grain ripens; entering: the consort's clan advances in stipend;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters and emerges, wind and rain will be timely and grain will ripen; if it enters, the consort's clan will advance in stipend;

translations.literal: green-black: then consorts mourn.
translations.idiomatic: If green-black, consorts will mourn.

translations.literal: Cloud vapor entering, color green: foreign states come to submit;
translations.idiomatic: If cloud vapor enters and its color is green, foreign states will come to submit;

translations.literal: emerging: then ministers have turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, ministers will fall into turmoil.

translations.literal: Red vapor entering: envoys come to speak of armies.
translations.idiomatic: If red vapor enters, envoys will come to speak of armies.

translations.literal: Black vapor entering: feudal lords come as guests.
translations.idiomatic: If black vapor enters, feudal lords will come as guests.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，尾宿十八度，唐開元遊儀同。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Tail Lodge eighteen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary is the same.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Tail Lodge was measured at eighteen degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan mobile armillary agrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極百二十度，一云百四十度；

translations.literal: Former polar distance one hundred twenty degrees; one account says one hundred forty degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Its former polar distance was one hundred twenty degrees; one account says one hundred forty degrees;

translations.literal: Now one hundred twenty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It is now reckoned at one hundred twenty-four degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，亦十八度，距西行從西第二星去極百二十八度，在赤道外二十二度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: also eighteen degrees, from the second star westward along the western row polar distance one hundred twenty-eight degrees, twenty-two degrees south of the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey measurements likewise reckoned it at eighteen degrees, with the second star westward along the western row at a polar distance of one hundred twenty-eight degrees, twenty-two degrees south of the equator.

translations.literal: The New Book of the Supernal Image: twenty-seven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The New Book of the Supernal Image places it at twenty-seven degrees.

sentences.zh: 神宮一星，在尾宿第三星旁，解衣之內室也。

translations.literal: Divine Palace is one star, beside the Tail Lodge's third star; the inner chamber where one removes one's garments.
translations.idiomatic: Divine Palace is a single star beside the Tail Lodge's third star, forming the inner chamber where one removes one's garments.

sentences.zh: 天江四星，在尾宿北，主太陰。

translations.literal: Celestial River has four stars, north of the Tail Lodge; it governs Great Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Celestial River comprises four stars north of the Tail Lodge; it presides over Great Yin.

translations.literal: Bright and stirring: means water, armies arise;
translations.idiomatic: If bright and stirring, floods will follow and armies will arise;

translations.literal: stars not complete: then ferries and bridges are blocked;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars are not complete, ferries and bridges will be cut off;

translations.literal: uneven: horses are costly.
translations.idiomatic: If uneven, horses will grow costly.

sentences.zh: 月犯，爲兵，爲臣強，河津不通。

translations.literal: The moon trespassing: means armies, ministers grow strong, river crossings are blocked.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, armies will arise, ministers will grow strong, and river crossings will be blocked.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: great drought;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, great drought will follow;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: there is one who establishes a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, someone will establish a new ruler.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing: sudden floods.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus trespasses it, sudden floods will follow.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: means great armies.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, great armies will march.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: river crossings are blocked.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters it, river crossings will be blocked.

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing: means water and famine.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star trespasses it, floods and famine will follow.

translations.literal: Red cloud vapor trespassing: chariots and cavalry march forth;
translations.idiomatic: If red cloud vapor trespasses it, chariots and cavalry will march forth;

translations.literal: green: means much water;
translations.idiomatic: If green, there will be much water;

translations.literal: yellow-white: the Son of Heaven takes action, armies arise;
translations.idiomatic: If yellow-white, the Son of Heaven will take action and armies will arise;

translations.literal: entering: then armies cease.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, armies will stand down.

sentences.zh: 傅說一星，在尾後河中，主章祝官也，一曰後宮女巫也，司天王之內祭祀，以祈子孫。

translations.literal: Fu Yue is one star, in the river behind the Tail; it governs the Director of Prayer Officials; it is also said to be the inner palace's shamaness, overseeing the King of Heaven's inner sacrifices to pray for sons and grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yue is a single star in the river behind the Tail; it presides over the Director of Prayer Officials, and is also said to represent the inner palace shamaness who oversees the King of Heaven's inner sacrifices to pray for sons and grandsons.

sentences.zh: 明大，則吉，王者多子孫，輔佐出；

translations.literal: Bright and large: then auspicious, the king has many sons and grandsons, assistants emerge;
translations.idiomatic: If bright and large, the omen is auspicious, the king will have many sons and grandsons, and worthy assistants will emerge;

translations.literal: not bright: then the realm has many prayer sacrifices;
translations.idiomatic: If not bright, the realm will see many prayer sacrifices;

translations.literal: perishing: then the altars of soil and grain have no lord;
translations.idiomatic: If it vanishes, the altars of soil and grain will have no lord;

translations.literal: entering below the Tail: many prayers and curses.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters below the Tail, prayers and curses will multiply.

translations.literal: The Zuo Tradition's "Heaven's Quill, blazing and wheeling"—this is that star.
translations.idiomatic: The Zuo Tradition's phrase "Heaven's Quill, blazing and wheeling" refers to this star.

sentences.zh: 彗星、客星守之，天子不享宗廟。

translations.literal: A comet or guest star dwelling on it: the Son of Heaven does not enjoy the ancestral temples.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or guest star dwells upon it, the Son of Heaven will not offer sacrifice at the ancestral temples.

sentences.zh: 赤雲氣入，巫祝官有誅者。

translations.literal: Red cloud vapor entering: among shaman-prayer officials some are executed.
translations.idiomatic: If red cloud vapor enters, some among the shaman-prayer officials will be executed.

sentences.zh: 魚一星，在尾後河中，主陰事，知雲雨之期。

translations.literal: Fish is one star, in the river behind the Tail; it governs yin affairs and knows the seasons of cloud and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Fish is a single star in the river behind the Tail; it presides over yin affairs and foreknows the seasons of cloud and rain.

translations.literal: Bright and large: then river and sea waters rise;
translations.idiomatic: If bright and large, river and sea waters will rise;

translations.literal: not bright: then yin and yang are in harmony, many fish;
translations.idiomatic: If not bright, yin and yang will be in harmony and fish will be plentiful;

translations.literal: perishing: then fish are few;
translations.idiomatic: If it vanishes, fish will be few;

translations.literal: trembling: then great floods burst forth;
translations.idiomatic: If it trembles, great floods will burst forth;

translations.literal: emerging: then in the river great fish die in great numbers.
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, great fish in the rivers will die in great numbers.

translations.literal: A lunar halo or trespassing: then drought, fish die.
translations.idiomatic: If a lunar halo appears or the moon trespasses it, drought will follow and fish will die.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing its yang side: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses its yang side, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: the yin side: means water.
translations.idiomatic: If on its yin side, floods will follow.

translations.literal: Saturn dwelling on it: means drought.
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn dwells upon it, drought will follow.

translations.literal: Red cloud vapor trespassing and emerging: armies arise, the general is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: If red cloud vapor trespasses and emerges, armies will arise and the general will be troubled;

translations.literal: entering: armies cease;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, armies will stand down;

translations.literal: Yellow-white vapor emerging: armies arise.
translations.idiomatic: If yellow-white vapor emerges, armies will arise.

sentences.zh: 龜五星，在尾南，主卜，以占吉凶。

translations.literal: Tortoise has five stars, south of the Tail; it governs divination to prognosticate auspice and bane.
translations.idiomatic: Tortoise comprises five stars south of the Tail; it presides over divination to prognosticate good and ill fortune.

translations.literal: stars bright: ruler and ministers are in harmony;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars shine bright, ruler and ministers will be in harmony;

translations.literal: not bright: then above and below are at odds.
translations.idiomatic: If not bright, those above and below will fall out of harmony.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: dwelling: means fire.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, fire calamity will follow.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: means water and sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters it, floods and sorrow will follow.

translations.literal: A shooting star emerging, color red-yellow: means armies;
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star emerges and its color is red-yellow, armies will arise;

sentences.zh: 青黑，爲水，各以其國言之。

translations.literal: green-black: means water; each is spoken of according to its state.
translations.idiomatic: If green-black, floods are foretold, each omen being interpreted according to its allotted state.

translations.literal: Red cloud vapor emerging: divination-prayer officials are troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If red cloud vapor emerges, divination-prayer officials will be troubled.

sentences.zh: 按神宮、傅說、魚各一星，天江四星，龜五星，《步天歌》與他書皆屬尾。

translations.literal: According to Divine Palace, Fu Yue, and Fish each one star, Celestial River four stars, Tortoise five stars—the Book of the Pace of Heaven and other books all assign them to the Tail.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Book of the Pace of Heaven and other books alike, Divine Palace, Fu Yue, and Fish each have one star, Celestial River four, and Tortoise five—all assigned to the Tail Lodge.

sentences.zh: 而《晉志》列天江於天市垣，以傅說、魚、龜在二十八宿之外，其說不同。

translations.literal: But the Jin Treatise lists Celestial River in the Celestial Market Enclosure and places Fu Yue, Fish, and Tortoise outside the Twenty-eight Lodges—the accounts differ.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin Treatise, however, lists Celestial River within the Celestial Market Enclosure and places Fu Yue, Fish, and Tortoise outside the Twenty-eight Lodges, so the reckonings differ.

sentences.zh: 箕宿四星，爲後宮妃後之府，亦曰天津，一曰天雞。

translations.literal: The Winnowing Basket Lodge has four stars; it is the consorts' palace in the inner quarters, also called the Celestial Ford, also called the Heavenly Cock.
translations.idiomatic: The Winnowing Basket Lodge comprises four stars forming the consorts' palace in the inner quarters; it is also called the Celestial Ford and the Heavenly Cock.

sentences.zh: 主八風，又主口舌，主蠻夷。

translations.literal: It governs the Eight Winds, also governs speech, and governs barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: It presides over the Eight Winds, over speech, and over barbarian peoples.

translations.literal: stars bright and large: grain ripens;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars shine bright and large, grain will ripen;

translations.literal: not upright: means armies;
translations.idiomatic: If not upright, armies will arise;

translations.literal: separated and shifting: the realm is unsettled;
translations.idiomatic: If separated and shifting, the realm will be unsettled;

translations.literal: the central stars numerous likewise: grain is dear.
translations.idiomatic: If the central stars are likewise numerous, grain prices will soar.

sentences.zh: 凡日月宿在箕、壁、翼、軫者，皆爲風起；

translations.literal: Whenever sun and moon lodge in the Winnowing Basket, Wall, Wings, or Chariot Shaft, winds all arise;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the sun and moon lodge in the Winnowing Basket, Wall, Wings, or Chariot Shaft Lodges, winds will arise;

translations.literal: the tongue stirs: within three days there is a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: If the tongue stirs, a great wind will rise within three days.

sentences.zh: 日犯或食其宿，將疾，佞臣害忠良，皇后憂，大風沙。

translations.literal: The sun trespassing or eclipsing its lodge: generals suffer illness, flatterers harm the loyal and good, the empress is troubled, great wind and sand.
translations.idiomatic: If the sun trespasses or eclipses this lodge, generals will suffer illness, flatterers will harm the loyal and good, the empress will be troubled, and great wind and sand will follow.

translations.literal: Solar halo: the state has demonic speech.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo portends demonic rumors in the state.

sentences.zh: 月食，爲風，爲水、旱，爲饑，後惡之。

translations.literal: Lunar eclipse: means wind, water and drought, famine; the consort finds it dire.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse portends wind, floods and drought, and famine; the consort will find the omen dire.

sentences.zh: 月暈，爲風，谷貴，大將易，又王者納後。

translations.literal: Lunar halo: means wind, grain costly, great generals replaced; it is also said the king takes a new consort.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends wind, dear grain prices, and the replacement of great generals; it is also said the king will take a new consort.

sentences.zh: 月犯，多風，糴貴，爲旱，女主憂，君將死，後宮幹政。

translations.literal: The moon trespassing: much wind, grain dear, means drought, the chief consort troubled, the ruler will die, the inner palace meddles in government.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, winds will be many, grain prices will soar, drought will follow, the chief consort will be troubled, the ruler will die, and the inner palace will meddle in government.

sentences.zh: 歲星入，宮內口舌，歲熟，在箕南，爲旱；

translations.literal: Jupiter entering: quarrels within the palace, the year ripens; in the south of the Winnowing Basket, means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter enters, quarrels will arise within the palace and the year will ripen; south of the Winnowing Basket, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: in the north: means a fruitful year;
translations.idiomatic: if to the north, a fruitful year is foretold;

sentences.zh: 守之，多惡風，穀貴，民饑死。

translations.literal: dwelling on it: many ill winds, grain costly, the people famish and die.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, ill winds will be many, grain prices will soar, and the people will starve and die.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: the earth quakes;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, the earth will quake;

translations.literal: entering: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, drought will follow;

translations.literal: emerging: then there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: dwelling long: means water;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells long, floods will follow;

sentences.zh: 逆行，諸侯相謀，人主惡之。

translations.literal: retrograde motion: feudal lords plot against one another, the ruler finds it dire.
translations.idiomatic: If it moves retrograde, feudal lords will plot against one another and the ruler will find the omen dire.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing: the chief consort is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn trespasses it, the chief consort will be troubled;

translations.literal: remaining long: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: If it remains long, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: the consort rejoices, there are earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, the consort will rejoice and earthworks will be undertaken;

translations.literal: color yellow, light lustrous: then the empress dowager rejoices;
translations.idiomatic: If its color is yellow and its light lustrous, the empress dowager will rejoice;

translations.literal: Further prognostication: dwelling, there is water;
translations.idiomatic: Further prognostication: if it dwells upon it, floods will follow;

translations.literal: dwelling ninety days: the people scatter, armies arise, locusts.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells ninety days, the people will scatter, armies will arise, and locusts will plague the land.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing: the chief consort rejoices;
translations.idiomatic: If Venus trespasses it, the chief consort will rejoice;

translations.literal: entering: then there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: emerging: means earthworks, grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, earthworks will be undertaken and grain prices will soar;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: means drought, wind, the people suffer illness;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, drought and wind will follow and the people will suffer illness;

sentences.zh: 出入留箕，五穀不登，多蝗。

translations.literal: entering, emerging, or remaining in the Winnowing Basket: the five grains do not ripen, many locusts.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, emerges, or remains in the Winnowing Basket, the five grains will fail to ripen and locusts will be many.

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury trespasses it, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: dwelling: then means drought;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, drought will follow;

sentences.zh: 動搖、色青，臣自戮，又占：爲水溢、旱、火災、穀不成。

translations.literal: trembling, color green: a minister executes himself; further prognostication: means overflowing water, drought, fire calamity, grain does not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: If it trembles and its color is green, a minister will execute himself; further prognostication: overflowing water, drought, fire calamity, and failure of the grain crop.

sentences.zh: 客星入犯，有土功，宮女不安，民流；

translations.literal: A guest star entering and trespassing: there are earthworks, palace women unsettled, the people scatter;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters and trespasses it, earthworks will be undertaken, palace women will be unsettled, and the people will scatter;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: means famine;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, famine will follow;

translations.literal: color red: means armies;
translations.idiomatic: If its color is red, armies will arise;

translations.literal: dwelling on its north: slight ripening;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells on its north, the crop will ripen slightly;

translations.literal: east: great ripening;
translations.idiomatic: if to the east, the crop will ripen abundantly;

translations.literal: south: slight famine;
translations.idiomatic: if to the south, slight famine will follow;

translations.literal: west: great famine;
translations.idiomatic: if to the west, great famine will follow;

sentences.zh: 出，其分民饑，大臣有棄者；

translations.literal: emerging: in its allotted region the people famish, among great ministers some are cast away;
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, the people in its allotted region will go hungry and some among the great ministers will be cast aside;

translations.literal: One account says dwelling on it: in autumn and winter, flood calamity.
translations.idiomatic: One account says that if it dwells upon it, floods will strike in autumn and winter.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing and dwelling: the eastern barbarians destroy themselves;
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses and dwells upon it, the eastern barbarians will destroy themselves;

translations.literal: emerging: then means drought, armies, turmoil in the north.
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, drought and armies will follow and the north will fall into turmoil.

translations.literal: A broom star trespassing: outer barbarians in turmoil, grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star trespasses it, outer barbarians will fall into turmoil and grain prices will soar;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: outer barbarians suffer calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, outer barbarians will suffer calamity;

translations.literal: emerging: grain is dear, the people die, they scatter in exile;
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges, grain prices will soar, the people will die, and they will scatter in exile;

translations.literal: spring and summer trespassing upon it: gold and jade are costly;
translations.idiomatic: If it trespasses in spring and summer, gold and jade will be costly;

translations.literal: autumn and winter: earthworks rise;
translations.idiomatic: In autumn and winter, earthworks will be undertaken;

translations.literal: entering: then much wind and rain;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, wind and rain will be abundant;

translations.literal: color yellow: outer barbarians come bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: If its color is yellow, outer barbarians will come bearing tribute.

translations.literal: cloud-vapor emerges, color pale white: the state's calamity is removed;
translations.idiomatic: When cloud-vapor emerges pale white, the state's calamities will be removed;

translations.literal: entering: then southern barbarians come to audience;
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, southern barbarians will come to audience;

translations.literal: emerging and color yellow: there are envoys;
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges yellow, envoys will appear;

translations.literal: emerging at the Winnowing Basket mouth, contracted: means rain;
translations.idiomatic: If it emerges at the mouth of the Winnowing Basket contracted, rain is foretold;

translations.literal: open: means much wind, little rain.
translations.idiomatic: If open, much wind and little rain are foretold.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，箕宿十度，唐開元游儀十一度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Winnowing Basket Lodge ten degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary eleven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary the Winnowing Basket Lodge was measured at ten degrees; on the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary, eleven degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極百十八度，今百二十度。

translations.literal: Former polar distance one hundred eighteen degrees; now one hundred twenty degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The former polar distance was one hundred eighteen degrees; it is now one hundred twenty degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，箕四星十度，距西北第一星去極百二十三度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: the Winnowing Basket's four stars ten degrees; from the northwest first star, polar distance one hundred twenty-three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey measured the Winnowing Basket's four stars at ten degrees, with the northwest first star at a polar distance of one hundred twenty-three degrees.

sentences.zh: 糠一星，在箕舌前，杵西北。

translations.literal: Chaff: one star, before the Winnowing Basket's tongue, northwest of the Pestle.
translations.idiomatic: Chaff is a single star lying before the Winnowing Basket's tongue, northwest of the Pestle.

translations.literal: bright: then abundant ripening;
translations.idiomatic: If bright, the harvest will ripen abundantly;

translations.literal: dim: then the people famish, scatter in exile.
translations.idiomatic: If dim, the people will famish and scatter in exile.

sentences.zh: 杵三星，在箕南，主給庖舂。

translations.literal: Pestle: three stars, south of the Winnowing Basket, govern supplying the kitchen for pounding grain.
translations.idiomatic: The Pestle's three stars lie south of the Winnowing Basket and govern supplying the kitchen mill for pounding grain.

translations.literal: moving: then people lose cauldrons and steamers;
translations.idiomatic: If they move, people will lose their cauldrons and steamers;

translations.literal: vertical: then abundance;
translations.idiomatic: If aligned vertically, abundance is foretold;

translations.literal: horizontal: then great famine;
translations.idiomatic: If aligned horizontally, great famine is foretold;

translations.literal: vanished: then the year is waste;
translations.idiomatic: If they vanish, the year will be barren;

translations.literal: shifting: then people lose their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: If they shift position, people will lose their livelihoods.

translations.literal: Mars dwelling on them: the people scatter.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars dwells upon them, the people will scatter.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing or dwelling: famine in the year.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses or dwells upon them, famine will afflict the year.

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing: the realm has urgent armies.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or broom star trespasses them, urgent armies will arise throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 按《晉志》，糠一星、杵三星在二十八宿之外。

translations.literal: According to the 《Book of Jin》, Chaff one star and Pestle three stars lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Book of Jin》, the one star of Chaff and the three stars of Pestle lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》與《步天歌》皆屬箕宿。

translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 and the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 both assign them to the Winnowing Basket Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Both the 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 and the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》 assign them to the Winnowing Basket Lodge.

sentences.zh: 南斗六星，天之賞祿府，主天子壽算，爲宰相爵祿之位，傳曰：天廟也。

translations.literal: The Southern Dipper's six stars are Heaven's Bureau of Rewards and Stipends; they govern the Son of Heaven's lifespan and are the seat of chancellors' ranks and stipends; tradition says: the Celestial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Dipper's six stars form Heaven's Bureau of Rewards and Stipends; they preside over the Son of Heaven's lifespan and mark the seat of chancellors' ranks and stipends—tradition calls them the Celestial Temple.

sentences.zh: 丞相太宰之位，褒賢進士，稟受爵祿，又主兵。

translations.literal: the seat of the chancellor and grand steward; commends the worthy and advances scholars; receives ranks and stipends; also governs armies.
translations.idiomatic: They mark the seat of the chancellor and grand steward, commending the worthy and advancing scholars, receiving ranks and stipends, and also governing armies.

translations.literal: Also called the Celestial Mechanism.
translations.idiomatic: They are also called the Celestial Mechanism.

translations.literal: The southern two stars are the Dipper's head—the Celestial Beam.
translations.idiomatic: The southern pair forms the Dipper's head, the Celestial Beam.

translations.literal: The central two stars are the Celestial Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The central pair is the Celestial Minister.

translations.literal: The northern two stars are the Celestial Treasury's court.
translations.idiomatic: The northern pair forms the court of the Celestial Treasury.

translations.literal: Further, the southern stars are called the Dipper-head stars;
translations.idiomatic: The southern stars are also called the Dipper-head stars;

sentences.zh: 北星，杓也，第一星曰北亭，一曰天開，一曰鈇鑕。

translations.literal: the northern stars are the ladle; the first star is called North Pavilion, also Celestial Gate, also Axe and Halberd.
translations.idiomatic: the northern stars form the ladle; the first is called North Pavilion, also the Celestial Gate, also Axe and Halberd.

sentences.zh: 石申曰：「魁第一主吳，二會稽，三丹陽，四豫章，五廬江，六九江。

translations.literal: Shi Shen said: "The Dipper-head's first governs Wu, the second Kuaiji, the third Danyang, the fourth Yuzhang, the fifth Lujiang, the sixth Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shen wrote: "The first star of the Dipper-head governs Wu, the second Kuaiji, the third Danyang, the fourth Yuzhang, the fifth Lujiang, and the sixth Jiujiang.

sentences.zh: 」星明盛，則王道和平，帝王長齡，將相同心；

translations.literal: " When the stars are bright and thriving, the kingly Way is peaceful, emperors and kings long-lived, generals and chancellors of one mind;
translations.idiomatic: " When the stars shine bright and thriving, the kingly Way will be peaceful, emperors and kings will enjoy long life, and generals and chancellors will be of one mind;

translations.literal: not bright: great and small lose order;
translations.idiomatic: if not bright, great and small will lose their proper order;

sentences.zh: 芒角動搖，國失忠臣，兵起，民愁。

translations.literal: rays and horns trembling: the state loses loyal ministers, armies rise, the people sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: if rays and horns tremble, the state will lose loyal ministers, armies will rise, and the people will sorrow.

sentences.zh: 日食在鬥，將相憂，兵起，皇后災，吳分有兵。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse in the Dipper: generals and chancellors troubled, armies rise, the empress suffers calamity, the Wu allotment has armies.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in the Dipper portends distress for generals and chancellors, rising armies, calamity for the empress, and warfare in the Wu allotment.

translations.literal: A solar halo: the chancellor troubled, the ancestral temple unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo portends distress for the chancellor and unrest in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 月食，其分國饑，小兵，後、夫人憂。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: its allotted region famines, minor warfare, the empress and chief consort troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse portends famine in its allotted region, minor warfare, and distress for the empress and chief consort.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: great generals die, the five grains do not grow.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends the death of great generals and failure of the five grains to grow.

sentences.zh: 月犯，將臣黜，風雨不時，大臣誅；

translations.literal: The moon trespassing: generals and ministers dismissed, wind and rain not timely, great ministers executed;
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, generals and ministers will be dismissed, wind and rain will be untimely, and great ministers will be executed;

translations.literal: three entries in one year: great amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: three entries in one year foretell a great amnesty;

sentences.zh: 又占：入，爲女主憂，趙、魏有兵；

translations.literal: Further prognostication: entering means the chief consort troubled, Zhao and Wei have armies;
translations.idiomatic: Further prognostication: if it enters, the chief consort will be troubled and Zhao and Wei will see armies;

translations.literal: color ill: the minister dies.
translations.idiomatic: if its color is ill, the minister will die.

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter trespasses it, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: long dwelling: flood calamity, grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells long, flood calamity will follow and grain will be dear;

translations.literal: dwelling one hundred days: armies employed, great ministers die.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells as long as one hundred days, armies will be mobilized and great ministers will die.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯，有赦，破軍殺將，火災；

translations.literal: Mars trespassing: there is an amnesty, defeated armies slay generals, fire calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, an amnesty will be proclaimed, yet defeated armies will slay generals and fire calamity will follow;

translations.literal: entering twenty days: grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: after twenty days of entering, grain prices will soar;

translations.literal: forty days: there is a decree of virtue;
translations.idiomatic: at forty days, a decree of virtue will be issued;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: means armies and bandits;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, armies and bandits will arise;

translations.literal: long dwelling: calamity severe;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells long, calamity will be severe;

translations.literal: emerging from the Dipper and going upward: the realm troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges from the Dipper and travels upward, the realm will be troubled;

translations.literal: not moving: ministers troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if it does not move, ministers will be troubled;

translations.literal: entering: inner and outer quarters have plotting;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, plotting will arise within and without;

translations.literal: dwelling seven days: the heir apparent falls ill.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells seven days, the heir apparent will fall ill.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing: means rebellion;
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn trespasses it, rebellion is foretold;

translations.literal: entering: then lose territory;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, territory will be lost;

translations.literal: retrograde: the earth quakes;
translations.idiomatic: if retrograde, the earth will quake;

translations.literal: emerging, entering, or remaining twenty days: great mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, enters, or remains twenty days, great mourning will follow;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: great ministers rebel.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, great ministers will rebel.

translations.literal: Further prognostication;
translations.idiomatic: Further prognostication:

translations.literal: retrograde: first flood, then drought;
translations.idiomatic: if retrograde, flood will come first and drought afterward;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: the state has many righteous men.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, the state will have many righteous men.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing it: there are armies, ministers rebel;
translations.idiomatic: If Venus trespasses it, armies will arise and ministers will rebel;

translations.literal: remaining and dwelling on it: defeated armies slay generals;
translations.idiomatic: if it remains and dwells upon it, defeated armies will slay generals;

sentences.zh: 與火俱入，白爍，臣子爲逆；

translations.literal: entering together with fire, flashing white: ministers and sons rebel;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters together with Mars, flashing white, ministers and sons will rebel;

translations.literal: long: then calamity is great.
translations.idiomatic: if prolonged, calamity will be great.

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: water, grain does not ripen, there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury trespasses it, flooding will follow, grain will fail to ripen, and armies will arise;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, armies and mourning will follow.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: armies rise, the state in turmoil;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses it, armies will rise and the state will fall into turmoil;

sentences.zh: 入，則諸侯相攻，多盜，大旱，宮廟火，穀貴；

translations.literal: entering: then feudal lords attack one another, many bandits, great drought, palace temples burn, grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, feudal lords will attack one another, bandits will be many, great drought will come, palace temples will burn, and grain will be dear;
