translations.literal: seven days not departing: there is an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: If it does not depart for seven days, an amnesty will be proclaimed.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: the state lord troubled;
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, the ruler of the state will be troubled;

sentences.zh: 出，則其分有謀，又爲水災，宮中火，下謀上，有亂兵；

translations.literal: emerging: then its allotment has plotting; also flood calamity, fire in the palace, subordinates plot against superiors, there are disorderly armies;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, its allotted region will harbor plotting; flood calamity will follow, fires will break out in the palace, subordinates will plot against superiors, and disorderly armies will arise;

translations.literal: entering: then means fire, great ministers rebel.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, fire calamity is foretold and great ministers will rebel.

translations.literal: A broom star trespassing and entering: subordinates plot against superiors, there are disorderly armies;
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star trespasses and enters, subordinates will plot against superiors and disorderly armies will arise;

translations.literal: emerging: then means armies, plague, the state troubled.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, armies and plague will follow and the state will be troubled.

translations.literal: A shooting star entering: southern barbarians come bearing tribute;
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star enters, southern barbarians will come bearing tribute;

sentences.zh: 犯之，宰相憂，在春天子壽，夏爲水，秋則相黜，冬大臣逆；

translations.literal: trespassing it: the chancellor troubled; in spring the Son of Heaven's longevity, in summer water, in autumn the minister dismissed, in winter great ministers rebel;
translations.idiomatic: If it trespasses it, the chancellor will be troubled; in spring the Son of Heaven enjoys long life, in summer flooding is foretold, in autumn the minister will be dismissed, and in winter great ministers will rebel;

translations.literal: color red and emerging from the Dipper: great ministers die.
translations.idiomatic: If red in color and emerging from the Dipper, great ministers will die.

translations.literal: cloud-vapor entering, pale: much wind;
translations.idiomatic: If cloud-vapor enters pale, wind will be abundant;

translations.literal: red: drought;
translations.idiomatic: if red, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: emerging: armies rise, palace temples burn;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, armies will rise and palace temples will burn;

translations.literal: entering: there are two red vapors, armies;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters with two red vapors, armies will arise;

translations.literal: black: the ruler falls ill.
translations.idiomatic: if black, the ruler will fall ill.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，鬥二十四度四分度之一，唐開元遊儀，二十六度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Dipper twenty-four and one-quarter degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary, twenty-six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary the Dipper was measured at twenty-four and one-quarter degrees; on the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary, twenty-six degrees.

sentences.zh: 去極百十六度，今百十九度。

translations.literal: Polar distance one hundred sixteen degrees; now one hundred nineteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The polar distance was one hundred sixteen degrees; it is now one hundred nineteen degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，亦二十六度，距魁第四星去極百二十二度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: also twenty-six degrees; from the Dipper-head's fourth star, polar distance one hundred twenty-two degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey likewise measured it at twenty-six degrees, with the Dipper-head's fourth star at a polar distance of one hundred twenty-two degrees.

sentences.zh: 鱉十四星，在南斗南，主水族，不居漢中，川有易者。

translations.literal: Soft-shelled Turtle: fourteen stars, south of the Southern Dipper, govern aquatic creatures; if not dwelling in Hanzhong, rivers change course.
translations.idiomatic: The Soft-shelled Turtle's fourteen stars lie south of the Southern Dipper and govern aquatic creatures; if they do not dwell in Hanzhong, rivers will change their courses.

translations.literal: Mars dwelling on them: means drought.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars dwells upon them, drought is foretold.

translations.literal: Mercury dwelling: means fire.
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury dwells upon them, fire calamity is foretold.

translations.literal: A guest star dwelling: means water.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star dwells upon them, flooding is foretold.

translations.literal: A shooting star emerging, color blue-black: means water;
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star emerges blue-black, flooding is foretold;

translations.literal: yellow: means drought.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, drought is foretold.

translations.literal: Cloud-vapor prognostication is the same.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication by cloud-vapor is the same.

sentences.zh: 一曰有星守之，白衣會，主有水。

translations.literal: One account says if a star dwells on them: white-robed assembly, governs water.
translations.idiomatic: One account says that if a star dwells upon them, a white-robed assembly will gather and water is presaged.

sentences.zh: 天淵十星，一曰天池，一曰天泉，一曰天海，在鱉星東南九坎間，又名太陰，主灌溉溝渠。

translations.literal: Celestial Abyss: ten stars, also called the Celestial Pool, also Celestial Spring, also Celestial Sea, among the Nine Pits southeast of the Soft-shelled Turtle stars, also called Grand Yin, governs irrigation ditches and canals.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Abyss comprises ten stars, also called the Celestial Pool, the Celestial Spring, and the Celestial Sea; they lie among the Nine Pits southeast of the Soft-shelled Turtle stars, are also called Grand Yin, and govern irrigation ditches and canals.

translations.literal: The five planets dwelling on them: great flood, the river bursts its banks.
translations.idiomatic: If the five planets dwell upon them, great flooding will follow and rivers will burst their banks.

translations.literal: Mars entering: means drought.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars enters, drought is foretold.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: sea fish emerge.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters, sea fish will emerge.

translations.literal: A comet dwelling on them: rivers overflow and harm people.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet dwells upon them, rivers will overflow and harm people.

sentences.zh: 狗二星，在南斗魁前，主吠守，以不居常處爲災。

translations.literal: Dog: two stars, before the Southern Dipper's head, govern barking and guarding; not dwelling in their usual place is calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The Dog's two stars lie before the Southern Dipper's head and govern barking and watch; calamity is foretold when they do not dwell in their usual place.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing them: means drought.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses them, drought is foretold.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: many earthworks, famine on the northern frontier;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters, earthworks will be many and the northern frontier will famish;

translations.literal: dwelling on them: defensive ministers rise in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon them, ministers charged with defense will rebel.

sentences.zh: 建六星，在南斗魁東北，臨黃道，一曰天旗，天之都關。

translations.literal: Establishment: six stars, northeast of the Southern Dipper's head, bordering the Yellow Path; also called the Celestial Banner, the capital's metropolitan pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Establishment's six stars lie northeast of the Southern Dipper's head along the Yellow Path; they are also called the Celestial Banner and the capital's metropolitan pass.

translations.literal: They govern planning affairs, the Celestial Drum, and the Celestial Horse.
translations.idiomatic: They govern planning affairs, the Celestial Drum, and the Celestial Horse.

translations.literal: The southern two stars are the Celestial Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: The southern pair forms the Celestial Storehouse.

translations.literal: The central two stars are the market and Axe and Halberd.
translations.idiomatic: The central pair is the market and Axe and Halberd.

translations.literal: The upper two stars are the flag's heel.
translations.idiomatic: The upper pair forms the flag's heel.

sentences.zh: 鬥建之間，三光道也，主司七曜行度得失，十一月甲子天正冬至，大曆所起宿也。

translations.literal: Between the Dipper's establishment lies the path of the Three Luminaries; it governs oversight of the seven luminaries' motions and errors; on jiazi of the eleventh month is the celestial standard winter solstice—the lodge from which the great calendar begins.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Dipper's establishment lies the path of the Three Luminaries, presiding over the seven luminaries' motions and deviations; on jiazi of the eleventh month falls the celestial standard winter solstice—the lodge from which the great calendar begins.

translations.literal: stars moving: people suffer forced labor.
translations.idiomatic: If the stars move, the people will suffer forced labor.

translations.literal: The moon trespassing them: ministers alter the Son of Heaven's laws;
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses them, ministers will alter the Son of Heaven's laws;

translations.literal: covering them: there are surrendering troops.
translations.idiomatic: If it covers them, surrendering troops will appear.

sentences.zh: 月食，其分皇后娣侄當黜。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: in its allotted region the empress's younger sisters and nephews should be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse in its allotted region portends dismissal for the empress's younger sisters and nephews.

sentences.zh: 月暈，大將死，五穀不成，蛟龍見，牛馬疫。

translations.literal: A lunar halo: great generals die, the five grains do not ripen, dragons appear, cattle and horses suffer plague.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends the death of great generals, failure of the five grains, the appearance of dragons, and plague among cattle and horses.

sentences.zh: 月與五星犯之，大臣相譖有謀，亦爲關梁不通，大水。

translations.literal: The moon and the five planets trespassing them: great ministers slander one another and plot; also means passes and bridges impassable, great flood.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon and the five planets trespass them, great ministers will slander one another and plot, passes and bridges will be blocked, and great flooding will follow.

sentences.zh: 歲星守，爲旱，糴貴，死者衆，諸侯有謀；

translations.literal: Jupiter dwelling: means drought, grain dear, many dead, feudal lords plot;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter dwells upon them, drought will follow, grain prices will soar, the dead will be many, and feudal lords will plot;

translations.literal: entering: then there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters, armies will arise.

sentences.zh: 熒惑守之，臣有黜者，諸侯有謀，糴貴；

translations.literal: Mars dwelling on them: some ministers are dismissed, feudal lords plot, grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars dwells upon them, some ministers will be dismissed, feudal lords will plot, and grain will be dear;

translations.literal: entering: then passes and bridges impassable, horses costly;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, passes and bridges will be blocked and horses will be costly;

translations.literal: dwelling on the flag's heel thirty days: there are armies.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells on the flag's heel for thirty days, armies will arise.

translations.literal: Saturn dwelling on them: the king has plotting.
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn dwells upon them, the king will harbor plotting.

translations.literal: Venus dwelling: foreign envoys come.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus dwells upon them, foreign envoys will arrive.

sentences.zh: 辰星守，爲水災，米貴，多病。

translations.literal: Mercury dwelling: means flood calamity, rice dear, many illnesses.
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury dwells upon them, flood calamity will follow, rice will be dear, and illness will be widespread.

sentences.zh: 彗、孛、客星犯之，王失道，忠臣黜。

translations.literal: A comet, broom star, or guest star trespassing them: the king loses the Way, loyal ministers dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet, broom star, or guest star trespasses them, the king will lose the Way and loyal ministers will be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，道路不通，多盜。

translations.literal: A guest star dwelling on them: roads impassable, many bandits.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star dwells upon them, roads will be blocked and bandits will be many.

translations.literal: A shooting star entering: below there is plotting;
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star enters, plotting will arise below;

translations.literal: color red: prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: if red in color, prosperity is foretold.

sentences.zh: 天弁九星弁一作辨，在建星北，市官之長，主列肆、闤闠、市籍之事，以知市珍也。

translations.literal: Celestial Cap: nine stars (cap also written as discern), north of the Establishment stars, head of market officials; governs arranging stalls, market lanes, and market registers, to know the market's treasures.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Cap's nine stars (cap also written as discern) lie north of the Establishment stars; as head of market officials they govern stalls, market lanes, and market registers and reveal the market's treasures.

translations.literal: bright and thriving: then the myriad things flourish;
translations.idiomatic: If bright and thriving, the myriad things will flourish;

translations.literal: not bright, and a comet or guest star trespassing: grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: if not bright, or if a comet or guest star trespasses them, grain prices will soar;

translations.literal: long dwelling on them: convicts raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells long upon them, convicts will raise armies.

sentences.zh: 天雞二星，在牛西，一在狗國北，主異鳥，一曰主候時。

translations.literal: Celestial Cock: two stars, west of the Ox, one north of the Dog State, govern strange birds; one account says they govern marking the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Cock's two stars lie west of the Ox, one north of the Dog State; they govern strange birds, though one account says they mark the seasons.

sentences.zh: 熒惑舍之，爲旱，雞多夜鳴。

translations.literal: Mars lodging in them: means drought, cocks crow much at night.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars lodges in them, drought is foretold and cocks will crow much at night.

translations.literal: Venus and Mars trespassing them: means armies.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus and Mars trespass them, armies will arise.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing them: the people scatter in exile.
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn trespasses them, the people will scatter in exile.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: flood and drought untimely;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses them, flood and drought will come untimely;

translations.literal: entering: means great flood.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, great flooding is foretold.

sentences.zh: 狗國四星，在建星東南，主三韓、鮮卑、烏桓、玁狁、沃且之屬。

translations.literal: Dog State: four stars, southeast of the Establishment stars, govern the Three Han, Xianbei, Wuhuan, Xianyun, Woju, and their kind.
translations.idiomatic: The Dog State's four stars lie southeast of the Establishment stars and govern the Three Han, Xianbei, Wuhuan, Xianyun, Woju, and their kind.

translations.literal: stars not complete: the realm has bandits;
translations.idiomatic: if the stars are not complete, bandits will arise throughout the realm;

translations.literal: not bright: then peace;
translations.idiomatic: if not bright, peace will prevail;

translations.literal: bright: then frontier raiders rise.
translations.idiomatic: if bright, frontier raiders will rise.

translations.literal: The moon trespassing them: Wuhuan and Xianbei states in turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses them, the Wuhuan and Xianbei states will fall into turmoil.

translations.literal: Mars dwelling on them: outer barbarians raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars dwells upon them, outer barbarians will raise armies.

translations.literal: Venus dwelling on them: the Xianbei suffer attack.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus dwells upon them, the Xianbei will suffer attack.

translations.literal: A guest star dwelling: their king comes to the Middle Kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star dwells upon them, their king will come to the Middle Kingdom.

sentences.zh: 天籥八星，在南斗杓第二星西，主開閉門戶。

translations.literal: Celestial Key: eight stars, west of the Southern Dipper ladle's second star, govern opening and closing gates and doors.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Key's eight stars lie west of the Southern Dipper ladle's second star and govern the opening and closing of gates and doors.

translations.literal: bright: then auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: if bright, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: not complete: then passes and locks have no restraint.
translations.idiomatic: if not complete, passes and locks will have no restraint.

sentences.zh: 客星、彗星守之，關梁閉塞。

translations.literal: A guest star or comet dwelling on them: passes and bridges blocked.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star or comet dwells upon them, passes and bridges will be blocked.

sentences.zh: 農丈人一星，在南斗西南，老農主稼穡者，又主先農、農正官。

translations.literal: Agricultural Old Man: one star, southwest of the Southern Dipper, an old farmer presiding over sowing and reaping; also governs the First Farmer and the director of agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: The Agricultural Old Man is a single star southwest of the Southern Dipper, an old farmer presiding over sowing and reaping; it also governs the First Farmer and the director of agriculture.

translations.literal: star bright: the year abundant;
translations.idiomatic: If the star is bright, the year will be abundant;

translations.literal: dim: then the people lose their livelihoods;
translations.idiomatic: if dim, the people will lose their livelihoods;

translations.literal: shifting: famine in the year.
translations.idiomatic: if it shifts, famine will afflict the year.

sentences.zh: 客星、彗星守之，民失耕，歲荒。

translations.literal: A guest star or comet dwelling on it: the people lose plowing, the year is waste.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star or comet dwells upon it, the people will abandon plowing and the year will be barren.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，已上諸星皆屬南斗。

translations.literal: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the above stars belong to the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the stars above belong to the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 《晉志》以狗國、天雞、天弁、天籥、建星皆屬天市垣，餘在二十八宿之外。

translations.literal: The 《Book of Jin》 assigns Dog State, Celestial Cock, Celestial Cap, Celestial Key, and Establishment stars all to the Celestial Market Enclosure; the rest lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Book of Jin》 assigns the Dog State, Celestial Cock, Celestial Cap, Celestial Key, and Establishment stars to the Celestial Market Enclosure, while the rest lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以天籥、農丈人屬箕，武密又以天籥屬尾，互有不同。

translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns Celestial Key and Agricultural Old Man to the Winnowing Basket; Wu Mi again assigns Celestial Key to the Tail—they differ from one another.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns the Celestial Key and Agricultural Old Man to the Winnowing Basket, while Wu Mi again assigns the Celestial Key to the Tail—the reckonings differ.

sentences.zh: 牛宿六星，天之關梁，主犧牲事。

translations.literal: The Ox Lodge's six stars are Heaven's passes and bridges; they govern sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Ox Lodge's six stars form Heaven's passes and bridges and govern sacrificial offerings.

sentences.zh: 其北二星，一曰即路，一曰聚火。

translations.literal: Its northern two stars: one is called Immediate Road, one Gathered Fire.
translations.idiomatic: Its northern pair comprises Immediate Road and Gathered Fire.

sentences.zh: 又曰：上一星主道路，次二星主關梁，次三星主南越。

translations.literal: Another account says: the upper star governs roads; the next two govern passes and bridges; the next three govern Southern Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Another account says the upper star governs roads, the next two govern passes and bridges, and the next three govern Southern Yue.

sentences.zh: 明大，則王道昌，關梁通，牛貴；

translations.literal: bright and large: then the kingly Way flourishes, passes and bridges open, oxen costly;
translations.idiomatic: If bright and large, the kingly Way will flourish, passes and bridges will open, and oxen will be costly;

translations.literal: angry: then horses costly;
translations.idiomatic: if angry in aspect, horses will be costly;

translations.literal: moving: then ox calamity, many deaths;
translations.idiomatic: if they move, oxen will suffer calamity and deaths will be many;

translations.literal: first emerging and color yellow: great beans cheap;
translations.idiomatic: if they first emerge yellow, great beans will be cheap;

translations.literal: red: then beans have insects;
translations.idiomatic: if red, beans will harbor insects;

translations.literal: green: then great beans costly;
translations.idiomatic: if green, great beans will be costly;

translations.literal: stars straight: grain cheap;
translations.idiomatic: if the stars stand straight, grain will be cheap;

translations.literal: curved: then costly.
translations.idiomatic: if curved, grain will be costly.

translations.literal: A solar eclipse: in its allotted region armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in its allotted region portends rising armies;

translations.literal: A halo: the yin states are troubled, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: A halo portends distress for the yin states and rising armies.

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: there are armies;
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse portends armies;

sentences.zh: 暈，爲水災，女子貴，五穀不成，牛多暴死，小兒多疾。

translations.literal: A halo: means flood calamity, women costly, the five grains do not ripen, many oxen die suddenly, many children fall ill.
translations.idiomatic: A halo portends flood calamity, dear prices for women, failure of the five grains, sudden death among oxen, and widespread illness among children.

sentences.zh: 月暈在冬三月，百四十日外有赦；

translations.literal: A lunar halo in the winter's third month: beyond one hundred forty days there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo in the winter's third month foretells an amnesty after one hundred forty days;

translations.literal: A halo's central great star: a great general is executed.
translations.idiomatic: If the halo's central great star is bright, a great general will be executed.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，有水，牛多死，其國有憂。

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: there is water, many oxen die, its state has distress.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, flooding will follow, many oxen will die, and its state will suffer distress.

translations.literal: Jupiter entering and trespassing: then feudal lords miss their rendezvous;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter enters and trespasses it, feudal lords will miss their rendezvous;

translations.literal: remaining and dwelling: then many oxen suffer plague, the five grains harmed;
translations.idiomatic: if it remains and dwells, many oxen will suffer plague and the five grains will be harmed;

translations.literal: east of the Ox: unfavorable to small children;
translations.idiomatic: east of the Ox, small children will fare ill;

translations.literal: west: governs wind and snow;
translations.idiomatic: west, wind and snow are presaged;

translations.literal: north: means the people scatter;
translations.idiomatic: north, the people will scatter;

translations.literal: retrograde: fire in the palace;
translations.idiomatic: if retrograde, fire will break out in the palace;

sentences.zh: 居三十日至九十日，天下和平，道德明正。

translations.literal: dwelling from thirty to ninety days: the realm peaceful, virtue and righteousness clear and upright.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells from thirty to ninety days, the realm will be peaceful and virtue and righteousness will shine clear.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯之，諸侯多疾，臣謀主；

translations.literal: Mars trespassing it: feudal lords mostly ill, ministers plot against the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: If Mars trespasses it, feudal lords will suffer illness and ministers will plot against the ruler;

translations.literal: dwelling: then grain does not ripen, armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells, grain will fail to ripen and armies will rise;

translations.literal: entering or emerging and dwelling south of the Dipper: amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: If it enters or emerges and dwells south of the Dipper, an amnesty will be proclaimed.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing it: there are earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: If Saturn trespasses it, earthworks will be undertaken;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: rain and snow, people and cattle and horses ill.
translations.idiomatic: If it dwells upon it, rain and snow will follow and people, cattle, and horses will fall ill.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing it: feudal lords do not communicate;
translations.idiomatic: If Venus trespasses it, feudal lords will not communicate;

translations.literal: dwelling: then the state has armies rising;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells, armies will rise in the state;

translations.literal: entering: then means military plotting, many people die.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, military plotting will follow and many people will die.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯，敗軍移將，臣謀主。

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: defeated armies shift generals, ministers plot against the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: If Mercury trespasses it, defeated armies will shift their generals and ministers will plot against the ruler.

sentences.zh: 客星犯守之，牛馬貴，越地起兵；

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing and dwelling on it: cattle and horses costly, Yue lands raise armies;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses and dwells upon it, cattle and horses will be costly and the Yue lands will raise armies;

translations.literal: emerging: many oxen die, the earth quakes, horses costly.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, many oxen will die, the earth will quake, and horses will be costly.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing it: the Wu allotment has armies rising;
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses it, armies will rise in the Wu allotment;

translations.literal: emerging: means grain dear, oxen die.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, grain prices will soar and oxen will die.

sentences.zh: 孛犯，改元易號，糴貴，牛多死，吳、越兵起，下當有自立者。

translations.literal: A broom star trespassing: the era name and reign title are changed, grain dear, many oxen die, Wu and Yue raise armies, below there will be one who establishes himself.
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star trespasses it, the era name and reign title will be changed, grain prices will soar, many oxen will die, Wu and Yue will raise armies, and below someone will establish himself.

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing it: the king wishes to alter affairs;
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star trespasses it, the king will wish to alter affairs;

translations.literal: spring and summer: grain ripens;
translations.idiomatic: in spring and summer, grain will ripen;

translations.literal: autumn and winter: grain costly;
translations.idiomatic: in autumn and winter, grain will be costly;

translations.literal: color black: cattle and horses flourish, passes and bridges bring tribute.
translations.idiomatic: if black in color, cattle and horses will flourish and passes and bridges will bring tribute.

translations.literal: cloud-vapor pale white crossing horizontally: there are armies and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: pale white cloud-vapor crossing horizontally portends armies and mourning;

translations.literal: red: also means armies;
translations.idiomatic: if red, armies are also foretold;

translations.literal: yellow-white vapor entering: oxen multiply;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white vapor enters, oxen will multiply;

translations.literal: black: then oxen die.
translations.idiomatic: if black, oxen will die.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以牽牛爲七度，唐開元遊儀八度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Led Ox was reckoned at seven degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary, eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary the Led Ox was measured at seven degrees; on the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary, eight degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極百六度，今百四度。

translations.literal: Former polar distance one hundred six degrees; now one hundred four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The former polar distance was one hundred six degrees; it is now one hundred four degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，牛六星八度，距中央大星去極百十度半。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: the Ox six stars eight degrees; from the central great star, polar distance one hundred ten and a half degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey measured the Ox six stars at eight degrees, with the central great star at a polar distance of one hundred ten and a half degrees.

sentences.zh: 天田九星，在鬥南，一曰在牛東南，天子畿內之田。

translations.literal: Celestial Field: nine stars, south of the Dipper, one account says southeast of the Ox, the fields within the Son of Heaven inner domain.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Field nine stars lie south of the Dipper—one account says southeast of the Ox—and mark the fields within the Son of Heaven inner domain.

translations.literal: Its prognostication is the same as the Celestial Field north of the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Its prognostication matches that of the Celestial Field north of the Horn.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing them: the realm is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses them, the realm will be troubled.

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing and dwelling on them: farmers lose their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or broom star trespasses and dwells upon them, farmers will lose their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 河鼓三星，在牽牛西北，主天鼓，蓋天子及將軍鼓也。

translations.literal: River Drum: three stars, northwest of the Led Ox, govern the Celestial Drum—the drum of the Son of Heaven and generals.
translations.idiomatic: The River Drum three stars lie northwest of the Led Ox and govern the Celestial Drum, the drum of the Son of Heaven and his generals.

sentences.zh: 一曰三鼓，主天子三將軍，中央大星爲大將軍，左星爲左將軍，右星爲右將軍。

translations.literal: Also called the Three Drums; they govern the Son of Heaven three generals—the central great star is the great general, the left star the left general, the right star the right general.
translations.idiomatic: They are also called the Three Drums and govern the Son of Heaven three generals: the central great star is the great general, the left the left general, and the right the right general.

sentences.zh: 左星，南星也，所以備關梁而拒難也，設守險阻，知謀徵也。

translations.literal: The left star is the southern star, for preparing passes and bridges and repelling hardship, setting defenses at perilous places, and knowing when plotting appears.
translations.idiomatic: The left star is the southern star, for preparing passes and bridges, repelling hardship, setting defenses at perilous places, and discerning plotting.

sentences.zh: 鼓欲正直而明，色黃光澤，將吉；

translations.literal: The drums should be upright and bright, color yellow and lustrous: the generals are auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: The drums should stand upright and bright, yellow and lustrous: then the generals are auspicious;

translations.literal: not upright: means armies and distress;
translations.idiomatic: if not upright, armies and distress are foretold;

translations.literal: stars angry: then horses costly;
translations.idiomatic: if the stars show anger, horses will be costly;

translations.literal: moving: then armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if they move, armies will rise;

translations.literal: curved: then the general loses his plan and his momentum;
translations.idiomatic: if curved, the general will lose his plan and his momentum;

translations.literal: having rays and horns: the general is fierce and savage in aspect;
translations.idiomatic: if they show rays and horns, the general will be fierce and savage in aspect;

translations.literal: trembling disorderly, degrees in disarray: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: if trembling disorderly with degrees in disarray, armies will rise.

translations.literal: The moon trespassing them: armies defeated and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses them, armies will be defeated and destroyed.

translations.literal: The five planets trespassing them: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: If the five planets trespass them, armies will rise.

translations.literal: A comet or guest star trespassing: the general is executed.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or guest star trespasses them, the general will be executed.

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing: feudal lords rebel.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star trespasses them, feudal lords will rebel.

translations.literal: yellow-white cloud-vapor entering: the Son of Heaven rejoices;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white cloud-vapor enters, the Son of Heaven will rejoice;

translations.literal: red: armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if red, armies will rise;

translations.literal: emerging: then battle is victorious;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, battle will be victorious;

translations.literal: black: the general dies.
translations.idiomatic: if black, the general will die.

translations.literal: green vapor entering: the general is troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if green vapor enters, the general will be troubled;

translations.literal: emerging: then calamity is removed.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, calamity will be removed.

sentences.zh: 左旗九星，在河鼓左旁，右旗九星，在牽牛北、河鼓西南，天之鼓旗旌表也。

translations.literal: Left Banner nine stars, beside the River Drum left; Right Banner nine stars, north of the Led Ox and southwest of the River Drum—Heaven drum flags and pennants.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Banner nine stars lie beside the River Drum left; the Right Banner nine stars north of the Led Ox and southwest of the River Drum—Heaven drum flags and pennants.

translations.literal: They govern sound, setting defenses, and knowing the enemy plot.
translations.idiomatic: They govern sound, setting defenses, and knowing the enemy plot.

translations.literal: banner stars bright and large: the general is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: If the banner stars are bright and large, the general is auspicious.

translations.literal: The five planets trespassing and dwelling: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: If the five planets trespass and dwell upon them, armies will rise.

sentences.zh: 織女三星，在天市垣東北，一曰在天紀東，天女也，主果蓏、絲帛、珍寶。

translations.literal: Weaving Maiden three stars, northeast of the Celestial Market Enclosure, one account says east of the Celestial Chronogram—a celestial woman governing fruits, silk, and treasures.
translations.idiomatic: The Weaving Maiden three stars lie northeast of the Celestial Market Enclosure—one account says east of the Celestial Chronogram—a celestial woman governing fruits, silk, and treasures.

sentences.zh: 王者至孝，神祗鹹喜，則星俱明，天下和平；

translations.literal: When the king reaches utmost filial piety and the spirits all rejoice, then the stars are all bright and the realm is peaceful;
translations.idiomatic: When the king reaches utmost filial piety and the spirits all rejoice, the stars will all shine bright and the realm will be peaceful;

translations.literal: stars angry with horns: cloth and silk costly.
translations.idiomatic: if the stars show anger with horns, cloth and silk will be costly.

sentences.zh: 陶隱居曰：「常以十月朔至六七日晨見東方。

translations.literal: Tao Hongjing said: "It is regularly seen in the east on the first to sixth or seventh day of the tenth month at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Hongjing wrote: "It is regularly seen in the east at dawn from the first to the sixth or seventh day of the tenth month.

translations.literal: " When color red and essence bright: women artisans are skilled;
translations.idiomatic: " When red and bright in essence, women artisans will be skilled;

translations.literal: stars vanished: armies rise, women become scouts.
translations.idiomatic: if the stars vanish, armies will rise and women will serve as scouts.

translations.literal: The Weaving Maiden feet should regularly face the Supporting Basket: then auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: If the Weaving Maiden feet regularly face the Supporting Basket, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: not facing: then silk and floss are greatly costly.
translations.idiomatic: if not facing, silk and floss will be greatly costly.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: in its allotted region armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo in its allotted region portends rising armies.

sentences.zh: 熒惑守之，公主憂，絲帛貴，兵起。

translations.literal: Mars dwelling on them: the princess troubled, silk costly, armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars dwells upon them, the princess will be troubled, silk will be costly, and armies will rise.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: the consort clans troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses them, the consort clans will be troubled.

translations.literal: A broom star: then there is mourning for a woman.
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star appears, mourning for a woman is foretold.

translations.literal: A guest star entering, color green: means famine;
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters green, famine is foretold;

translations.literal: red: means armies;
translations.idiomatic: if red, armies are foretold;

translations.literal: yellow: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: white: means mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if white, mourning is foretold;

translations.literal: black: means water.
translations.idiomatic: if black, water calamity is foretold.

translations.literal: A shooting star entering: there is water and bandits, the chief consort troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star enters, flooding and bandits will follow and the chief consort will be troubled.

translations.literal: cloud-vapor entering, pale: women troubled;
translations.idiomatic: If cloud-vapor enters pale, women will be troubled;

translations.literal: red: then mourning death among women-at-arms;
translations.idiomatic: if red, women-at-arms will die in battle;

translations.literal: color yellow: a woman is advanced.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, a woman will be advanced.

sentences.zh: 漸台四星，在織女東南，臨水之台也，主晷漏、律呂事。

translations.literal: Stepping Tower four stars, southeast of the Weaving Maiden, a tower by the water governing sundials, clepsydrae, and pitch-pipes.
translations.idiomatic: The Stepping Tower four stars lie southeast of the Weaving Maiden, a waterside tower governing sundials, clepsydrae, and pitch-pipes.

translations.literal: bright: then yin and yang are harmonized and pitch-pipes accord;
translations.idiomatic: If bright, yin and yang will be harmonized and the pitch-pipes will accord;

translations.literal: not bright: then clepsydrae are constantly unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: if not bright, clepsydrae will be constantly unsettled.

sentences.zh: 客星、彗星犯之，陰陽反戾。

translations.literal: A guest star or comet trespassing them: yin and yang turn contrary.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star or comet trespasses them, yin and yang will turn contrary.

sentences.zh: 輦道五星，在織女西，主王者遊嬉之道。

translations.literal: Imperial Carriage Road five stars, west of the Weaving Maiden, govern the king road of pleasure excursions.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Carriage Road five stars lie west of the Weaving Maiden and govern the king road of pleasure excursions.

sentences.zh: 漢輦道通南北宮，其象也。

translations.literal: The Han imperial carriage road connected the southern and northern palaces—this is its image.
translations.idiomatic: The Han imperial carriage road connected the southern and northern palaces—this is its image.

sentences.zh: 太白、熒惑守之，御路兵起。

translations.literal: Venus and Mars dwelling on them: armies rise on the imperial road.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus and Mars dwell upon them, armies will rise on the imperial road.

sentences.zh: 九坎九星，在牽牛南，主溝渠、導引泉源、疏瀉盈溢，又主水旱。

translations.literal: Nine Pits nine stars, south of the Led Ox, govern ditches and canals, conducting spring sources, draining overflow, and also govern flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Pits nine stars lie south of the Led Ox and govern ditches and canals, conducting spring sources, draining overflow, and also flood and drought.

translations.literal: stars bright: means flood calamity;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars are bright, flood calamity is foretold;

translations.literal: minute and small: auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: if minute and small, the omen is auspicious.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: means water;
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends water;

translations.literal: The five planets trespassing them: water overflows.
translations.idiomatic: If the five planets trespass them, water will overflow.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: the realm is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters, the realm will be troubled.

translations.literal: cloud-vapor entering, green: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: if cloud-vapor enters green, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: black: means water overflow.
translations.idiomatic: if black, water will overflow.

sentences.zh: 羅堰三星，在牽牛東，拒馬也，主堤塘，壅蓄水源以灌溉也。

translations.literal: Network Dam three stars, east of the Led Ox, blocking horses, governing embankments, damming and storing water sources for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: The Network Dam three stars lie east of the Led Ox, blocking horses, governing embankments and damming water sources for irrigation.

translations.literal: stars bright and large: then water floods and overflows.
translations.idiomatic: If the stars are bright and large, water will flood and overflow.

sentences.zh: 天桴四星，在牽牛東北橫列，一曰在左旗端，鼓桴也，主漏刻。

translations.literal: Celestial Beat four stars, arrayed horizontally northeast of the Led Ox, one account says at the Left Banner end—drumsticks governing clepsydra markings.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Beat four stars array horizontally northeast of the Led Ox—one account says at the Left Banner end—as drumsticks governing clepsydra markings.

translations.literal: dim: then clepsydra markings miss the time.
translations.idiomatic: If dim, clepsydra markings will miss the time.

translations.literal: Wu Mi said: "They govern the use of drumsticks and drums.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi wrote: "They govern the use of drumsticks and drums.

translations.literal: " trembling: then military drums are used;
translations.idiomatic: " If they tremble, military drums will be used;

sentences.zh: 前近河鼓，若桴鼓相直，皆爲桴鼓用。

translations.literal: near the River Drum ahead, if drumstick and drum align straight, both drumstick and drum are used.
translations.idiomatic: if near the River Drum ahead the drumstick and drum align straight, both drumstick and drum are used.

translations.literal: Venus and Mars dwelling on them: war drums rise.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus and Mars dwell upon them, war drums will rise.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing them: clepsydra markings miss the time.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses them, clepsydra markings will miss the time.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，已上諸星俱屬牛宿。

translations.literal: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the above stars belong to the Ox Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the stars above belong to the Ox Lodge.

sentences.zh: 《晉志》以織女、漸台、輦道皆屬太微垣，以河鼓、左旗、右旗、天桴屬天市垣，餘在二十八宿之外。

translations.literal: The 《Book of Jin》 assigns Weaving Maiden, Stepping Tower, and Imperial Carriage Road to the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and River Drum, Left Banner, Right Banner, and Celestial Beat to the Celestial Market Enclosure; the rest lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Book of Jin》 assigns the Weaving Maiden, Stepping Tower, and Imperial Carriage Road to the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and the River Drum, Left Banner, Right Banner, and Celestial Beat to the Celestial Market Enclosure, while the rest lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.

sentences.zh: 武密以左旗屬箕屬鬥，右旗亦屬鬥，漸臺屬鬥，又屬牛，余與《步天歌》同。

translations.literal: Wu Mi assigns the Left Banner to the Winnowing Basket and to the Dipper, the Right Banner also to the Dipper, the Stepping Tower to the Dipper and again to the Ox—the rest agree with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi assigns the Left Banner to the Winnowing Basket and Dipper, the Right Banner also to the Dipper, and the Stepping Tower to the Dipper and again to the Ox—the rest agree with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》則又以左旗、織女、漸台、輦道、九坎皆屬於鬥。

translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 again assigns Left Banner, Weaving Maiden, Stepping Tower, Imperial Carriage Road, and Nine Pits all to the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 again assigns the Left Banner, Weaving Maiden, Stepping Tower, Imperial Carriage Road, and Nine Pits all to the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 須女四星，天之少府，賤妾之稱，婦職之卑者也，主布帛裁制、嫁娶。

translations.literal: Maiden four stars, Heaven Lesser Treasury, the title of humble concubines, the lowliest of wifely duties, governing cloth and silk cutting and marriage.
translations.idiomatic: The Maiden four stars form Heaven Lesser Treasury, the title of humble concubines and the lowliest of wifely duties, governing cloth, silk cutting, and marriage.

translations.literal: stars bright: the realm abundant, women skillful, the state wealthy;
translations.idiomatic: If the stars are bright, the realm will be abundant, women skillful, and the state wealthy;

translations.literal: small and not bright: the opposite.
translations.idiomatic: if small and not bright, the opposite is foretold.

sentences.zh: 日食在女，戒在巫祝、後妃禱祠，又占越分饑，後妃疾。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse in the Maiden: warning to shamans and sacrificial prayers of empresses and consorts; further prognostication: Yue allotment famines, empress and consorts ill.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in the Maiden warns shamans and sacrificial prayers of empresses and consorts; further prognostication: famine in the Yue allotment and illness for empress and consorts.

translations.literal: A solar halo: distress for the inner palace and chief consort.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo portends distress for the inner palace and chief consort.

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: armies and drought, the state troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse portends armies, drought, and distress for the state.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: military plotting does not succeed;
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends that military plotting will not succeed;

translations.literal: double and triple halos: the chief consort dies.
translations.idiomatic: double and triple halos portend the death of the chief consort.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，有女惑，有兵不戰而降，又曰將軍死。

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: there is a woman seduction, armies that do not fight yet surrender; another account says the general dies.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, a woman will seduce, armies will surrender without fighting; another account says the general will die.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯之，後妃喜，外國進女；

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing it: the empress and consorts rejoice, foreign states present women;
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter trespasses it, empress and consorts will rejoice and foreign states will present women;

sentences.zh: 守之，多水，國饑，喪，糴貴，民大災，熒惑犯之，大臣、皇后憂，布帛貴，民大災；

translations.literal: dwelling on it: much water, the state famines, mourning, grain dear, the people suffer great calamity; Mars trespassing: great ministers and the empress troubled, cloth costly, the people suffer great calamity;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, water will be abundant, the state will famish, mourning will follow, grain will be dear, and the people will suffer great calamity; if Mars trespasses it, great ministers and the empress will be troubled, cloth will be costly, and the people will suffer great calamity;

sentences.zh: 守之，土人不安，五穀不熟，民疾，有女喪，又爲兵；

translations.literal: dwelling on it: native peoples unsettled, the five grains do not ripen, the people suffer illness, mourning for a woman, also means armies;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, native peoples will be unsettled, the five grains will fail to ripen, the people will fall ill, mourning for a woman will follow, and armies will arise;

translations.literal: entering: then grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, grain prices will soar;

translations.literal: retrograde trespassing and dwelling: great ministers troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if retrograde it trespasses and dwells, great ministers will be troubled;

translations.literal: dwelling in the yang position: joy;
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling in the yang position, joy is foretold;

translations.literal: yin: means distress.
translations.idiomatic: if in the yin position, distress is foretold.

sentences.zh: 填星犯守，有苛政，山水出，壞民舍，女謁行，後專政，多妖女；

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing and dwelling: there is harsh government, mountains and rivers overflow, the people's dwellings are ruined, women petitioners act, the empress wields government, many seductive women;
translations.idiomatic: if Saturn trespasses and dwells, harsh government will follow, mountains and rivers will overflow, dwellings will be ruined, women petitioners will act, the empress will wield government, and seductive women will be many;

translations.literal: remaining fifty days: the people scatter in exile.
translations.idiomatic: if it remains fifty days, the people will scatter in exile.

sentences.zh: 太白犯之，布帛貴，兵起，天下多寡女；

translations.literal: Venus trespassing it: cloth and silk costly, armies rise, the realm has many widows;
translations.idiomatic: if Venus trespasses it, cloth and silk will be costly, armies will rise, and the realm will have many widows;

translations.literal: remaining and dwelling: mourning for a woman, armies mobilize.
translations.idiomatic: if it remains and dwells, mourning for a woman is foretold and armies will mobilize.

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: the state famines, the people suffer illness;
translations.idiomatic: if Mercury trespasses it, the state will famish and the people will suffer illness;

sentences.zh: 守之，天下水，有赦，南地火，北地水，又兵起，布帛貴。

translations.literal: dwelling on it: flooding throughout the realm, an amnesty, fire in the southern lands, flood in the northern lands, also armies rise, cloth costly.
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, flooding will spread throughout the realm, an amnesty will be proclaimed, the south will see fire and the north flood, armies will rise, and cloth will be costly.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: armies rise, women rebel;
translations.idiomatic: if a guest star trespasses it, armies will rise and women will rebel;

sentences.zh: 守之，宮人憂，諸侯有兵，江淮不通，糴貴。

translations.literal: dwelling on it: palace women troubled, feudal lords have armies, the Huai and Jiang impassable, grain dear.
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, palace women will be troubled, feudal lords will raise armies, the Huai and Jiang will be impassable, and grain will be dear.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: armies rise, women rebel;
translations.idiomatic: if a comet trespasses it, armies will rise and women will rebel;

sentences.zh: 出，爲兵亂，有水災，米鹽貴。

translations.literal: emerging: armies in turmoil, flood calamity, rice and salt dear.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, armies will fall into turmoil, flood calamity will follow, and rice and salt will be dear.

sentences.zh: 星孛，其分兵起，女爲亂，有奇女來進；

translations.literal: A broom star: in its allotment armies rise, women rebel, a remarkable woman comes forward;
translations.idiomatic: if a broom star appears, armies will rise in its allotment, women will rebel, and a remarkable woman will come forward;

translations.literal: entering and emerging: the state has distress, the king finds it dire.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters and emerges, the state will suffer distress and the king will find the omen dire.

sentences.zh: 流星犯，天子納美女，又曰有貴女下獄；

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing: the Son of Heaven receives beautiful women; another account says a noble woman is imprisoned;
translations.idiomatic: if a shooting star trespasses it, the Son of Heaven will receive beautiful women; another account says a noble woman will be imprisoned;

translations.literal: reaching the Maiden: the chief consort dies.
translations.idiomatic: if it reaches the Maiden, the chief consort will die.

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》：出入而色黃潤，立妃後；

translations.literal: The Yisi Treatise: emerging and color yellow and moist: establish an empress or consort;
translations.idiomatic: The Yisi Treatise says: if it emerges yellow and moist, an empress or consort will be established;

translations.literal: white: mourning death in the inner palace concubines.
translations.idiomatic: if white, concubines in the inner palace will die.

translations.literal: cloud-vapor entering, yellow-white: there is a daughter's marriage;
translations.idiomatic: if cloud-vapor enters yellow-white, a daughter's marriage is foretold;

translations.literal: white: many women fall ill;
translations.idiomatic: if white, many women will fall ill;

translations.literal: black: many women die;
translations.idiomatic: if black, many women will die;

translations.literal: red: then many women die in armies.
translations.idiomatic: if red, many women will die in armies.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以須女爲十一度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Maiden was reckoned at eleven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary the Maiden Lodge was measured at eleven degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，十二度，距西南星去極百五度，在赤道外十四度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: twelve degrees; from the southwest star, polar distance one hundred five degrees, fourteen degrees south of the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey measured it at twelve degrees, with the southwest star at a polar distance of one hundred five degrees, fourteen degrees south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 十二國十六星，在牛女南，近九坎，各分土居列國之象。

translations.literal: Twelve States sixteen stars, south of the Ox and Maiden, near the Nine Pits, each governing the image of a state dwelling in its allotted territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Twelve States sixteen stars lie south of the Ox and Maiden, near the Nine Pits, each marking a state dwelling in its allotted territory.

sentences.zh: 九坎之東一星曰齊，齊北二星曰趙，趙北一星曰鄭，鄭北一星曰越，越東二星曰周，周東南北列二星曰秦，秦南二星曰代，代西一星曰晉，晉北一星曰韓，韓北一星曰魏，魏西一星曰楚，楚南一星曰燕，有變動，各以其國占之。

translations.literal: East of the Nine Pits one star is called Qi; north of Qi two stars are called Zhao; north of Zhao one star is called Zheng; north of Zheng one star is called Yue; east of Yue two stars are called Zhou; east of Zhou north and south in a row two stars are called Qin; south of Qin two stars are called Dai; west of Dai one star is called Jin; north of Jin one star is called Han; north of Han one star is called Wei; west of Wei one star is called Chu; south of Chu one star is called Yan; if there is change, each is prognosticated by its state.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Nine Pits, one star is Qi; north of Qi are Zhao's two stars; north of Zhao is Zheng; north of Zheng is Yue; east of Yue are Zhou's two stars; east of Zhou in a north-south row are Qin's two stars; south of Qin are Dai's two stars; west of Dai is Jin; north of Jin is Han; north of Han is Wei; west of Wei is Chu; south of Chu is Yan; if they change, prognosticate by each state.

sentences.zh: 陶隱居曰：「越星在婺女南，鄭一星在越北，趙二星在鄭南，週二星在越東，楚一星在魏西南，燕一星在楚南，韓一星在晉北，晉一星在代北，代二星在秦南，齊一星在燕東。」

translations.literal: Tao Hongjing said: "The Yue star is south of the Maiden; Zheng's one star is north of Yue; Zhao's two stars are south of Zheng; Zhou's two stars are east of Yue; Chu's one star is southwest of Wei; Yan's one star is south of Chu; Han's one star is north of Jin; Jin's one star is north of Dai; Dai's two stars are south of Qin; Qi's one star is east of Yan."
translations.idiomatic: Tao Hongjing wrote: "The Yue star lies south of the Maiden; Zheng's star north of Yue; Zhao's two south of Zheng; Zhou's two east of Yue; Chu's southwest of Wei; Yan's south of Chu; Han's north of Jin; Jin's north of Dai; Dai's two south of Qin; Qi's east of Yan."

sentences.zh: 離珠五星，在須女北，須女之藏府，女子之星也。

translations.literal: Pearls Apart five stars, north of the Maiden, the Maiden's treasury storehouse, stars of women.
translations.idiomatic: The Pearls Apart five stars lie north of the Maiden, the Maiden's treasury storehouse, marking women's stars.

sentences.zh: 又曰：主天子旒珠、後夫人環珮。

translations.literal: Another account says: they govern the Son of Heaven's tasselled beads and the chief consort's rings and pendants.
translations.idiomatic: Another account says they govern the Son of Heaven's tasselled beads and the chief consort's rings and pendants.

translations.literal: departing the yang: drought;
translations.idiomatic: if departing the yang, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: departing the yin: flooding.
translations.idiomatic: if departing the yin, flooding is foretold.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing them: distress in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star trespasses them, the inner palace will suffer distress.

sentences.zh: 奚仲四星，在天津北，主帝車之官。

translations.literal: Xi Zhong four stars, north of Celestial Ford, govern the officials of the imperial carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Zhong's four stars lie north of the Celestial Ford and govern officials of the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 凡太白、熒惑守之，爲兵祥。

translations.literal: Whenever Venus or Mars dwell on them, it is an omen of armies.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Venus or Mars dwell upon them, armies are portended.

sentences.zh: 天津九星，在虛宿北，橫河中，一曰天漢，一曰天江，主四瀆津梁，所以度神通四方也。

translations.literal: Celestial Ford nine stars, north of the Emptiness Lodge, spanning the river, also called the Celestial Han, also the Celestial River, governing the four waterways' fords and bridges, for crossing and communicating with the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Ford's nine stars lie north of the Emptiness Lodge across the river, also called the Celestial Han and Celestial River, governing the four waterways' fords and bridges for crossing the four directions.

translations.literal: one star not complete: fords and bridges impassable;
translations.idiomatic: if one star is not complete, fords and bridges will be impassable;

translations.literal: bright: then armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if bright, armies will rise;

translations.literal: uneven: horses costly;
translations.idiomatic: if uneven, horses will be costly;

translations.literal: large: then flood calamity;
translations.idiomatic: if large, flood calamity will follow;

translations.literal: shifting: then water overflows.
translations.idiomatic: if shifting, water will overflow.

sentences.zh: 彗、孛犯之，津敗，道路有賊。

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing them: fords defeated, bandits on the roads.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or broom star trespasses them, fords will be defeated and bandits will roam the roads.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: bridges not repaired;
translations.idiomatic: if a guest star trespasses them, bridges will not be repaired;

translations.literal: dwelling on them: waterways impassable, boats costly.
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon them, waterways will be impassable and boats will be costly.

sentences.zh: 流星出，必有使出，隨分野占之。

translations.literal: A shooting star emerging: there will certainly be envoys sent forth; prognosticate by allotted region.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star emerges, envoys will certainly be sent; prognosticate by allotted region.

translations.literal: red cloud-vapor entering: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: if red cloud-vapor enters, drought is foretold;

translations.literal: yellow-white: the Son of Heaven has a decree of virtue;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white, the Son of Heaven will issue a decree of virtue;

translations.literal: black: means great flood;
translations.idiomatic: if black, great flooding is foretold;

translations.literal: color pale: means water and distress;
translations.idiomatic: if pale, water calamity and distress are foretold;

translations.literal: emerging: then calamity is removed.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, calamity will be removed.

sentences.zh: 敗瓜五星，在匏瓜星南，主修瓜果之職，與匏瓜同占。

translations.literal: Ruined Melon five stars, south of the Gourd stars, governing the office of tending melons and fruits, prognosticated the same as Gourd.
translations.idiomatic: The Ruined Melon five stars lie south of the Gourd stars, governing tending melons and fruits, with prognostication the same as Gourd.

sentences.zh: 匏瓜五星一作瓠瓜，在離珠北，天子果園也，其西觜星主後宮，不明，則後失勢；

translations.literal: Gourd five stars (also written as bottle gourd), north of Pearls Apart, the Son of Heaven's orchard; west of them the Turtle Beak star governs the inner palace—if not bright, the empress loses power;
translations.idiomatic: The Gourd five stars (also bottle gourd) lie north of Pearls Apart, the Son of Heaven's orchard; west of them the Turtle Beak governs the inner palace—if not bright, the empress loses power;

translations.literal: not complete or trembling: means bandits;
translations.idiomatic: if not complete or trembling, bandits are foretold;

translations.literal: bright: then the year abundant;
translations.idiomatic: if bright, the year will be abundant;

translations.literal: dim: then fruit does not ripen.
translations.idiomatic: if dim, fruit will not ripen.

sentences.zh: 彗、孛犯之，近臣僭，有戮死者。

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing them: close ministers overstep, some are executed.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or broom star trespasses them, close ministers will overstep and some will be executed.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，魚鹽貴，山谷多水；

translations.literal: A guest star dwelling on them: fish and salt costly, valleys have much water;
translations.idiomatic: if a guest star dwells upon them, fish and salt will be costly and valleys will have much water;

translations.literal: trespassing them: there are roaming troops that do not fight.
translations.idiomatic: if it trespasses them, roaming troops will appear that do not fight.

sentences.zh: 蒼白雲氣入之，果不可食；

translations.literal: pale white cloud-vapor entering: fruit cannot be eaten;
translations.idiomatic: if pale white cloud-vapor enters, fruit cannot be eaten;

translations.literal: green: the Son of Heaven besieges cities;
translations.idiomatic: if green, the Son of Heaven will besiege cities;

translations.literal: yellow: then the Son of Heaven bestows fruit on feudal lords;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, the Son of Heaven will bestow fruit on feudal lords;

translations.literal: black: the Son of Heaven eats fruit and falls ill.
translations.idiomatic: if black, the Son of Heaven will eat fruit and fall ill.

sentences.zh: 扶筐七星，爲盛桑之器，主勸蠶也，一曰供奉後與夫人之親蠶。

translations.literal: Supporting Basket seven stars are vessels for holding mulberry, governing encouraging sericulture; one account says supplying the empress and consorts' personal sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: The Supporting Basket seven stars are vessels for holding mulberry and govern encouraging sericulture; one account says they supply the empress and consorts' personal sericulture.

translations.literal: bright: auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: if bright, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: dim: inauspicious;
translations.idiomatic: if dim, the omen is inauspicious;

translations.literal: shifting: then women workers lose their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: if they shift, women workers will lose their livelihoods.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: generals rebel.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses them, generals will rebel.

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing: silk and floss greatly costly.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star trespasses them, silk and floss will be greatly costly.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，已上諸星俱屬須女，而十二國及奚仲、匏瓜、敗瓜等星，《晉志》不載，《隋志》有之。

translations.literal: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the above stars belong to the Maiden; but the Twelve States and Xi Zhong, Gourd, Ruined Melon, and the like—the 《Book of Jin》 does not record them; the 《Book of Sui》 has them.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the stars above belong to the Maiden; but the Twelve States, Xi Zhong, Gourd, Ruined Melon, and the like are not recorded in the 《Book of Jin》; the 《Book of Sui》 has them.

sentences.zh: 《晉志》又以離珠、天津屬天市垣，扶筐屬太微垣。

translations.literal: The 《Book of Jin》 also assigns Pearls Apart and Celestial Ford to the Celestial Market Enclosure, and Supporting Basket to the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Book of Jin》 also assigns Pearls Apart and Celestial Ford to the Celestial Market Enclosure and Supporting Basket to the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以周、越、齊、趙屬牛，秦、代、韓、魏、燕、晉、楚、鄭屬女。

translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns Zhou, Yue, Qi, and Zhao to the Ox, and Qin, Dai, Han, Wei, Yan, Jin, Chu, and Zheng to the Maiden.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns Zhou, Yue, Qi, and Zhao to the Ox and Qin, Dai, Han, Wei, Yan, Jin, Chu, and Zheng to the Maiden.

sentences.zh: 武密以離珠、匏瓜屬牛又屬女，以奚仲屬危。

translations.literal: Wu Mi assigns Pearls Apart and Gourd to the Ox and again to the Maiden, and Xi Zhong to the Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi assigns Pearls Apart and Gourd to the Ox and again to the Maiden, and Xi Zhong to the Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以離珠、匏瓜屬牛，敗瓜屬鬥又屬牛，以天津西一星屬鬥，中屬牛，東五星屬女。

translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns Pearls Apart and Gourd to the Ox, Ruined Melon to the Dipper and again to the Ox, the Celestial Ford's western one star to the Dipper, central to the Ox, eastern five to the Maiden.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns Pearls Apart and Gourd to the Ox, Ruined Melon to the Dipper and again to the Ox, the Celestial Ford's western star to the Dipper, its center to the Ox, and its eastern five to the Maiden.

sentences.zh: 虛宿二星，爲虛堂，塚宰之官也，主死喪哭泣，又主北方邑居、廟堂祭祀祝禱事。

translations.literal: The Emptiness Lodge's two stars are the Emptiness Hall, the Grand Steward's office, governing death, mourning, and weeping, also governing northern settlements, ancestral temples, and sacrificial prayer affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Emptiness Lodge's two stars form the Emptiness Hall, seat of the Grand Steward, governing death, mourning, and weeping, and also northern settlements, ancestral temples, and sacrificial prayers.

sentences.zh: 宋均曰：「危上一星高，旁兩星下，似蓋屋也。

translations.literal: Song Jun said: "Above the Rooftop one star is high and the two beside it low, like a covered house.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jun said: "Above the Rooftop one star is high and the two beside it low, like a covered house.

sentences.zh: 」蓋屋之下，中無人，但空虛似乎殯宮，主哭泣也。

translations.literal: " Below the covered house no one is within—only emptiness like a mourning palace, governing weeping.
translations.idiomatic: " Below the covered house no one dwells within—only emptiness like a mourning palace, governing weeping.

translations.literal: bright: then the realm is secure;
translations.idiomatic: if bright, the realm will be secure;

translations.literal: not bright: means drought;
translations.idiomatic: if not bright, drought is foretold;

sentences.zh: 欹斜上下不正，享祀不恭；

translations.literal: tilted up and down not upright: sacrifices are not reverent;
translations.idiomatic: if tilted and not upright, sacrifices will lack reverence;

translations.literal: moving: mourning will follow.
translations.idiomatic: if they move, mourning will follow.

translations.literal: A solar eclipse: in its allotted region that state has mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in its allotted region portends mourning for that state.

translations.literal: A solar halo: the people famish, many deaths among empresses and consorts.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo portends famine among the people and many deaths among empresses and consorts.

sentences.zh: 月食，主刀劍官有憂，國有喪。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: the sword-and-blade officials troubled, the state has mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse portends distress for sword-and-blade officials and mourning for the state.

sentences.zh: 月暈，有兵謀，風起則不成，又爲民饑。

translations.literal: A lunar halo: military plotting, if wind rises it does not succeed, also famine among the people.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends military plotting; if wind rises it will not succeed, and the people will famish.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，宗廟兵動，又國憂，將死。

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: the ancestral temple sees armies, also the state troubled, generals die.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, armies will stir at the ancestral temple, the state will be troubled, and generals will die.

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing: the people famish;
translations.idiomatic: if Jupiter trespasses it, the people will famish;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: color fades, the king changes garments;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, its color will fade and the king will change garments;

translations.literal: together with Saturn dwelling: flood and drought untimely.
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling together with Saturn, flood and drought will be untimely.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing it: blood fills the wilds;
translations.idiomatic: if Mars trespasses it, blood will fill the wilds;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: means drought, the people famish, armies defeated;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, drought is foretold, the people will famish, and armies will be defeated;

translations.literal: entering: fire calamity, achievement completed then banished;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, fire calamity will follow, achievement completed then banishment;

translations.literal: or coiled-serpent aspect: the great man battles unfavorably.
translations.idiomatic: or if forming the coiled-serpent aspect, the great man will battle unfavorably.

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing it: there is an urgent decree;
translations.idiomatic: if Saturn trespasses it, an urgent decree will follow;

translations.literal: moving swiftly: there are guest armies;
translations.idiomatic: if moving swiftly, guest armies will appear;

sentences.zh: 入，則有赦，穀不成，人不安；

translations.literal: entering: then there is an amnesty, grain does not ripen, people unsettled;
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, an amnesty will be proclaimed, grain will fail to ripen, and people will be unsettled;

sentences.zh: 守之，風雨不時，爲旱，米貴，大卜欲危宗廟，有客兵。

translations.literal: dwelling on it: wind and rain untimely, drought, rice dear, the grand diviner wishes harm to the ancestral temple, guest armies.
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, wind and rain will be untimely, drought and dear rice will follow, the grand diviner will wish harm to the ancestral temple, and guest armies will appear.

translations.literal: Venus trespassing: below many orphans and widows, armies and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if Venus trespasses it, below there will be many orphans and widows, armies and mourning;

translations.literal: emerging: government pressing;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, government will be pressing;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: ministers rebel against the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, ministers will rebel against the ruler;

translations.literal: entering: then great ministers are imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, great ministers will be imprisoned.

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: in spring and autumn there is water;
translations.idiomatic: if Mercury trespasses it, in spring and autumn there will be water;

sentences.zh: 守之，亦爲水災，在東爲春水，南爲夏水，西爲秋水，北冬有雷雨、水。

translations.literal: dwelling on it: also flood calamity—in the east spring water, south summer water, west autumn water, north winter has thunder rain and water.
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, flood calamity will follow—east spring water, south summer water, west autumn water, north winter thunder and rain.

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: grain dear;
translations.idiomatic: if a guest star trespasses it, grain prices will soar;

sentences.zh: 守之，兵起，近期一年，遠則二年，有哭泣事；

translations.literal: dwelling on it: armies rise; near term one year, far term two years, there are weeping affairs;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, armies will rise; in the near term one year, in the far two years, weeping affairs will follow;

translations.literal: emerging: means armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, armies and mourning are foretold.

translations.literal: A comet trespassing it: the state is dire, there are rebel ministers;
translations.idiomatic: if a comet trespasses it, the state will be dire and rebel ministers will appear;

translations.literal: emerging: field battle and flowing blood;
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, field battle and flowing blood are foretold;

sentences.zh: 出入，有兵起，芒焰所指國必亡。

translations.literal: entering and emerging: armies rise; the country pointed to by rays and flames will perish.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters and emerges, armies will rise and the country its rays point to will perish.

translations.literal: A broom star at its lodge: there are weeping affairs;
translations.idiomatic: if a broom star appears at its lodge, weeping affairs are foretold;

sentences.zh: 出，則爲野戰流血，國有叛臣。

translations.literal: emerging: then field battle and flowing blood, the state has rebel ministers.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, field battle and flowing blood follow and the state will have rebel ministers.

sentences.zh: 流星犯，光潤出入，則塚宰受賞，有赦令；

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing, lustrous entering and emerging: the Grand Steward receives reward, there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if a shooting star trespasses, lustrous in entering and emerging, the Grand Steward will receive reward and an amnesty will be proclaimed;

translations.literal: color black: great ministers die;
translations.idiomatic: if black, great ministers will die;

translations.literal: entering and color green: there are weeping affairs;
translations.idiomatic: if entering green, weeping affairs are foretold;

translations.literal: yellow-white: there is one who receives gifts;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow-white, someone will receive gifts;

translations.literal: emerging: then nobles seek medicine.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, nobles will seek medicine.

translations.literal: cloud-vapor yellow entering: means joy;
translations.idiomatic: if yellow cloud-vapor enters, joy is foretold;

translations.literal: pale: means weeping;
translations.idiomatic: if pale, weeping is foretold;

translations.literal: red: fire;
translations.idiomatic: if red, fire is foretold;

translations.literal: black: water;
translations.idiomatic: if black, water is foretold;

translations.literal: white: guest bearing coins comes.
translations.idiomatic: if white, a guest bearing coins will come.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以虛爲十度，唐開元遊儀同。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Emptiness was reckoned at ten degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary agrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary the Emptiness Lodge was measured at ten degrees; the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary agrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極百四度，今百一度。

translations.literal: Former polar distance one hundred four degrees; now one hundred one degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The former polar distance was one hundred four degrees; it is now one hundred one degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，距南星去極百三度，在赤道外十二度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: from the southern star, polar distance one hundred three degrees, twelve degrees south of the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey placed the southern star at a polar distance of one hundred three degrees, twelve degrees south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 司命二星，在虛北，主舉過、行罰、滅不祥，又主死亡。

translations.literal: Director of Fate two stars, north of Emptiness, govern reporting faults, imposing punishments, and extinguishing ill omens, also govern death.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Fate two stars lie north of Emptiness and govern reporting faults, imposing punishments, and extinguishing ill omens, and also death.

sentences.zh: 逢星出司命，王者憂疾，一曰宜防祅惑。

translations.literal: A shooting star emerging at Director of Fate: the king is troubled by illness; one account says guard against seductive delusions.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star emerges at the Director of Fate, the king will be troubled by illness; one account says guard against seductive delusions.

sentences.zh: 司祿二星，在司命北，主增年延德，又主掌功賞、食料、官爵。

translations.literal: Director of Stipends two stars, north of Director of Fate, govern extending years and accumulating virtue, also govern bestowing merit rewards, provisions, ranks, and stipends.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Stipends two stars lie north of the Director of Fate and govern extending years and virtue, and also merit rewards, provisions, ranks, and stipends.

sentences.zh: 司危二星，在司祿北，主矯失正下，又主樓閣台榭、死喪、流亡。

translations.literal: Director of Peril two stars, north of Director of Stipends, govern correcting the improper below, also govern towers, pavilions, terraces, death, mourning, and exile.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Peril two stars lie north of Director of Stipends and govern correcting impropriety below, and also towers, pavilions, death, mourning, and exile.

sentences.zh: 司非二星，在司危北，主司候內外，察愆尤，主過失。

translations.literal: Director of Blame two stars, north of Director of Peril, govern inspecting inner and outer affairs and detecting faults, governing errors.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Blame two stars lie north of Director of Peril and govern inspecting inner and outer affairs and detecting faults.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》：命、祿、危、非八星主天子已下壽命、爵祿、安危、是非之事。
