translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》: the eight stars of Fate, Stipends, Peril, and Blame govern below the Son of Heaven matters of lifespan, stipends, safety, and right and wrong.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 says the eight stars of Fate, Stipends, Peril, and Blame govern below the Son of Heaven matters of lifespan, stipends, safety, and right and wrong.

translations.literal: bright and large: means calamity;
translations.idiomatic: if bright and large, calamity is foretold;

translations.literal: dwelling normally: means auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling normally, the omen is auspicious.

sentences.zh: 哭二星，在虛南，主哭泣、死喪。

translations.literal: Weeping two stars, south of Emptiness, govern weeping and death mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The Weeping two stars lie south of Emptiness and govern weeping and death mourning.

translations.literal: moon, five planets, comet, or broom star trespassing them: means mourning.
translations.idiomatic: if the moon, five planets, a comet, or broom star trespasses them, mourning is foretold.

sentences.zh: 泣二星在哭星東，與哭同占。

translations.literal: Sobbing two stars east of Weeping stars, prognosticated the same as Weeping.
translations.idiomatic: The Sobbing two stars lie east of the Weeping stars, with prognostication the same as Weeping.

sentences.zh: 天壘城一十三星，在泣南，圜如大錢，形若貫索，主鬼方、北邊丁零類，所以候興敗存亡。

translations.literal: Celestial Rampart thirteen stars, south of Sobbing, round like large coins, shaped like a strung rope, governing the Guifang and northern Dingling tribes, for observing rise, fall, survival, and extinction.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Rampart thirteen stars lie south of Sobbing, round like large coins and shaped like a strung rope, governing the Guifang and northern Dingling tribes to observe rise, fall, survival, and extinction.

translations.literal: Mars entering and dwelling: barbarians raid the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars enters and dwells, barbarians will raid the frontier.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: the north is invaded.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters, the north will be invaded.

sentences.zh: 赤雲氣掩之，北方驚滅，有疾疫。

translations.literal: red cloud-vapor covering them: the north is startled and destroyed, there is plague.
translations.idiomatic: If red cloud-vapor covers them, the north will be startled and destroyed and plague will follow.

sentences.zh: 離瑜三星，在十二國東，《乾象新書》在天壘城南。

translations.literal: Pearls on Belt three stars, east of the Twelve States; the 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 places them south of the Celestial Rampart.
translations.idiomatic: The Pearls on Belt three stars lie east of the Twelve States; the 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 places them south of the Celestial Rampart.

translations.literal: pearls: ceremonial robes;
translations.idiomatic: pearls: ceremonial robes;

sentences.zh: 瑜，玉飾，皆婦人見舅姑衣服也。

translations.literal: belt ornaments: jade adornments, all a woman's garments when meeting her husband's parents.
translations.idiomatic: belt ornaments: jade adornments, all a woman's garments when meeting her husband's parents.

translations.literal: minute: then the inner palace is frugal;
translations.idiomatic: if minute, the inner palace will be frugal;

translations.literal: bright: then women are extravagant.
translations.idiomatic: if bright, women will be extravagant.

sentences.zh: 客星、彗星入之，後宮無禁。

translations.literal: A guest star or comet entering: the inner palace has no restraint.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star or comet enters, the inner palace will have no restraint.

sentences.zh: 敗臼四星，在虛、危南，兩兩相對，主敗亡、災害。

translations.literal: Ruined Mortar four stars, south of Emptiness and Rooftop, two pairs facing one another, governing defeat, ruin, and calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The Ruined Mortar four stars lie south of Emptiness and Rooftop in two facing pairs, governing defeat, ruin, and calamity.

sentences.zh: 石申曰：「一星不具，民賣甑釜；

translations.literal: Shi Shen said: "One star not complete: the people sell cauldrons and steamers;
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shen wrote: "If one star is not complete, the people will sell their cauldrons and steamers;

translations.literal: not visible: the people leave their villages.
translations.idiomatic: if not visible, the people will leave their villages.

translations.literal: " The five planets entering: remove the old and spread the new.
translations.idiomatic: " If the five planets enter, the old will be removed and the new spread.

sentences.zh: 客星、彗星犯之，民饑，流亡。

translations.literal: A guest star or comet trespassing them: the people famish, scatter in exile.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star or comet trespasses them, the people will famish and scatter in exile.

translations.literal: black vapor entering: the ruler is troubled.
translations.idiomatic: If black vapor enters, the ruler will be troubled.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，已上諸星俱屬虛宿。

translations.literal: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the above stars belong to the Emptiness Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the stars above belong to the Emptiness Lodge.

sentences.zh: 司命、司祿、司危、司非、離瑜、敗臼，《晉志》不載，《隋志》有之。

translations.literal: Director of Fate, Stipends, Peril, Blame, Pearls on Belt, and Ruined Mortar—the 《Book of Jin》 does not record them; the 《Book of Sui》 has them.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Fate, Stipends, Peril, Blame, Pearls on Belt, and Ruined Mortar are not recorded in the 《Book of Jin》; the 《Book of Sui》 has them.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以司命、司祿、司危、司非屬須女；

translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns Director of Fate, Stipends, Peril, and Blame to the Maiden;
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns Director of Fate, Stipends, Peril, and Blame to the Maiden;

translations.literal: Sobbing stars and Ruined Mortar to the Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: Sobbing stars and Ruined Mortar to the Rooftop.

translations.literal: Wu Mi's book agrees with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi's book agrees with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.

sentences.zh: 危宿三星，在天津東南，爲天子宗廟祭祀，又爲天子土功，又主天府、天市、架屋、受藏之事。

translations.literal: The Rooftop Lodge's three stars, southeast of the Celestial Ford, are the Son of Heaven's ancestral temple sacrifices, also the Son of Heaven's earthworks, also governing the celestial treasury, celestial market, framing houses, and receiving stores.
translations.idiomatic: The Rooftop Lodge's three stars lie southeast of the Celestial Ford as the Son of Heaven's ancestral temple sacrifices, also his earthworks, and also the celestial treasury, celestial market, framing houses, and receiving stores.

translations.literal: not bright: guests face execution, earthworks rise;
translations.idiomatic: if not bright, guests face execution and earthworks will rise;

translations.literal: moving or dim: palace buildings constructed, military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: if moving or dim, palace buildings will be constructed and military affairs arise.

sentences.zh: 日食，陵廟摧，有大喪，有叛臣。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse: mausoleums destroyed, great mourning, rebel ministers.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse portends destroyed mausoleums, great mourning, and rebel ministers.

translations.literal: A solar halo: there is mourning.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo portends mourning.

sentences.zh: 月食，大臣憂，有喪，宮殿圮。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: great ministers troubled, mourning, palace halls collapse.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse portends distress for great ministers, mourning, and collapsed palace halls.

sentences.zh: 月暈，有兵、喪，先用兵者敗。

translations.literal: A lunar halo: armies and mourning; whoever uses armies first is defeated.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends armies and mourning; whoever uses armies first will be defeated.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，宮殿陷，臣叛主，來歲糴貴，有大喪。

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: palace halls fall, ministers rebel against the ruler, next year grain dear, great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, palace halls will fall, ministers will rebel, next year grain will be dear, and great mourning will follow.

sentences.zh: 歲星犯守，爲兵、役徭，多土功，有哭泣事，又多盜。

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing and dwelling: armies and corvée labor, many earthworks, weeping affairs, also many bandits.
translations.idiomatic: If Jupiter trespasses and dwells, armies and corvée labor, many earthworks, weeping affairs, and many bandits will follow.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing it: there is an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if Mars trespasses it, an amnesty will be proclaimed;

sentences.zh: 守之，人多疾，兵動，諸侯謀叛，宮中火災；

translations.literal: dwelling on it: many people ill, armies mobilize, feudal lords plot rebellion, fire in the palace;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, many will fall ill, armies will mobilize, feudal lords will plot rebellion, and the palace will burn;

sentences.zh: 守上星，人民死，中星諸侯死，下星大臣死，各期百日十日；

translations.literal: dwelling on the upper star: the people die; middle star: feudal lords die; lower star: great ministers die, each within one hundred or ten days;
translations.idiomatic: dwelling on the upper star: the people die; on the middle: feudal lords; on the lower: great ministers, each within one hundred or ten days;

sentences.zh: 守三十日，東兵起，歲旱，近臣叛；

translations.literal: dwelling thirty days: armies rise in the east, famine in the year, close ministers rebel;
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling thirty days, armies rise in the east, famine afflicts the year, and close ministers rebel;

translations.literal: entering: means armies, there is an order of change.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, armies arise and an order of change is issued.

sentences.zh: 填星守之，爲旱，民疾，土功興，國大戰；

translations.literal: Saturn dwelling on it: drought, the people ill, earthworks rise, the state battles greatly;
translations.idiomatic: if Saturn dwells upon it, drought and illness follow, earthworks rise, and the state battles greatly;

translations.literal: trespassing it: the chief consort troubled, armies and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if it trespasses it, the chief consort will be troubled and armies and mourning will follow;

sentences.zh: 出、入、留、舍，國亡地，有流血；

translations.literal: emerging, entering, remaining, or lodging: the state loses territory, there is flowing blood;
translations.idiomatic: if emerging, entering, remaining, or lodging, the state loses territory and blood flows;

translations.literal: entering: then great turmoil, rebel ministers rise.
translations.idiomatic: if it enters, great turmoil follows and rebel ministers rise.

sentences.zh: 太白犯之，爲兵，一曰無兵兵起，有兵兵罷，五穀不成，多火災；

translations.literal: Venus trespassing it: armies; one account says if no armies armies rise, if armies armies cease, the five grains do not ripen, many fire calamities;
translations.idiomatic: if Venus trespasses it, armies arise; one account says if no armies then armies rise, if armies then armies cease, the five grains fail, and fire calamities are many;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: generals troubled, also drought and fire;
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, generals will be troubled, with drought and fire;

translations.literal: lodging: there are urgent affairs.
translations.idiomatic: if lodging, urgent affairs arise.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯之，大臣誅，法官憂，國多災；

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing it: great ministers executed, judges troubled, the state has many calamities;
translations.idiomatic: if Mercury trespasses it, great ministers will be executed, judges troubled, and the state suffer many calamities;

sentences.zh: 守之，臣下叛，一云皇后疾，兵、喪起。

translations.literal: dwelling on it: subordinates rebel; one account says the chief consort ill, armies and mourning rise.
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, subordinates rebel; one account says the chief consort falls ill and armies and mourning rise.

sentences.zh: 客星犯，有哭泣，一曰多雨水，穀不收；

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: there is weeping; one account says much rain, grain does not ripen;
translations.idiomatic: if a guest star trespasses it, weeping follows; one account says much rain and grain fails to ripen;

sentences.zh: 入之，有土功，或三日有赦；

translations.literal: entering: earthworks; or within three days an amnesty;
translations.idiomatic: if entering, earthworks; or within three days an amnesty;

translations.literal: emerging: then much rain, the five grains do not ripen;
translations.idiomatic: if emerging, much rain follows and the five grains fail to ripen;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: the state defeated, the people famish.
translations.idiomatic: if it dwells upon it, the state will be defeated and the people famish.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，下有叛臣兵起；

translations.literal: A comet trespassing it: below rebel ministers raise armies;
translations.idiomatic: if a comet trespasses it, rebel ministers below will raise armies;

sentences.zh: 出，則將軍出國，易政，大水，民饑。

translations.literal: emerging: then the general goes forth from the state, government changes, great flood, the people famish.
translations.idiomatic: if it emerges, the general goes forth, government changes, great flooding comes, and the people famish.

translations.literal: A broom star trespassing: the state has rebels who raise armies.
translations.idiomatic: If a broom star trespasses it, rebels in the state will raise armies.

sentences.zh: 流星犯之，春夏爲水災，秋冬爲口舌；

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing it: spring-summer flood calamity, autumn-winter slander;
translations.idiomatic: if a shooting star trespasses it, spring-summer brings flood and autumn-winter slander;

translations.literal: entering: then subordinates plot against superiors;
translations.idiomatic: if entering, subordinates plot against superiors;

translations.literal: reaching the Rooftop: armies clash in the northern lands.
translations.idiomatic: if reaching the Rooftop, armies clash in the northern lands.

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》：流星出入色黃潤，入民安，穀熟，土功興；

translations.literal: The Yisi Treatise: a shooting star entering and emerging yellow and moist: the people secure, grain ripens, earthworks rise;
translations.idiomatic: The Yisi Treatise says: if a shooting star enters and emerges yellow and moist, the people are secure, grain ripens, and earthworks rise;

translations.literal: color black: means water, great ministers suffer calamity.
translations.idiomatic: if black, water calamity follows and great ministers suffer calamity.

translations.literal: cloud-vapor entering, pale: means earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: if pale cloud-vapor enters, earthworks are foretold;

translations.literal: green: the state troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if green, the state is troubled;

translations.literal: black: water and mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if black, water and mourning;

translations.literal: red: fire;
translations.idiomatic: if red, fire;

translations.literal: white: distress and armies;
translations.idiomatic: if white, distress and armies;

translations.literal: yellow entering and emerging: joy.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow entering and emerging, joy is foretold.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，以危爲十六度；

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the Rooftop was reckoned at sixteen degrees;
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary the Rooftop was measured at sixteen degrees;

translations.literal: the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary seventeen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: on the Tang Kaiyuan touring armillary, seventeen degrees.

sentences.zh: 舊去極九十七度，距南星去極九十八度，在赤道外七度。

translations.literal: Former polar distance ninety-seven degrees; from the southern star polar distance ninety-eight degrees, seven degrees south of the equator.
translations.idiomatic: The former polar distance was ninety-seven degrees; the southern star at ninety-eight degrees, seven degrees south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 虛梁四星，在危宿南，主園陵寢廟、禱祝。

translations.literal: Void Bridge four stars, south of the Rooftop, govern imperial mausoleums, temples, and prayers.
translations.idiomatic: The Void Bridge four stars lie south of the Rooftop and govern imperial mausoleums, temples, and prayers.

translations.literal: Not a place for humans; hence called Void Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Not a place for humans—hence Void Bridge.

translations.literal: One account: palace dwellings, curtains, and sleeping quarters.
translations.idiomatic: One account: palace dwellings, curtains, and sleeping quarters.

translations.literal: Venus and Mars trespassing them: armies.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus and Mars trespass them, armies will arise.

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing: armies rise, ancestral temples altered.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or broom star trespasses them, armies will rise and ancestral temples will be altered.

sentences.zh: 天錢十星，在北落師門西北，主錢帛所聚，爲軍府藏。

translations.literal: Celestial Coin ten stars, northwest of North Gate Army, where coin and silk gather, the military treasury store.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Coin ten stars lie northwest of the North Gate Army where coin and silk gather, the military treasury.

translations.literal: bright: then treasuries full;
translations.idiomatic: if bright, treasuries will be full;

translations.literal: dim: empty.
translations.idiomatic: if dim, treasuries will be empty.

translations.literal: Venus and Mars dwelling on them: bandits rise.
translations.idiomatic: If Venus and Mars dwell upon them, bandits will rise.

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing them: treasuries have bandits.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or broom star trespasses them, treasuries will suffer bandits.

sentences.zh: 墳墓四星，在危南，主山陵、悲慘、死喪、哭泣。

translations.literal: Tombs four stars, south of the Rooftop, govern mountain tombs, grief, death mourning, and weeping.
translations.idiomatic: The Tombs four stars south of the Rooftop govern mountain tombs, grief, death mourning, and weeping.

translations.literal: Large called tomb, small called grave.
translations.idiomatic: The large is called tomb, the small grave.

sentences.zh: 五星守犯，爲人主哭泣之事。

translations.literal: The five planets dwelling or trespassing: matters of the ruler weeping.
translations.idiomatic: If the five planets dwell or trespass them, the ruler will weep.

sentences.zh: 杵三星，在人星東，一云在臼星北，主舂軍糧。

translations.literal: Pestle three stars, east of the Human stars, one account north of the Mortar stars, governing pounding army grain.
translations.idiomatic: The Pestle three stars lie east of the Human stars—one account north of the Mortar—governing pounding army grain.

translations.literal: not complete: the people sell cauldrons and steamers.
translations.idiomatic: if not complete, the people will sell cauldrons and steamers.

sentences.zh: 臼四星，在杵星下，一云在危東。

translations.literal: Mortar four stars, below the Pestle stars, one account east of the Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: The Mortar four stars lie below the Pestle—one account east of the Rooftop.

translations.literal: Pestle and Mortar not bright: the people famish;
translations.idiomatic: if Pestle and Mortar are not bright, the people will famish;

translations.literal: many stars: the year joyful;
translations.idiomatic: if many stars, the year will be joyful;

translations.literal: sparse: famine;
translations.idiomatic: if sparse, famine;

translations.literal: trembling: also famine;
translations.idiomatic: if trembling, also famine;

translations.literal: Pestle straight down facing Mortar: auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: if the Pestle points straight to the Mortar, the omen is auspicious;

translations.literal: not matching: army grain exhausted;
translations.idiomatic: if not matching, army grain will be exhausted;

translations.literal: vertical: auspicious;
translations.idiomatic: if vertical, auspicious;

translations.literal: horizontal: waste;
translations.idiomatic: if horizontal, barren;

translations.literal: also Mortar covering: famine in the year;
translations.idiomatic: if the Mortar is covered, famine in the year;

translations.literal: upturned: the year ripens.
translations.idiomatic: if upturned, the year will ripen.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，民饑，兵起，天下急。

translations.literal: A comet trespassing them: the people famish, armies rise, the realm urgent.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet trespasses them, the people will famish, armies rise, and the realm will be urgent.

sentences.zh: 客星守之，天下聚會米粟。

translations.literal: A guest star dwelling on them: the realm gathers rice and grain.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star dwells upon them, the realm will gather rice and grain.

sentences.zh: 蓋屋二星，在危宿南九度，主治宮室。

translations.literal: Canopy House two stars, nine degrees south of the Rooftop, governing palace buildings.
translations.idiomatic: The Canopy House two stars lie nine degrees south of the Rooftop and govern palace buildings.

translations.literal: The five planets trespassing them: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: If the five planets trespass them, armies will rise.

translations.literal: A comet or broom star trespassing and dwelling: military calamity especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or broom star trespasses and dwells, military calamity will be especially severe.

sentences.zh: 造父五星，在傳舍南，一曰在騰蛇北，御官也。

translations.literal: Zao Fu five stars, south of the Relay Lodges, one account north of Coiled Serpent, the imperial carriage office.
translations.idiomatic: Zao Fu's five stars lie south of the Relay Lodges—one account north of Coiled Serpent—as the imperial carriage office.

sentences.zh: 一曰司馬，或曰伯樂，主御營馬廄、馬乘、轡勒。

translations.literal: Also called Marshal, or Bo Le, governing imperial stables, horses, bridles, and reins.
translations.idiomatic: Also called Marshal, or Bo Le, governing imperial stables, horses, bridles, and reins.

translations.literal: shifting position: armies rise, horses costly;
translations.idiomatic: if shifting, armies rise and horses will be costly;

translations.literal: stars vanished: horses greatly costly.
translations.idiomatic: if the stars vanish, horses will be greatly costly.

sentences.zh: 彗、客入之，僕御謀主，有斬死者，一曰兵起；

translations.literal: A comet or guest entering: attendants plot against the ruler, some executed; one account armies rise;
translations.idiomatic: if a comet or guest enters, attendants plot against the ruler and some are executed; one account says armies rise;

translations.literal: dwelling on them: armies mobilize, stable horses go forth.
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling upon them, armies mobilize and stable horses go forth.

sentences.zh: 人五星，在虛北，車府東，如人形，一曰主萬民，柔遠能邇；

translations.literal: Human five stars, north of Emptiness, east of Carriage Repository, like a human form; one account governs the myriad people, gentle to the distant and capable to the near;
translations.idiomatic: The Human five stars lie north of Emptiness, east of Carriage Repository, like a human; one account governs the myriad people, gentle to the distant and capable to the near;

sentences.zh: 又曰臥星，主夜行，以防淫人。

translations.literal: another account: Lying stars, governing night travel to guard against licentious persons.
translations.idiomatic: another account: Lying stars, governing night travel against licentious persons.

sentences.zh: 星亡，則有詐作詔者，又爲婦人之亂；

translations.literal: stars vanished: there are false edicts; also women's rebellion;
translations.idiomatic: if the stars vanish, false edicts appear and women rebel;

translations.literal: stars not complete: the prince has distress.
translations.idiomatic: if the stars are not complete, the prince will suffer distress.

translations.literal: A guest star or comet dwelling or trespassing: many people suffer plague.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest or comet dwells or trespasses them, many will suffer plague.

sentences.zh: 車府七星，在天津東，近河，東西列，主車府之官，又主賓客之館。

translations.literal: Carriage Repository seven stars, east of the Celestial Ford, near the river, arrayed east-west, governing carriage officials, also governing guests' lodges.
translations.idiomatic: The Carriage Repository seven stars lie east of the Celestial Ford near the river, arrayed east-west, governing carriage officials and guests' lodges.

sentences.zh: 星光明，潤澤，必有外賓，車駕華潔。

translations.literal: stars bright, lustrous: there will certainly be foreign guests, carriages splendid.
translations.idiomatic: if the stars are bright and lustrous, foreign guests will come and carriages will be splendid.

translations.literal: Mars dwelling on them: armies mobilize.
translations.idiomatic: If Mars dwells upon them, armies will mobilize.

translations.literal: A comet or guest trespassing: war chariots go forth.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet or guest trespasses them, war chariots go forth.

sentences.zh: 鉤九星，在造父西河中，如鉤狀。

translations.literal: Hook nine stars, in the river west of Zao Fu, hook-shaped.
translations.idiomatic: The Hook nine stars lie in the river west of Zao Fu, hook-shaped.

translations.literal: stars straight: the earth quakes;
translations.idiomatic: if the stars stand straight, the earth will quake;

translations.literal: other stars dwelling: prognostication the same.
translations.idiomatic: if other stars dwell, prognostication is the same.

translations.literal: One account: governs palanquins and apparel.
translations.idiomatic: One account: they govern palanquins and apparel.

translations.literal: bright: then apparel is correct.
translations.idiomatic: if bright, apparel will be correct.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，已上諸星俱屬危宿。

translations.literal: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the above stars belong to the Rooftop Lodge.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, all the stars above belong to the Rooftop Lodge.

sentences.zh: 《晉志》不載人星、車府，《隋志》有之。

translations.literal: The 《Book of Jin》 does not record Human stars or Carriage Repository; the 《Book of Sui》 has them.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Book of Jin》 does not record the Human stars or Carriage Repository; the 《Book of Sui》 has them.

translations.literal: Pestle and Mortar stars are in neither the 《Book of Jin》 nor the 《Book of Sui》.
translations.idiomatic: The Pestle and Mortar stars appear in neither the 《Book of Jin》 nor the 《Book of Sui》.

sentences.zh: 造父、鉤星，《晉志》屬紫微垣，蓋屋、虛梁、天錢在二十八宿外。

translations.literal: Zao Fu and Hook stars—the 《Book of Jin》 assigns them to the Purple Palace Enclosure; Canopy House, Void Bridge, and Celestial Coin lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.
translations.idiomatic: Zao Fu and Hook stars are assigned by the 《Book of Jin》 to the Purple Palace Enclosure; Canopy House, Void Bridge, and Celestial Coin lie outside the Twenty-eight Lodges.

sentences.zh: 《乾象新書》以車府西四星屬虛，東三星屬危。

translations.literal: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns the western four stars of Carriage Repository to Emptiness and the eastern three to Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: The 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 assigns Carriage Repository's western four stars to Emptiness and its eastern three to Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 武密書以造父屬危又屬室，餘皆與《步天歌》合。

translations.literal: Wu Mi's book assigns Zao Fu to Rooftop and again to Encampment; the rest agrees with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi's book assigns Zao Fu to Rooftop and again to Encampment; the rest agrees with the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》.

sentences.zh: 按《乾象新書》又有天綱一星，在危宿南，入危八度，去極百三十二度，在赤道外四十一度。

translations.literal: According to the 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 there is also a Celestial Guideline one star, south of the Rooftop, entering Rooftop eight degrees, polar distance one hundred thirty-two degrees, forty-one degrees south of the equator.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《New Book of the Supernal Image》 there is also a Celestial Guideline star south of the Rooftop, entering Rooftop eight degrees at polar distance one hundred thirty-two degrees, forty-one degrees south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 《晉》、《隋志》及諸家星書皆不載，止載危、室二宿間與北落師門相近者。

translations.literal: The 《Book of Jin》, 《Book of Sui》, and all star books do not record it; they only record what lies between Rooftop and Encampment near the North Gate Army.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Book of Jin》, 《Book of Sui》, and star books do not record it; they only record stars between Rooftop and Encampment near the North Gate Army.

sentences.zh: 近世天文乃載此一星，在鬼、柳間，與外廚、天紀相近。

translations.literal: Recent astronomy records this star between Ghost and Willow, near Outer Kitchen and Celestial Chronogram.
translations.idiomatic: Recent astronomy records this star between Ghost and Willow, near Outer Kitchen and Celestial Chronogram.

sentences.zh: 然《新書》兩天綱雖同在危度，其說不同，今姑附于此。

translations.literal: Yet the 《New Book》's two Celestial Guidelines, though both in Rooftop degrees, differ in account; for now it is appended here.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the 《New Book》's two Celestial Guidelines, though both in Rooftop degrees, differ in account; for now it is appended here.

sentences.zh: 營室二星，天子之宮，一曰玄宮，一曰清廟，又爲軍糧之府，主土功事。

translations.literal: Encampment two stars, the Son of Heaven's palace, also called Dark Palace, also Clear Temple, also the military grain storehouse, governing earthworks.
translations.idiomatic: The Encampment two stars are the Son of Heaven's palace, also the Dark Palace and Clear Temple, and the military grain storehouse, governing earthworks.

sentences.zh: 一曰室一星爲天子宮，一星爲太廟，爲王者三軍之廩，故置羽林以衛；

translations.literal: One account: one Encampment star is the Son of Heaven's palace, one the Grand Temple, the king's three armies' granary; hence the Feathered Forest is set to guard.
translations.idiomatic: One account: one star is the Son of Heaven's palace, one the Grand Temple, the three armies' granary; hence the Feathered Forest guards them.

sentences.zh: 又爲離宮閣道，故有離宮六星在其側。

translations.literal: Also the detached palace passage; hence the six Detached Palace stars at its side.
translations.idiomatic: Also the detached palace passage; hence the six Detached Palace stars beside it.

sentences.zh: 一曰定室，《詩》曰「定之方中」也。

translations.literal: Also called Fixed Encampment—the Odes say 'fixed at the center'.
translations.idiomatic: Also called Fixed Encampment—as the Odes say 'fixed at the center'.

translations.literal: stars bright: the state flourishes;
translations.idiomatic: if the stars are bright, the state will flourish;

sentences.zh: 不明而小，祠祀鬼神不享；

translations.literal: not bright and small: sacrifices to ghosts and spirits not enjoyed;
translations.idiomatic: if not bright and small, sacrifices to ghosts and spirits will not be enjoyed;

translations.literal: moving: then earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: if moving, earthworks will follow;

translations.literal: not complete: distress for sons and grandsons;
translations.idiomatic: if not complete, sons and grandsons will suffer distress;

translations.literal: no rays, not moving: the realm is secure.
translations.idiomatic: if without rays and unmoving, the realm will be secure.

sentences.zh: 日食在室，國君憂，王者將兵，一曰軍絕糧，土卒亡。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse in Encampment: the state ruler troubled, the king will lead armies; one account the army lacks grain and soldiers perish.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse in Encampment troubles the state ruler; the king will lead armies; one account says the army lacks grain and soldiers perish.

translations.literal: A solar halo: the state troubled, the chief consort troubled and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo portends distress for the state and dismissal of the chief consort.

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: in its allotment earthworks, famine in the year.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse in its allotment portends earthworks and famine in the year.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: water, fire, and wind.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends water, fire, and wind.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，爲土功，有哭泣事。

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: earthworks, weeping affairs.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, earthworks and weeping affairs follow.

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing it: urgency and armies;
translations.idiomatic: if Jupiter trespasses it, urgency and armies follow;

translations.literal: entering: the Son of Heaven has an amnesty, ranks and stipends reach below;
translations.idiomatic: if entering, the Son of Heaven proclaims amnesty and ranks and stipends reach below;

translations.literal: lodging east of Encampment: many people die;

sentences.zh: 明大，則王者興，道術行，國多君子；

translations.literal: bright and large: then the king rises, the Way and techniques flourish, the state has many gentlemen;
translations.idiomatic: if bright and large, the king will rise, the Way and techniques flourish, and the state will have many gentlemen;

sentences.zh: 星失色，大小不同，王者好武，經術不用，圖書廢；

translations.literal: stars lose color, large and small differ: the king loves martial affairs, classical learning unused, books abandoned;
translations.idiomatic: if stars lose color and differ in size, the king loves martial affairs, learning is unused, and books abandoned;

translations.literal: stars moving: then earthworks.
translations.idiomatic: if the stars move, earthworks will follow.

sentences.zh: 日食于壁，陽消陰壞，男女多傷，國不用賢。

translations.literal: A solar eclipse at the Wall: yang fades and yin is ruined, many men and women harmed, the state does not employ the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse at the Wall means yang fades and yin is ruined, many men and women harmed, and the state does not employ the worthy.

translations.literal: A solar halo: eminent scholars troubled.
translations.idiomatic: A solar halo portends distress for eminent scholars.

sentences.zh: 月食，其分大臣憂，文章士廢，民多疫。

translations.literal: A lunar eclipse: in its allotment great ministers troubled, literary scholars dismissed, epidemic among the people.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar eclipse in its allotment troubles great ministers, dismisses literary scholars, and brings epidemic among the people.

translations.literal: A lunar halo: wind and water; its allotment has distress.
translations.idiomatic: A lunar halo portends wind and water; its allotment suffers distress.

sentences.zh: 月犯之，國有憂，爲饑，衛地有兵。

translations.literal: The moon trespassing it: the state troubled, famine, warfare in the Wei allotment.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses it, the state will be troubled, famine will follow, and warfare will arise in the Wei allotment.

translations.literal: Jupiter trespassing it: water harms the five grains;
translations.idiomatic: if Jupiter trespasses it, water will harm the five grains;

sentences.zh: 久守或淩犯、勾巳，有兵起。

translations.literal: long dwelling or encroaching, coiled-serpent: armies rise.
translations.idiomatic: if long dwelling, encroaching, or coiled-serpent, armies will rise.

translations.literal: Mars trespassing it: the Wei lands troubled;
translations.idiomatic: if Mars trespasses it, the Wei lands will be troubled;

translations.literal: dwelling on it: the state drought, the people famish, the worthy not employed;
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling upon it, the state will drought, the people famish, and the worthy not employed;

translations.literal: one prognostication: the king suffers great calamity.
translations.idiomatic: one prognostication: the king suffers great calamity.

sentences.zh: 填星犯守，圖書興，國王壽，天下豐，國用賢；

translations.literal: Saturn trespassing and dwelling: books flourish, the king long-lived, the realm abundant, the state employs the worthy;
translations.idiomatic: if Saturn trespasses and dwells, books flourish, the king enjoys long life, the realm is abundant, and the worthy are employed;

translations.literal: one prognostication: things do not ripen, the people mostly ill;
translations.idiomatic: one prognostication: things fail to ripen and the people mostly fall ill;

translations.literal: retrograde forming coiled-serpent: earthworks;
translations.idiomatic: if retrograde forming coiled-serpent, earthworks follow;

translations.literal: sixty days: a king is established throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: at sixty days, a king is established throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 太白犯之一二寸許，則諸侯用命；

translations.literal: Venus trespassing one or two cun: feudal lords obey orders;
translations.idiomatic: if Venus trespasses one or two cun, feudal lords obey orders;

sentences.zh: 守之，文武並用，一曰有軍不戰，一曰有兵喪，一曰水災，多風雨；

translations.literal: dwelling: civil and military both employed; one account armies do not fight; one account armies and mourning; one account flood, much wind and rain;
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling, civil and military are both employed; one account armies do not fight; one armies and mourning; one flood and much wind and rain;

translations.literal: one account: many fire calamities when trespassing.
translations.idiomatic: one account: many fire calamities when trespassing.

sentences.zh: 辰星犯，國有蓋藏保守之事，王者刑法急；

translations.literal: Mercury trespassing: the state has storehouse and conservation affairs, the king's punishments severe;
translations.idiomatic: if Mercury trespasses it, the state has storehouse conservation and the king's punishments are severe;

sentences.zh: 守之，近臣憂，一曰其分有喪，有兵，奸臣有謀；

translations.literal: dwelling: close ministers troubled; one account mourning in its allotment, armies, treacherous ministers plot;
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling, close ministers troubled; one account mourning, armies, treacherous plotting;

translations.literal: retrograde dwelling: bridges impassable.
translations.idiomatic: if retrograde dwelling, bridges are impassable.

sentences.zh: 客星犯之，文章士死，一曰有喪；

translations.literal: A guest star trespassing: literary scholars die; one account mourning;
translations.idiomatic: if a guest star trespasses, literary scholars die; one account mourning;

translations.literal: entering: earthworks, water;
translations.idiomatic: if entering, earthworks and water;

translations.literal: dwelling: much wind and rain in the year;
translations.idiomatic: if dwelling, much wind and rain in the year;

translations.literal: lodging: then many cattle and horses die.
translations.idiomatic: if lodging, many cattle and horses die.

sentences.zh: 彗星犯之，爲兵，爲火，一曰大水，民流。

translations.literal: A comet trespassing: armies and fire; one account great flood, the people scatter.
translations.idiomatic: if a comet trespasses, armies and fire; one account great flood and the people scatter.

translations.literal: A broom star trespassing: armies, fire and flood calamity.
translations.idiomatic: if a broom star trespasses, armies and fire and flood calamity follow.

translations.literal: A shooting star trespassing: literature abandoned;
translations.idiomatic: if a shooting star trespasses, literature is abandoned;

sentences.zh: 《乙巳占》曰：「若色黃白，天下文章士用。

translations.literal: The Yisi Treatise says: "If color yellow-white, literary scholars of the realm are employed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yisi Treatise says: "If yellow-white, literary scholars of the realm will be employed.

translations.literal: " red cloud-vapor entering: armies;
translations.idiomatic: " If red cloud-vapor enters, armies;

translations.literal: black: that state below is destroyed;
translations.idiomatic: if black, the state below is destroyed;

sentences.zh: 黃，則外國貢獻，一曰天下有烈士立。

translations.literal: yellow: then foreign states bring tribute; one account a heroic man is established throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: if yellow, foreign states bring tribute; one account a heroic man is established throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 按漢永元銅儀，東壁二星九度。

translations.literal: According to the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary, the eastern Wall two stars nine degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the Han Yongyuan bronze armillary the eastern Wall two stars were nine degrees.

translations.literal: Former polar distance eighty-six degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The former polar distance was eighty-six degrees.

sentences.zh: 景祐測驗，壁二星九度，距南星去極八十五度。

translations.literal: Jingyou survey measurements: Wall two stars nine degrees; from the southern star polar distance eighty-five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyou survey measured the Wall two stars at nine degrees, southern star at polar distance eighty-five degrees.

sentences.zh: 天廄十星，在東壁之北，主馬之官，若今驛亭也，主傳令置驛，逐漏馳騖，謂其急疾與晷漏競馳也。

translations.literal: Celestial Stables ten stars, north of the eastern Wall, governing horses' offices, like relay stations today, governing dispatching relays, chasing clepsydrae, racing with the sundial's urgency.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Stables ten stars lie north of the eastern Wall, governing horses' offices like relay stations, dispatching relays and racing clepsydrae.

translations.literal: The moon trespassing them: armies and horses return.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon trespasses them, armies and horses return.

translations.literal: A comet entering: stable fire.
translations.idiomatic: If a comet enters, the stables burn.

translations.literal: A guest star entering: horses go forth.
translations.idiomatic: If a guest star enters, horses go forth.

translations.literal: A shooting star entering: alarm throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: If a shooting star enters, alarm spreads throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 霹靂五星，在雲雨北，一曰在雷電南，一曰在土功西，主陽氣大盛，擊碎萬物。

translations.literal: Thunderclap five stars, north of Cloud and Rain, one account south of Thunder and Lightning, one account west of Earthworks Officers, governing great yang force shattering the myriad things.
translations.idiomatic: The Thunderclap five stars lie north of Cloud and Rain—one account south of Thunder and Lightning, one west of Earthworks Officers—governing great yang shattering things.

translations.literal: conjoining with the five planets: there is a thunderclap response.
translations.idiomatic: if conjoining with the five planets, thunderclap responds.

sentences.zh: 雲雨四星，在雷電東，一云在霹靂南，主雨澤，成萬物。

translations.literal: Cloud and Rain four stars, east of Thunder and Lightning, one account south of Thunderclap, governing rain and moisture ripening the myriad things.
translations.idiomatic: The Cloud and Rain four stars lie east of Thunder and Lightning—one account south of Thunderclap—governing rain ripening things.

translations.literal: stars bright: then much rain.
translations.idiomatic: if the stars are bright, rain will be abundant.

translations.literal: Mercury dwelling on them: great flood;
translations.idiomatic: if Mercury dwells upon them, great flood follows;

sentences.zh: 一占：主陰謀殺事，孳生萬物。

translations.literal: one prognostication: governing secret plotting and killing, generating the myriad things.
translations.idiomatic: one prognostication: secret plotting and killing, generating the myriad things.

sentences.zh: 鈇鑕五星，在天倉西南，刈具也，主斬芻飼牛馬。

translations.literal: Axe and Halberd five stars, southwest of the Celestial Granary, cutting implements, governing cutting fodder to feed cattle and horses.
translations.idiomatic: The Axe and Halberd five stars lie southwest of the Celestial Granary as cutting implements governing fodder for cattle and horses.

translations.literal: bright: then cattle and horses fat;
translations.idiomatic: if bright, cattle and horses are fat;

translations.literal: minute and dim: then cattle and horses hunger.
translations.idiomatic: if minute and dim, cattle and horses hunger.

sentences.zh: 按《步天歌》，壁宿下有鈇鑕五星，《晉》、《隋志》皆不載。

translations.literal: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, below the Wall Lodge are Axe and Halberd five stars; neither the 《Book of Jin》 nor the 《Book of Sui》 records them.
translations.idiomatic: According to the 《Song of Pacing the Heavens》, below the Wall Lodge are five Axe and Halberd stars; neither the 《Book of Jin》 nor the 《Book of Sui》 records them.

sentences.zh: 《隋志》八魁西北三星曰鈇鑕，又曰鈇鉞，其占與《步天歌》室宿內斧鉞略同，恐即是此誤重出之。

translations.literal: The 《Book of Sui》's three stars northwest of Eight Chiefs are called Axe and Halberd, also Axe and Spear, prognostication much like Encampment's Axe and Halberd—likely a duplicate error.
translations.idiomatic: The 《Book of Sui》's three stars northwest of Eight Chiefs are Axe and Halberd, also Axe and Spear, like Encampment's Axe and Halberd—likely a duplicate error.

sentences.zh: 霹靂五星、雲雨四星，《晉志》無之，《隋志》有之。

translations.literal: Thunderclap five stars and Cloud and Rain four stars are not in the 《Book of Jin》; the 《Book of Sui》 has them.
translations.idiomatic: Thunderclap and Cloud and Rain are not in the 《Book of Jin》; the 《Book of Sui》 has them.

translations.literal: Wu Mi's book assigns Cloud and Rain to Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Mi assigns Cloud and Rain to Encampment.

sentences.zh: 天廄十星，《晉志》屬天市垣，其說皆不同。

translations.literal: Celestial Stables ten stars—the 《Book of Jin》 assigns them to the Celestial Market Enclosure; the accounts differ.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Stables ten stars are assigned by the 《Book of Jin》 to the Celestial Market Enclosure; the accounts differ.
